jobs.title: Senior Director, Marketing Strategy
jobs.description:
Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com.

Job Description

Why this role exists

Blend's marketing function has grown into a global operation that spans the full marketing funnel, from brand and market perception through demand and pipeline. We are looking for a senior marketing leader to partner with the Head of Global Marketing to drive impact.

Blend has a clear identity and a real point of view. This role takes that foundation and expands it. The goal is to make the story land harder in the markets we are going after and extend it into the categories and regions we are moving into next, with tangible impact on the business. That means shaping how we describe ourselves, holding the through-line across various areas that reach the market, and making sure the story is consistent whether it shows up in an analyst evaluation, a press release, a conference stage, or with our partners and clients.

That partnership will look different depending on the work. Some of it is collaboration: setting strategy together, pressure-testing decisions, working through team scalability. Some of it is trusted ownership: taking a set of priorities, being accountable for the outcome without needing to check in, and managing a team with driven execution.

The shape of this role will also evolve as the business does. Today the center of gravity sits in business storytelling: translating growth objectives into a narrative the market believes, and making sure it holds up wherever Blend is evaluated. Over time it is likely to expand into growth priorities like events, partner marketing, and demand.

Where you will have impact

Our approach is account-based. We put focused energy against a defined set of target accounts and named markets, which means the narrative, the campaigns, the events calendar, the partner motions, and the regional plans all have to point in the same direction. A meaningful part of this role is making that focus real — and keeping it disciplined when it would be easier to broaden.

Market narrative and strategic consistency

Sharpen how Blend describes itself in market, including category positioning, differentiation against the firms we compete with, and the through-line that connects our thought leadership
Own the messaging architecture that campaigns, events, sales enablement, executive communications, and partner materials all draw from
Establish the editorial standards and governance that keep the story consistent across regions, functions, and channels, and define what good looks like so the standard survives without you in the room
Serve as the editorial check on the work that carries the most reputational weight: press releases, analyst responses, executive bylines, and launch narratives
Ability to define success metrics, track and develop reporting that supports decisions made in this area and their expected or actual impact to the business.

Reputation and market perception

Own how the business storyline lands publicly — earned media, thought leadership, and executive visibility that put Blend's leaders in the conversations that shape our market
Guide the analyst relations approach alongside the Head of Global Marketing and the senior leadership team: which evaluations we pursue, what we say in them, and how we build durable standing with the firms that define our category
Turn client outcomes into credible, well-sourced proof that carries weight with buyers, analysts, and media

Growth capacity and planning

Partner with the Head of Global Marketing on the annual and quarterly plan, translating company growth priorities into sequenced, resourced marketing work
Own the measurement framework for your areas: what we are accountable for, how it is tracked, and how it gets reported to the executive team and the board
Bring rigor to investment decisions, including where to spend, where to stop, and what tradeoffs we are making
Build the growth capacity that makes the storyline usable — enablement, client-facing materials, and proof that moves an account conversation forward with sales and the client business units
Align the events calendar and partner motions to the same storyline and the same target accounts, so what a buyer hears from a stage, a partner, and our teams is one consistent story

Team leadership and global operating consistency

Lead a group of marketers spanning communications, content, design, and enablement, and grow the team as the plan requires
Coach senior individual contributors and managers, set performance expectations, and build a bench
Bring resources and operating consistency to the global teams that carry growth — shared knowledge, shared content, and reuse that compounds across regions instead of restarting in each one
Run the cadence that keeps a distributed global team aligned and engaged
Push the function's AI-native operating model forward, using the tooling and knowledge infrastructure the team is building rather than treating it as a side project

Qualifications

What we are looking for

We care more about demonstrated range than years on a resume. The strongest candidates will be able to point to specifics.

A track record of owning a significant piece of a marketing organization and being accountable for its results. We will want to hear what you were measured on, what you decided, and what happened
Depth in brand, corporate communications, or integrated marketing, with earned media experience and enough analyst relations exposure to hold your own with the firms in our category
Genuine editorial judgment. You can tell strong writing from filler, you can fix it yourself, and you can teach others to see the difference
Scope that has spanned multiple marketing disciplines, and comfort operating outside your deepest area of expertise
Fluency in the technology industry and how technical narratives can show up in market with accuracy, credibility and differentiation
Comfort in professional services, or a clear pattern of learning a new industry fast and earning credibility in it quickly
Experience managing marketers and hiring senior people
Executive presence with a CEO and senior leadership team, and the judgment to know when to decide and when to escalate
The temperament for a role that will change. Much of this work is bringing structure to things that do not have it yet, and the priorities will move as the business grows

Marketing leaders from professional services, B2B technology, SaaS, or the data and AI space are all plausible fits. What matters is the capability, not the pedigree.

What would set you apart

Experience within service-based business, technology industry and the partner-ecosystem; especially how service partners work with technology hyper scalers
Having built or scaled a marketing function through a growth or transaction cycle
Practical, hands-on use of AI in your own marketing work rather than a theoretical interest in it
Experience marketing across LATAM or EMEA, or working across languages and regional buying cultures
Experience with a rebrand, repositioning, or category-definition effort
Established relationships with Forrester, Gartner, Everest Group, or similar

Additional Information

The starting pay range for this role is $190,000 - $210,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, paid holidays, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.

jobs.description:
About the Company

We don't do traditional staffing or source resumes. Ready Talent is a global Managed Services partner built for the modern enterprise. We design and deploy agile, high-performing teams to execute critical projects and solve complex challenges for the world’s most ambitious bra
nds.Working here means being part of a highly coordinated, expert unit delivering actual outcomes. Our people get the best of both worlds: direct, high-impact engagement with Tier-1 global enterprises, backed by an agile structure built entirely around execution, complete professional autonomy, and zero corporate noice.

Who we are looking for

We are seeking a sharp, highly strategic, and operationally rigorous Strategy & Operations Lead
to join our clients Chief of Staff team. In this role, you will serve as a critical engine for our Top 5 B2B Tech marketing organization, blending high-level business strategy
with world-class program management
.

The ideal candidate is a master communicator who can translate complex marketing data into compelling, executive-ready narratives. Operating on EST
, you will act as a central operator—streamlining business processes, optimizing leadership communication, and collaborating across regional and global teams to accelerate executive decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Communications & Strategy
Design executive narratives
: Create high-impact, visually polished presentations and briefing materials for VPs and C-suite executives.
Translate data into insights

Program Management & Operations
Drive operational excellence

Optimize leadership governance

Advanced data storytelling

Sharp analytical skills

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Vice President
jobs.description:
Senior Platform Engineer, VP

Who We Are Looking For

The State Street Cyber Architecture & Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer, VP.
The Cyber Data & Analytics team delivers models, insights, and tooling to help Cybersecurity teams make faster, more informed decisions as we work to secure State Street’s digital footprint.

Why this role is important to us

As a Senior Platform Engineer
, you will be responsible for driving the architecture and implementation of complex cloud & hybrid data solutions for all the customer teams at State Street in the form of an internal platform, deploying and maintaining our vast infrastructure using IaC tools, integrating new tools and technologies to boost efficiency and meet new challenges, and working with other engineers, architects, and managers to continue innovating in all the cloud efforts of the team.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Senior
Platform Engineer,
you will:

Architect cloud & hybrid infrastructure across various cloud providers and on-premises locations with multi-region HA & DR capabilities
Participate in Site Reliability Engineering practices, continuously remove toil by automating and designing it out
Mentor Platform Engineers on the team and participate in knowledge sharing sessions
Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.
Drive the technical vision for platforms owned by the Platform Engineering team, continuously review the technologies used to maintain the optimal tech stack
Develop software solutions for complex application and cloud infrastructure management and eliminate ClickOps
Build a robust modern platform with a fusion of purpose-made code and industry-standard tools, increasing team effectiveness and eliminating unnecessary toil.
Develop software tools for deployment, monitoring, alerting and operations automation
Own the platform implementation and functionality end-to-end with clear understanding from the end user standpoint
Maintain live services by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system performance
Design and build petabyte scale systems for high availability, high throughput, data consistency, security, and end user privacy, defining our next generation of data analytics tooling
Come up with solutions for scaling data systems for various business needs and collaborate in a dynamic and consultative environment.

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Minimum 8+ years of production engineering and management (deployment, release, maintenance, migration) using DevOps toolset and methodologies
Minimum 8+ years in developing production code using at least one high-level programming language like Python, Golang, Ruby, JavaScript
Minimum 5+ years in medium to large-scale production infrastructure management experience with at least one of the major cloud providers - AWS, GCP, Azure
Experience building and managing cybersecurity platforms such as Splunk, Sentinel, ELK, Anvilogic, Crogl, Databricks, etc.
Strong expertise in operation and workflow automation using tools like Ansible, Chef, Puppet
Production experience in the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, AWS CDK or similar tools
Deep understanding of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Harness, Spinnaker, Argo CD, etc.) and methodology, production experience in designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines with a focus on helping teams release frequently to production while maintaining deployment reliability
Medium to large-scale production infrastructure management experience with at least one of the major cloud providers - AWS, GCP, Azure
Understanding of core cloud security principles, experience in securing cloud platforms
Ability to troubleshoot and measure the performance of complex cloud environments
Strong understanding of Linux fundamentals (networking, filesystems, kernel, isolation)
Ability to transform business requirements into production-ready software components
Strong end-to-end ownership, autonomy, and a good sense of urgency to enable proper self-prioritization
Proven ability to self-sufficiently lead projects and cross-team engagements
Production experience with modern observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, etc.)
Understanding of core concepts of distributed systems design
Excellent communication skills

Work Requirements

This is a hybrid position with 3 days of the week spent at the office, with an 8 AM to 5 PM work schedule.

Salary Range

$120,000 - $202,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. jobs.title: Director, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Applications, Data and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
E2IP Technologies is looking for a Director, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Applications, Data and Artificial Intelligence to play a key role in the organization's next phase of growth, modernization, and risk posture.

This is a unique opportunity for a strategic, engaging and pragmatic leader who thrives running a small, agile team hands-on. Reporting to the Vice-President, IT, you will take ownership of the organization's cybersecurity posture and governance first and foremost, alongside the evolution of our enterprise application ecosystem, our data strategy, our artificial intelligence capabilities, our core IT infrastructure and collaboration tooling, our help desk function, and our technology project portfolio across our sites in Canada, Morocco and New Jersey.

In particular, you will lead our cybersecurity and compliance program (including ITAR, CMMC, and NIST 800-171), the evolution of the EPICOR/Kinetic ERP, the development of our BI and analytics capabilities, and the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence — spanning both cloud and on-premises environments.

This role is for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of security, business strategy, manufacturing operations and technology — and who wants to see the concrete impact of their decisions on the ground, leading a lean team rather than a large one.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES :

Lead cybersecurity and risk management

Own the organization's cybersecurity strategy, governance, and posture across Canada, Morocco and New Jersey — this is the top priority of the role.
Ensure compliance with ITAR, CMMC requirements and the NIST 800-171 standard in connection with defense-related activities.
Establish and maintain identity and access management practices, including Azure AD and Beyond Identity, with security as the primary lens.
Protect sensitive data and intellectual property, particularly in R&D, through strong data management, access control, and AI solution governance practices.
Lead incident response readiness, vulnerability management, and security awareness across the organization.
Evaluate and harden the security posture of collaboration and infrastructure tooling (Egnyte, Box, SharePoint, OneDrive, Ubiquiti, 3CX) in partnership with the help desk function.

Lead the transformation of enterprise applications

Define and deliver the vision, strategy and roadmap for E2IP Technologies' application ecosystem, including the EPICOR/Kinetic ERP, EPM/BOARD, BI tools, CRM, integrations and related platforms — with security and compliance built in by design.
Lead the evolution of the EPICOR/Kinetic ERP for the Canada, Morocco and New Jersey sites, ensuring sustainable adoption, effective governance and measurable business results.
Simplify and modernize the application portfolio to eliminate redundancies and improve the flow of cross-functional processes.
Identify opportunities to optimize business and operational processes through automation, systems integration and continuous improvement.
Ensure rigorous management of partners, vendors and integrators in order to maximize quality, speed of execution, security, and return on technology investments.

Turn data and AI into business value, securely

Establish a data and artificial intelligence strategy that supports business priorities, manufacturing operations and the organization's growth — with strong working knowledge of AI deployment in both cloud and on-premises environments, and security as a first-order design constraint.
Define and implement a data governance framework covering ownership, quality, classification, security, compliance and responsible use of data, including data lake infrastructure.
Build BI, reporting and advanced analytics capabilities, including executive dashboards, operational metrics and self-service analytics tools.
Identify, prioritize and deploy concrete use cases in artificial intelligence, predictive analytics and intelligent automation to improve planning, production, quality, supply chain, customer service and decision-making.
Put measurement mechanisms in place to demonstrate the value generated by data, AI and automation initiatives, particularly in terms of productivity, cost, quality, lead times and adoption.

Own IT infrastructure, help desk, and collaboration tooling

Directly manage the Help Desk Manager, providing oversight of day-to-day support operations, ticket escalation, SLAs, and end-user satisfaction — with a security-conscious support culture.
Maintain strong working knowledge of the organization's collaboration and file-management stack — Egnyte, Box, SharePoint, OneDrive, and the full Microsoft Office 365 Admin Center.
Maintain working knowledge of network and communications infrastructure, including Ubiquiti and 3CX, to guide the help desk team and vendor relationships.
Linux experience preferred, given the mixed infrastructure environment.

Establish a high-value delivery discipline

Create and grow a lean, pragmatic and results-oriented IT PMO to improve demand management, prioritization, execution, governance and accountability.
Oversee the IT project portfolio and ensure initiatives are prioritized according to their business value, operational impact, security risk, and strategic alignment.
Lead major technology projects, taking ownership of scope, budget, timelines, quality, risks, vendors and change management.
Foster a transparent, disciplined and collaborative delivery culture focused on measurable results rather than simply putting solutions into production.

Build and lead a small, high-performing team

Lead, coach and develop a small, agile team spanning cybersecurity, applications, data, artificial intelligence, project delivery, and help desk/end-user support.
Manage and develop the Help Desk Manager directly, including goal-setting, coaching, and performance management.
Define the team's resourcing needs and build the business cases required to recruit and structure a team capable of supporting the company's security, growth, and analytics ambitions.
Develop the team's skills in cybersecurity practices, data governance, automation, advanced analytics, and responsible AI.
Create an environment of close collaboration between IT teams, business units and the various sites, particularly between Montreal and Morocco.

YOUR PROFILE :

What you bring

Demonstrated cybersecurity leadership experience — governance, risk management, incident response, and compliance frameworks — is the top priority for this role.
More than 12 years of progressive IT experience, including leadership responsibilities in enterprise applications, data, digital transformation and project delivery.
Working knowledge of ITAR and CMMC compliance and the NIST 800-171 standard is required, not just an asset.
At least 5 years of experience leading ERP implementations, with EPICOR/Kinetic experience strongly preferred.
Strong working knowledge of artificial intelligence, both cloud-based and on-premises, with demonstrated experience identifying, prioritizing and delivering AI, advanced analytics or process automation use cases — deployed with security in mind.
At least 5 years of experience managing teams in a multi-site or international environment — ideally leading smaller, agile teams rather than large ones.
Experience managing a help desk or end-user support function, directly or through a direct-report manager.
PMP certification or an equivalent designation in project or program management.
Extensive experience in a discrete or process manufacturing environment. Previous experience in an engineering company is considered a strong plus.
Strong command of data governance, data lake infrastructure, Microsoft Fabric, BI platforms such as Power BI, and SQL.
Working familiarity with collaboration/file-management platforms (Egnyte, Box, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Admin Center) and identity management (Azure AD, Beyond Identity).
Working knowledge of network/communications infrastructure (Ubiquiti, 3CX); Linux experience preferred.
French/English bilingualism, both spoken and written.
Demonstrated experience managing external vendors, systems integrators and implementation partners.

Considered assets

CISSP, CISM, or other recognized cybersecurity certification
EPICOR/Kinetic certification
CDMP certification or equivalent
Experience with enterprise artificial intelligence platforms, services or deployment frameworks
ITIL v4, CBAP, Lean Six Sigma or other relevant professional certification
Experience in the defense or aerospace manufacturing sectors
Previous experience working within an engineering company or engineering-driven organization
Knowledge of the BOARD EPM platform
Knowledge of MES and/or PLM systems

WHY JOIN E2IP TECHNOLOGIES

Shape a real transformation: you will play a decisive role in modernizing the processes, systems and data that support the organization's operations.
Lead with security: you will build and own the cybersecurity foundation that protects our people, our data, and our intellectual property.
Turn AI into business value: you will identify and deploy concrete use cases in artificial intelligence, advanced analytics and automation to improve productivity, quality, planning and decision-making.
Build a function in your own image: you will have the opportunity to structure a growing team, define strong governance practices and establish a PMO suited to the company's real needs.
Have direct influence with leadership: you will work with the executive team, plant directors, R&D teams and international partners on strategic priorities.
Work in an international, multi-site context: you will help harmonize ways of working and create scalable technology capabilities across Canada, Morocco and New Jersey.
Leave a lasting mark: the foundations you put in place for cybersecurity, ERP, data, AI, automation, governance and project delivery will support E2IP Technologies' competitiveness and growth for years to come.

jobs.title: Head of Digital Product & Experience, Tim Hortons, Canada
jobs.description:
Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

The Head of Digital Product & Experience is responsible for leading Product, Design, and Product Analytics for Tim Hortons’ owned digital guest experiences across Mobile App, Web, Catering, and connected delivery experiences, including product capabilities that leverage AI/ML for personalization, optimization, and improved guest experiences.

This leader oversees product and experience teams aligned to core digital commerce and engagement capabilities while partnering closely with Engineering, Restaurant Technology, Marketing, Loyalty/CRM, Operations, and Support to deliver scalable, modern, and high-performing digital experiences.

The ideal candidate combines deep product management expertise, strong product operating discipline, design fluency, analytical rigor, technical fluency, and modern AI-enabled product development practices. This role requires a leader who can create clarity across complex cross-functional environments, translate strategy into disciplined product execution, and drive measurable guest and business outcomes through strong prioritization, product discovery, experience direction, analytics, and roadmap ownership.

This role is best suited for a high-ownership leader who thrives in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. The successful candidate will bring urgency, resilience, and a strong bias for action, while leading with curiosity, humility, and respect for existing context. They should be able to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels, build trust across teams, and help shape, hire, and develop the Product and Experience organization as it scales.

This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for shaping the future of one of Canada’s largest and most engaged digital restaurant ecosystems.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy, Roadmap & Prioritization

Define and evolve the product vision, strategic roadmap, and prioritization framework across Tim Hortons’ owned digital experiences.
Lead product investment decisions across multiple domains, balancing guest experience, business priorities, operational realities, analytics, and technical scalability.
Translate guest insights, analytics, operational feedback, and market trends into clear product strategies and actionable roadmaps.
Ensure digital product investments align to long-term platform evolution and measurable business outcomes.
Own product discovery, problem definition, requirements clarity, and success metrics so initiatives are well-defined, validated, prioritized, and ready for effective cross-functional execution.
Partner with Engineering to understand platform health, technical dependencies, and infrastructure investments that impact product capability, delivery velocity, reliability, or guest experience, ensuring these tradeoffs are reflected in roadmap and prioritization discussions.

Product, Experience & Analytics Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop teams across Product, Design, and Product Analytics, ensuring these capabilities operate as an integrated Product and Experience organization.
Build clear accountability, strong business judgment, customer obsession, and consistent product standards across the team.
Bring a clear point of view on team structure, role design, and hiring priorities to support stronger execution, clearer ownership, and long-term scalability.
Coach and develop product and experience talent, strengthening craft, ownership, and disciplined execution.
Lean in directly where needed to support product strategy, experience direction, analytics interpretation, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, or cross-functional decision-making.

Product Execution, Guest Experience & Measurement

Own product-side execution from strategy through launch and optimization, ensuring initiatives are clearly defined, prioritized, designed, measured, and ready for effective delivery.
Lead cohesive digital guest experiences across app, web, catering, delivery, restaurant-connected journeys, and other digital touchpoints.
Ensure Product and Design decisions are grounded in guest insights, business context, analytics, operational realities, and clear success metrics.
Advance design craft, consistency, and execution quality across guest-facing digital experiences.
Bring Product Analytics closer to product strategy, prioritization, experimentation, and performance management so decisions are grounded in guest behavior, funnel performance, and measurable outcomes.
Own measurable digital product outcomes including engagement, conversion, ordering performance, payment performance, loyalty engagement, adoption, retention, guest satisfaction, and digital sales contribution.

AI-Enabled Product & Engineering Partnership

Partner closely with Engineering and data/ML teams to translate AI/ML-enabled opportunities into scalable product capabilities and measurable guest or business impact.
Champion modern product management practices including experimentation, rapid iteration, AI-assisted workflows, and data-informed decision making.
Support build-versus-buy evaluations for AI-enabled product tools, personalization platforms, experimentation capabilities, and digital experience workflows.
Partner with Engineering on solution shaping, feasibility, planning, quality, and release readiness, while maintaining clear accountability for product outcomes and guest experience.
Ensure Product, Design, and Analytics provide the clarity, inputs, and decision-making needed to support efficient, high-quality cross-functional delivery.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Business Performance

Collaborate with Restaurant Technology, Marketing, Loyalty/CRM, Operations, Support, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to align digital product decisions with business goals and operational realities.
Drive alignment across complex cross-functional initiatives while ensuring Product brings clarity to problem definition, prioritization, customer outcomes, requirements, experience direction, success metrics, and launch readiness.
Ensure product and experience decisions balance guest value, business impact, operational feasibility, scalability, technical sustainability, and restaurant owner impact.
Create communication routines that provide visibility into roadmap progress, tradeoffs, risks, and performance outcomes.
Build trust across the Product and Experience organization and with cross-functional partners through curiosity, transparency, follow-through, and respect for existing context.

Qualifications

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Product Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Analytics, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in Product Management, Digital Product, Digital Experience, Product Strategy, or Technology Strategy roles.
5+ years of experience leading product managers, design teams, product analytics teams, or cross-functional digital product organizations.
Proven track record leading consumer-facing mobile app, commerce, loyalty, ordering, marketplace, restaurant, retail, or digital ecosystem product teams.
Strong product management fundamentals including prioritization, roadmap management, discovery, experimentation, stakeholder alignment, requirements clarity, and agile delivery practices.
Strong design and analytical fluency, with the ability to evaluate guest experience strategy, UX quality, research inputs, funnel performance, experimentation, and product measurement.
Strong technical fluency and comfort partnering closely with Engineering organizations on platform capabilities, integrations, APIs, architecture considerations, data/ML capabilities, and technical tradeoffs.
Proven ability to establish product standards, coach talent, hire strong leaders, and improve execution across cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, scaling, or evolving environments.
Strong communication and organizational leadership skills with the ability to simplify complex problems for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Competencies

Experience leading large-scale mobile app, digital commerce, restaurant, retail, loyalty, delivery, marketplace, or omnichannel digital ecosystems.
Experience leading or closely partnering with Design, UX Research, Content Design, Product Analytics, or AI-enabled product functions.
Experience in franchise, QSR, retail, or other environments where digital product decisions have direct operational and commercial consequences for operators, as well as end consumers.
Experience balancing guest experience strategy with operational and business realities in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
Experience partnering with Engineering teams to improve planning quality, design readiness, analytics enablement, and delivery outcomes.

Leadership Characteristics

Guest-obsessed and operationally pragmatic
Product-led, experience-oriented, and analytically grounded
High-ownership leader with strong bias for action
Comfortable with pace, ambiguity, and high expectations
Hands-on when needed, while still building scalable teams, routines, and ownership

Interim Chief Information Security Officer

Reports to Chief Information Officer

Our client, a leading academic institution, is making a significant investment in information security through the creation of a new Chief Information Security Officer position reporting to the CIO. This is an exceptional opportunity for a seasoned security leader to provide both strategic advice and operational leadership while building and strengthening this critical function. Working across the institution, the CISO will define the strategy, governance, policies and capabilities required to deepen and broaden information security, protect data and effectively manage evolving cyber risks. This is a highly purposeful mandate for someone who has built or transformed a security function before and wants to make a lasting impact within an important Canadian institution.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategy and Governance Oversee institution-wide security resources and advise on policy, legislation, regulation, and technology.
Lead security policies and practices that protect data and ensure compliance.
Manage regulatory compliance, including Ontario’s Enhancing Digital Security and Trust Act (2024), required contacts, biennial assessments, incident reporting, and executive and Board updates.
Assess AI-related threats, defenses, adoption risks, phishing, agentic attacks, and third-party data leakage.
Embed security controls in AI governance with the future Office of AI and key stakeholders.
Maintain cyber insurance eligibility and advise on coverage and risk transfer.
Support cloud adoption through risk-based vendor assessments and shared-responsibility guidance.
Risk Management and Compliance Assess security controls and advise executives on improvements.
Identify security risks and monitor compliance with standards and policies.
Lead third-party risk management, including HECVAT reviews, SOC 2 Type II attestations, cloud assessments, and shared-responsibility guidance.
Coordinate and track security audits, findings, timelines, and outcomes.
Align records retention and data disposal with policy, legislation, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements.

2. Security Operations and Technology
Implement technical standards, services, and tools that reduce cyber risk.
Coordinate vulnerability assessments and promote effective security practices.
Lead response and communications for suspected and confirmed incidents.
Maintain incident response protocols and conduct regular tabletop exercises.
Maintain continuity, succession, and cross-training plans for disrupted operations.

Maintain metrics for maturity, insurance, third-party ratings, vulnerabilities, and training completion.

Report training completion and remediation plans to executives and the Board.
Track higher-education security issues and consult governments and industry partners.
Support cybersecurity-related academic programs as needed.
External Partnerships and Collaboration Represent the organization in multi-agency threat-sharing, incident planning, and tabletop exercises.
Partner with Privacy, Legal, Communications, and academic leaders on security matters.
People Leadership Lead, coach, and develop IT security staff within a client-focused culture.
Oversee service quality, efficiency, stakeholder engagement, and SLAs.
Build recruitment and retention plans that strengthen business and technical capability.
Duties may change based on organizational needs and CIO direction.

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:
Expert knowledge of NIST, ISACA, CIS Controls, and applicable legislation, including Ontario’s Enhancing Digital Security and Trust Act, FIPPA, PIPEDA, and PHIPA.
Strong understanding of AI-enabled threats, defensive tools, vendor capabilities, and institutional AI risk.
Knowledge of nation-state threats and geopolitical risks affecting Canadian post-secondary institutions.
Expertise in network, endpoint, cloud, identity, vulnerability, and incident response security.
Proven ability to develop cybersecurity strategy, assess risk, prioritize threats, and implement mitigation plans.
Strong leadership, change management, negotiation, influencing, and decision-making skills.
Experience leading teams, projects, budgets, workforce planning, and service delivery.
Excellent communication skills, including executive and Board-level reports and policies.
Ability to perform effectively under ambiguity and pressure.
Proven vendor, contractor, and third-party negotiation skills.
Results-oriented and financially astute, with strong fiduciary judgment.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
A master’s degree in information security, or other related field plus equivalent training and experience.
Information security management qualifications such as CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), or CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).
Minimum 10 years’ progressively responsible experience in computing and information security, network security issues, and security incident response or related information technology fields, preferably in a higher education or equivalent complex environment.
Minimum 5 years of experience in senior leadership and people management.
Experience developing and administering an IS program and IS policy and regulations in a complex environment.

jobs.description:
ABOUT PANOPLY

Panoply Media is a digital-native, 360° media buying agency driven by a simple philosophy: Inspire. Engage. Repeat. We specialize in delivering media innovation for ambitious brands, harnessing consumer-centric insights and actionable market trends to amplify voices across all channels—from TV, Radio, and OOH to Digital, CTV, and beyond. With a diverse client portfolio spanning Education, Government, Entertainment, Pharmaceutical, Travel & Transportation, CPG, Finance, and Home Restoration, we create data-driven storytelling that resonates.

OUR VALUES

Passion for the Industry:
We live and breathe media. Our team is driven by genuine enthusiasm for creating campaigns that make an impact.

Client-Centric Excellence:
We're committed to providing the best campaigns and experiences to our clients, ensuring every touchpoint is strategically crafted.

Innovation & Adaptability:
As digital natives and 360° media thinkers, we embrace emerging channels and technologies to stay ahead of the curve.

Collaborative Partnership:
We work hand-in-hand with creative agencies and clients to build campaigns collaboratively, amplifying brand voices across all channels.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced Director of Digital Media Operations & Performance to lead our execution team, which spans both execution and data. This role sits at the intersection of campaign execution, measurement, reporting, technology and operational excellence.
You will establish the processes, quality standards and technical practices that help campaigns launch accurately, dashboards remain reliable and the agency scale efficiently. You will work closely with Strategy, Client Services, Creative and agency leadership.

STRATEGIC PILLARS

1. Operational Excellence & Platform Mastery:
Lead end-to-end campaign setup, activation and optimization across Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, Display, Video, Audio and emerging platforms.
2. Data, Tracking & Performance:
Own the dashboard and reporting offering; maintain GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, conversion tracking and attribution best practices.
3. Growth & Leadership:
Build, coach and grow the execution team while evaluating technology partners and automation opportunities with the VP.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead and develop the execution team (spanning campaign activation and data) across Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, Display, Video, Audio and emerging platforms.
Oversee day-to-day pacing, optimization and issue resolution to keep every campaign on track against its KPIs.
Establish and maintain SOPs, launch standards, naming conventions and platform governance so every campaign goes live accurately, on time and on brief.
Manage live negotiations, contract development and partner follow-up across media opportunities from research through execution.
Partner with the VP of Operations to lead the agency's dashboard and reporting offering; continuously improve it based on client and internal-team usage.
Ensure the dashboards and reports we hand off to clients are accurate, consistent and useful.
Translate campaign data into clear insights and actionable recommendations, and identify opportunities to automate reporting workflows.
Oversee tracking, measurement and data integrity across campaigns, websites and digital platforms including GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, conversion tracking, attribution and troubleshooting discrepancies.
Build, coach and develop the execution team: set clear expectations, drive accountability, support hiring, onboarding and resource planning, and grow a culture of collaboration, accuracy and continuous learning.
Partner with the VP of Operations to identify and evaluate technology, automation and platform opportunities: research, define use cases, lead pilots, present business cases and drive adoption of approved tools.
Manage vendor and platform partner relationships; maintain relationships with platform representatives and technology partners.
Work cross-functionally with Strategy, Client Services and Creative to ensure media plans are practical, measurable and executable; present performance insights and contribute technical expertise on pitches, proposals and client presentations.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

8–12+ years of experience in digital media operations, ad operations, performance marketing, analytics or marketing technology
Leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams; agency experience is strongly preferred
Strong knowledge of paid search, paid social, programmatic and digital media platforms
Experience with campaign tracking, GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, conversion measurement and attribution
Experience with dashboard and visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker Studio or Power BI
Experience developing processes, quality standards and operational documentation
Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem-solving
Strong communication, client-management and presentation skills
Bilingualism in French and English is preferred

WHAT WE OFFER

Hybrid work model (2-3 days in Montreal office)
Comprehensive benefits package after 3 months
Direct access to senior leadership
Ability to work from abroad
Diverse clients and evolving digital challenges

jobs.description:
Cyclic Materials™ is building a resilient circular supply chain for rare earth elements and other critical materials. Our proprietary two-phase process unlocks value from end-of-life products by efficiently recycling rare earths back to a high-purity form. Cyclic Materials offers a scalable, rapid and resource-efficient solution to complement traditional mining in creating supply of rare earths. These materials are critical to the modern economy, including the production of electric vehicles, electronics, AI infrastructure, wind turbines, defense, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

Founded in 2021, Cyclic Materials has rapidly progressed from technology development to commercialization. We currently operate facilities in Ontario and Arizona, with a new expansion underway in South Carolina. Backed by US$75 million in Series C financing led by T. Rowe Price, alongside strategic investors including Microsoft, Amazon, Hitachi Ventures, BMW i Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion fund, Energy Impact Partners, ArcTern Ventures, and Fifth Wall, we are scaling to meet growing global demand for a secure and sustainable rare earth supply.

We are growing quickly and building the industrial backbone required for a circular rare earth economy. Joining Cyclic Materials means working on complex and exciting challenges at scale, alongside a team committed to executing and delivering measurable impact. If you are motivated by building critical infrastructure and advancing the circular economy, join us and help accelerate the growth of rare earth recycling.

The Position:

This is not a traditional FP&A role.

You will work directly with the VP, Strategy & FP&A and regularly support the CFO, executive leadership team, Board of Directors, investors and external advisors. Your models will influence hundreds of millions—and ultimately billions—of dollars in capital allocation decisions.

Enterprise Financial Modelling

Own and continuously improve the Company's fully integrated corporate financial model
Develop sophisticated three-statement operating models supporting executive decision-making
Build scenario analyses covering growth strategies, financing alternatives and capital allocation
Create long-range strategic planning models extending five to ten years
Produce highly reliable forecasting models with institutional-quality documentation and controls

Prepare investor-quality valuation analyses, sensitivity analyses and return models

Support Board materials and investment committee presentations

Build and maintain project finance models for multiple North American and European facilities
Develop debt sizing, covenant compliance and lender reporting models
Evaluate government incentive programs, grants and tax credit opportunities
Model manufacturing economics across multiple technologies and jurisdictions
Support financing discussions with banks, infrastructure funds and institutional lenders

Executive Decision Support

Deliver high-quality analyses directly to executive leadership under tight timelines
Translate complex financial scenarios into concise strategic recommendations
Identify key business drivers, risks and opportunities
Challenge assumptions through rigorous analytical thinking
Provide financial support for major commercial and strategic initiatives

Financial Planning & Analysis

Support annual planning, forecasting and long-range planning processes
Develop KPI dashboards and operational performance models
Improve forecasting accuracy through enhanced analytical techniques
Partner closely with Accounting to ensure model integrity and consistency
Support monthly executive reporting and Board reporting

Process Excellence

Establish best-in-class financial modelling standards
Create model governance, version control and documentation practices
Improve automation and analytical efficiency
Maintain rigorous quality control over all financial outputs
Ensure models are scalable as the business continues global expansion

3–5 years of financial modelling experience within one or more of Investment Banking (ECM, M&A or Industrials); Equity Capital Markets; Late-stage venture capital; Private equity; Infrastructure investing; and Project finance
Demonstrated experience building sophisticated institutional-quality financial models
Experience supporting capital raises, strategic transactions or major investments
Advanced Microsoft Excel expertise (expert-level modelling skills)

Preferred

US GAAP financial modelling

Experience working with executive leadership and Boards

You are known as the person whose models everyone trusts.

Job Title: Associate Director, Supply Chain Planning

Location: Hamilton, Ontario

Onsite 5 days/week

Description

Fusion Pharmaceuticals, part of the AstraZeneca Group, is redefining precision oncology with next‑generation radioconjugates that deliver powerful alpha‑emitting payloads directly to tumors. Our pipeline spans multiple first‑in‑class programs—backed by a GMP‑compliant, brand new radiopharmaceutical facility in Hamilton, we’re turning groundbreaking science into real‑world impact for patients. Join us at the forefront of radiopharma innovation and be part of turning breakthrough science into meaningful outcomes for patients—come build what’s next with us!

The Role

We are seeking a strategic and analytical Associate Director of Supply Chain Planning to lead clinical supply forecast planning and drive cross-functional alignment. In this vital leadership role, you will be the linchpin for global clinical supply visibility, translating complex clinical trial protocols and enrollment forecasts into executable supply plans. You will direct the Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) processes. You will focus on identifying risks early and serve as the main contact for supply chain health with collaborators inside and outside the company.

Responsibilities

Host recurring Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) meetings to align cross-functional partners.
Lead the systematic collection and consolidation of clinical trial drug demand from multiple studies, translating Phase 1–3 clinical trial protocols and enrollment forecasts into executable supply plans.
Develop and deliver high-level Demand and Supply reports, collaborate cross-functionally to define and implement long-range and short-range supply strategies.
Proactively identify and communicate supply chain risks, establishing early-warning indicators for potential bottlenecks, shortages, or timeline shifts, and driving risk mitigation strategies.
Ensure internal and external manufacturing alignment with evolving S&OP demand forecasts and scheduling requirements.
Support annual budgeting process and monitor financial forecasts.
Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions for core departmental processes and supply activities to ensure GxP compliance and consistency.
Plan and oversee patient doses and overall manufacturing operations.
Participate in ongoing optimization of planning workflows, system enhancements, and change control assessments.
Perform other related operational duties as required by the business.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Life Sciences, or Finance. A Master’s degree or MBA is highly preferred.
8+ years of experience in production planning, scheduling, or supply chain experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or clinical research sectors.
Expert-level capability in analyzing complex datasets, modeling supply scenarios, and presenting risk/demand forecasts to executive partners.
Strong command of ERP/MRP systems(e.g. SAP or specialized clinical supply management systems like Perceptive RTSM) and advanced data management tools (e.g. Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, and workflow automation tools).
Familiarity with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and Standard Operating Procedures within a regulated manufacturing environment.
Outstanding ability to synthesize complex clinical data into clear, proactive risk communications for both technical and non-technical partners.
Able to work flexible hours to accommodate global time zones as needed.

Desirable

Familiarity with clinical trial phases (Phase I–III), blinding/randomization concepts, and the strict timelines required for patient-specific dosing.
Proven experience in cell therapy or radiopharmaceutical supply chain operations is a plus.
Familiarity with Global clinical distribution networks, import/export regulations, and short shelf-life material logistics.
Experience leading change control assessments, deviation investigations, or CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions) workflows within a GxP environment.

jobs.title: VP Enterprise Marketing
jobs.description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.

We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you'll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

Build Mentimeter's enterprise growth engine

40 million users have experienced the value of using a Menti!

Building on that product-led foundation, Mentimeter is used daily by more than 84.000 organisations globally across all industries and we now serve more than 3,200 Enterprise customers globally. Our next challenge is to increase a systematic enterprise demand growth engine - and we are looking for a VP Enterprise Marketing to lead that journey.

This is a global leadership role responsible for how Mentimeter creates, identifies and converts enterprise demand. You will lead our Enterprise Marketing organisation, report to our Chief Sales Officer and join Mentimeter's Global Enterprise Leadership Team. Your primary focus will be EMEA and North America, while building the foundations for APAC. The goal is to connect our product adoption, organic reach and customer base into an Enterprise qualified pipeline, ARR and customer growth.

What You'll Lead

You will lead three existing teams, each with an experienced leader, across three connected areas:

Digital demand

Build and optimize enterprise demand generation and capture across web, paid media, account-based programs, content distribution, conversion and nurture.

Field and customer marketing

Develop a global strategy across events, partner programs, customer advocacy, regional activation and use-case storytelling - measured by account engagement, adoption, pipeline and expansion, not simply attendance.

Executive Exchange

Build Mentimeter's Executive Exchange into a distinctive platform for strategic customers, including our Enterprise Community, executive networks, education and certification programs.

What you'll own

Define and own Mentimeter's global Enterprise Marketing strategy, budget and operating model.
Build an integrated system for demand generation and demand capture that turns our PLG footprint and product signals into account-level pipeline.
Set priorities across segments, accounts, audiences, buying groups, use cases and regions, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
Create qualified pipeline and measurable Enterprise ARR impact, with clear accountability for conversion, velocity, attribution and ROI.
Recruit, coach and develop leaders and senior marketing talent, creating an organisation that performs beyond your direct involvement.
Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Growth, Brand, Data and regional leadership to strengthen the handover from product-led growth to sales-assisted opportunities.
Stop, redesign or reallocate investment away from programs that do not create meaningful customer or commercial impact.

What Will Help You Succeed

You are an experienced B2B marketing leader who combines strategic range with commercial discipline. You are likely to bring:

12+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including significant leadership experience in Enterprise Marketing, Demand Generation, Integrated Marketing or a closely related area.
Experience leading leaders and multidisciplinary teams across digital demand, field marketing, customer marketing or executive programs.
A strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys, account-based marketing, buying groups, demand capture and pipeline creation in a PLG environment.
Experience connecting product-led or high-volume inbound growth with a sales-assisted enterprise motion.
Commercial fluency across funnel economics, pipeline, conversion, attribution, investment and ROI.
Experience operating across EMEA and/or North America and adapting global programs to local markets.
An AI-native approach to marketing: using AI to improve insight, experimentation, personalisation and performance - not only individual productivity.

The kind of leader who will thrive here

You create clarity where ownership is shared and the answer is not obvious. You set a high bar while building trust, develop leaders and give talented people meaningful ownership. Most importantly, you want to build - not simply inherit and administer - a modern Enterprise Marketing function, see the strategy through and be accountable for its long-term impact. You are ambitious while staying humble, curious and collaborative in how you get there.

Why this role

You will have the mandate to shape how Mentimeter approaches enterprise demand globally and define the next chapter of our Enterprise growth. If you are looking for a finished playbook, this probably is not the role for you. If you want to build the system and be accountable for its impact, we would like to hear from you.

We're actively hiring for one position, which can be based in either Stockholm or Toronto. The role follows our hybrid way of working.

How we lead at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we have a Leadership Manifesto that sets a shared direction for how we lead ourselves, our teams and the business. We call it Heart & Bravery.

It starts with authenticity: knowing yourself, showing yourself and leading yourself.

We expect our leaders to develop high-performing teams through both care and challenge, drive the right results in a changing environment, and set a clear direction by connecting the work to our vision and making the complex simple.

You will learn more about our Leadership Manifesto throughout the recruitment process. These principles are also an important part of how we assess and hire leaders at Mentimeter.

Our recruitment process

We want the process to be transparent and give both you and us the opportunity to get to know each other properly. The steps are:

TA Intro Interview

Hiring Manager Interview:
A 20-minute digital chat with our Chief Sales Officer to meet and learn more about the role
Business Case & Competence Interview

A short business case, submitted the day before the competence interview
Competence interview: 75-minute at our office

Leadership and culture interview:
90-minute at our office
References and a coffee chat
with the team
Offer and signing

Compensation:

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The annual base salary range for this role is $226,000–$303,000 CAD. It's intentionally broad to reflect different stages of growth within the role: from growing into its full scope to bringing deep expertise and meaningful impact from day one.

Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role's requirements. We're committed to supporting your growth. You'll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your compensation will be reviewed as your skills, scope and impact evolve.

In addition to your salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package - learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/toronto .

What Mentimeter Can Offer

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It's not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.

AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.

AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we're not building an AI-driven hiring process - we're building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.

Culture at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.

Location:
Greater Toronto Area
Work Environment:
On-site

Third-Party Logistics (3PL) / Transportation / Distribution

The Opportunity
Our client, an established and growing third-party logistics organization in the Greater Toronto Area, is looking for an experienced Director of Finance
to join its leadership team.
This is a hands-on senior finance position for someone who enjoys being close to the business. In addition to leading the accounting and finance function, the Director of Finance will work closely with operations, transportation, sales, and senior leadership to improve financial performance, strengthen reporting, and provide greater visibility into costs and profitability.
The successful candidate will bring strong financial leadership along with an understanding of the operational side of a logistics, transportation, or distribution business.

Key Responsibilities
Financial Leadership & Reporting
Lead the day-to-day accounting and finance function and provide direction to the finance team.
Oversee financial reporting, general ledger activities, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and period-end closing.
Deliver timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
Lead the budgeting and forecasting process and maintain ongoing cash flow projections.
Analyze business performance, operating expenses, customer profitability, and gross margins.
Provide senior leadership with meaningful financial analysis to support business decisions.
Maintain appropriate financial controls, policies, and processes.
Manage relationships with external auditors, financial institutions, tax professionals, and other external partners.

Commercial Finance & Profitability
Work closely with operational and commercial teams to understand the financial performance of customers, lanes, services, and contracts.
Provide financial oversight related to transportation costs, pricing, and margin performance.
Review costing information and identify areas where profitability can be improved.
Support pricing decisions, customer proposals, bids, and contract renewals.
Develop reporting that provides greater visibility into customer and operational profitability.
Help establish consistent processes for reviewing pricing, costs, and margins.

Business & Operational Partnership
Partner with Operations and Transportation leaders to ensure financial information accurately reflects business activity.
Provide financial guidance on operational decisions, service costs, and customer requirements.
Work with Sales on the financial components of new business opportunities and customer agreements.
Develop and monitor KPIs related to financial and operational performance.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate financial data into practical recommendations for the leadership team.

Payroll, Compliance & Risk
Provide oversight of payroll administration and related reporting requirements.
Ensure appropriate remittances, tax filings, and regulatory requirements are completed accurately and on time.
Maintain strong financial documentation and ensure the organization remains audit-ready.
Monitor areas of financial and operational risk and ensure appropriate controls are in place.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement
Coach, develop, and support members of the finance team.
Evaluate existing financial processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and reporting.
Support improvements to accounting, transportation, and business systems.
Participate in system implementations and integrations, with a focus on data integrity and effective financial reporting.
Introduce tools, reporting, and automation that provide leadership with better and faster business information.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline.
CPA designation strongly preferred.

Progressive experience in accounting and financial leadership within 3PL, transportation, logistics, distribution, or a similar operational environment
.
Strong understanding of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, and internal controls.
Experience analyzing costing, margins, pricing, and profitability
within an operational business.
Previous experience leading and developing a finance or accounting team.
Strong Excel skills and experience working with accounting and ERP systems.
Exposure to transportation management systems (TMS) or other logistics technology is considered an asset.
Experience supporting system implementations, integrations, or finance process improvements is an asset.
Strong analytical, leadership, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.

The Ideal Candidate
You are a finance leader who wants to understand why the numbers look the way they do
, not simply report them.

You are comfortable moving between financial statements and operational conversations and can work collaboratively with Operations, Sales, and senior leadership. You understand the importance of costing and margin visibility in a high-volume logistics environment and can turn financial information into practical business decisions.

This opportunity is well suited to someone who has built their career within a 3PL, transportation, logistics, distribution, or similarly fast-paced operational business
and is looking for a role where Finance has a meaningful seat at the table.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, CRO & Analytics based in Canada.

This role leads a conversion rate optimization practice with a strong focus on data, experimentation, and behavioral science.

You will translate quantitative and qualitative insights into revenue-driving improvements across Shopify ecommerce experiences.

The position combines client strategy, analytics, statistical modeling, experimentation, personalization, and performance reporting.

You will work with DTC and omnichannel brands, partnering closely with UX, Design, Development, and other specialists.

A major focus is building reliable analytics foundations and turning funnel, cohort, and segmentation data into actionable priorities.

You will also help evolve CRO through AI-enabled experimentation and real-time personalization.

The role offers broad ownership across strategy, execution, client relationships, and the continuous improvement of CRO practices.

Accountabilities

As Director, CRO & Analytics, you will own strategic CRO engagements and the analytics backbone supporting experimentation, optimization, and measurable business outcomes.

Lead strategic CRO engagements for ecommerce brands, including discovery, ongoing retainers, and consulting initiatives.
Serve as a data-driven strategy partner across site experience, merchandising, acquisition, retention, analytics, UX, and digital product roadmaps.
Develop strategies aligned with short- and long-term business objectives using funnel and cohort analysis.
Identify optimization opportunities across the customer journey, from landing pages and product pages through checkout and post-purchase experiences.
Develop data-backed hypotheses and prioritized testing roadmaps in collaboration with UX, Design, and Development teams.
Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate experiments using appropriate statistical methods, including sample size, significance, and power calculations.
Monitor test and site performance, identify data anomalies, and continuously refine recommendations.
Lead the evolution toward AI-enabled experimentation and real-time personalization using behavioral and transactional data.
Apply AI throughout the experimentation lifecycle to improve insight generation, test design, velocity, and performance analysis.
Own monthly client analytics reporting covering traffic, conversion, revenue, channel mix, and experiment results, with prioritized recommendations.
Oversee analytics implementation and data integrity, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify Customer Events and pixels, consent mode, bot and spam filtering, and reconciliation with Shopify order data.
Build automated BI dashboards that visualize conversion trends, test impact, and revenue attribution for client leadership.
Conduct funnel, cohort, segmentation, statistical, ROI, revenue growth, and customer lifetime value analyses.
Combine quantitative analysis with qualitative research such as user testing, surveys, interviews, persona development, journey mapping, and competitive or heuristic audits.
Translate complex, multi-source data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations.
Perform final quality assurance on analytics and CRO deliverables and oversee CRO contractors and vendors.
Maintain the central CRO task board and support delivery coordination.
Collaborate with UX, Design, and Technical Delivery teams across new site builds, migrations, redesigns, feature launches, optimization, and maintenance.
Contribute to internal CRO, UX, and ecommerce best practices, frameworks, and thought leadership.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is a data-first CRO leader who combines advanced ecommerce analytics and experimentation expertise with strong client leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, UX, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus, or equivalent professional experience.
Proven experience leading CRO initiatives as a data-driven practice, mentoring team members, guiding cross-functional teams, and owning client strategy from discovery through execution.
Advanced ecommerce analytics expertise with the ability to turn raw data into clear insights and prioritized, revenue-focused actions.
Hands-on experience with statistical modeling for web experimentation, including hypothesis testing, sample size calculations, significance testing, and segmentation.
Experience with A/B testing and experimentation platforms such as Intelligems, VWO, Optimizely, Shoplift, Visually, or similar tools.
Advanced hands-on proficiency with Google Analytics 4, including custom reporting, funnel analysis, and segmentation.
Experience building prioritized and resourced testing roadmaps based on quantitative impact estimates.
Experience with the Shopify platform.
Experience partnering with UX, Design, and Development teams to bring insights and experiments into execution.
Experience conducting UX analysis, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain data and statistical findings to both clients and internal stakeholders.
Strong organizational and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to manage multiple client engagements in a fast-paced environment.
Prior agency experience supporting multiple brands and workstreams is preferred.
Experience with Klaviyo or other email and retention platforms is an advantage.
Understanding of paid social and paid search, including how traffic quality and acquisition data can affect experiment reliability, is preferred.
Working proficiency with BigQuery and SQL for independent, ad hoc analysis is a plus.

Benefits

Opportunity to lead a specialized CRO and analytics practice across multiple ecommerce brands.
Broad ownership spanning analytics, experimentation, AI-enabled optimization, client strategy, and business impact.
Exposure to DTC and omnichannel ecommerce environments and complex Shopify experiences.
Collaboration with UX, Design, Development, and Technical Delivery specialists.
Opportunity to work with modern analytics, experimentation, BI, and AI-driven optimization tools.

Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

KPMG Corporate Finance Inc. is the Ontario Securities Commission (OSC)-regulated entity through which KPMG LLP provides investment banking services in Canada. KPMG Corporate Finance services are principally comprised of merger, acquisition and divestiture services and financing services, including raising debt and equity capital. We offer independent financial advisory and investment banking services to both private and public companies.

With over 100 professionals across Canada and a global network of 3,000+ bankers in 160 offices, we combine local execution expertise with global reach. KPMG Corporate Finance is consistently ranked the #1 mid-market investment bank in Canada.

Our growing diversified investment banking team is seeking an Associate Vice President (Manager) to join our team in Calgary, Edmonton or Winnipeg to play a key role across all aspects of transaction delivery.

Manage, mentor and train junior corporate finance professionals (Analysts & Associates).

Assist in the identification of potential acquisition targets, purchasers and/or investors.
Undertake engagement and practice management responsibilities, including billings and adherence to professional practice requirements.

Likewise, employees need time to devote to personal matters, and our approach to flexibility provides for this.

An undergraduate degree in finance, commerce, business, accounting, economics or other related field.
4-6 years of relevant post-graduate experience, in Corporate Finance, or a related field e.g. transaction advisory, investment banking, private equity, or corporate development.
Proven track record of M&A transaction initiation/execution in a fast-paced professional setting – as exhibited by your deal credential list which should accompany your cover letter.

Strong technical finance proficiency, including knowledge of financial statements and general accounting principles.
