jobs.title: AI-Augmented Full-Stack Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description:
About the Role: Where Your Engineering Actually Ships

The AI-Augmented Full-Stack Engineer is a senior individual contributor
position within Citi's Banking Technology organization. This team builds and
maintains the applications and platforms that put real capital to work for clients across one of the world's largest financial institutions.

This is a hands-on engineering
role. You will design, develop, and ship full-stack solutions
while helping shape how the team builds software - embedding AI into the engineering craft as a natural and practical part of daily work, not as an afterthought.

If you are a senior engineer who writes excellent code, thinks clearly about systems, and wants to work on problems that matter - this role was written for you.

Key Responsibilities:

Full-Stack Design and Delivery: Design, develop, and deliver full-stack applications using Java and Spring Boot on the backend and Angular on the frontend, with meaningful input into technical direction and architectural decisions.
AI-Augmented Engineering Practice: Embed AI development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Codex into your daily engineering workflow as the default way of working - and actively drive that same adoption across the team. Establish shared standards for prompt engineering, code review, and quality guardrails so that AI-augmented development becomes the team's natural practice, not the exception.
Technical Leadership and Engineering Excellence: Set the technical bar for the team through thoughtful code reviews, clear architectural guidance, and hands-on problem solving. Mentor mid-level engineers not through instruction alone, but by demonstrating what excellent engineering looks like in practice every day.
Data Management and Architecture: Apply sound data design principles across both relational and NoSQL databases - Oracle and MongoDB - with a focus on data integrity, schema design, and query performance. Champion data standards that keep systems maintainable and trustworthy at scale.
Cloud-Native Engineering Mindset: Bring a strong conceptual understanding of modern cloud-native principles - infrastructure as code, containerization with Docker and OpenShift, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and engineering practices that optimize for delivery throughput and system stability. You do not need to own the pipes, but you need to think about them.
Engineering Judgement and Accountability: Make decisions with the full picture in mind - technical quality, business impact, security, and regulatory context. Bring the kind of professional judgement that earns trust with stakeholders and keeps the team building with confidence.

What You Bring

Experience And Qualifications

6+ of software engineering experience, with meaningful time in a senior, lead, or principal capacity on complex, enterprise-grade systems
Experience delivering software in a financial service, fintech, or similarly regulated, high-complexity environment
Proven ability to provide technical leadership and mentor engineers in a senior individual contributor capacity
Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to engineering and business audiences alike
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Technical Skills

Backend: Strong working knowledge of Java and the Spring Framework ecosystem
Frontend: Hands-on experience with Angular. Familiarity with React or other modern frameworks is a plus
Databases: Working knowledge of both relational and NoSQL databases, including Oracle and MongoDB
AI Fluency: Practical, daily use of AI coding tools with a solid conceptual understanding of how they work - including prompt engineering, context window management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tokenization, and grounding techniques. You know enough about what is happening under the hood to use these tools with intention, not just habit
Cloud Awareness: Familiarity with cloud-native concepts - containerization, infrastructure as code, CI/CD practices, and delivery metrics such as DORA. Comfortable reasoning about system design in a cloud-native context

Preferred

Experience with Angular at production scale; React or Vue as additional frontend exposure
Exposure to agentic AI patterns, MCP, A2A workflows, or agent development frameworks such as Google ADK
Familiarity with 12-Factor App principles and microservices architecture
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

What Success Looks Like

You have personally delivered features that are in production, trusted by the business, and cited as examples of how good engineering is done here.
Stakeholders - technical and non-technical - come to you with hard problems because they trust your judgement and your ability to translate complexity into a clear, actionable direction.
The engineers around you are measurably better for working alongside you. Not because you ran workshops, but because your code, your reviews, and your approach set a standard worth following.
You have shaped how AI is used on this team - not by mandating tools, but by demonstrating what thoughtful, effective AI-augmented engineering actually looks like in practice.
Problems that previously stalled the team get solved. You are the person who unblocks things - through technical depth, clear thinking, and the confidence to make a call.

Why Join Us?

Solve Problems That Are Hard to Find Elsewhere: The systems here run at a scale and complexity that few engineering environments can match.
Own the AI Practice, Not Just Use It: You will define how this team adopts, evaluates, and improves its use of AI - from day one.
Senior IC With Real Autonomy: High visibility, high trust, and the freedom to do serious work without a people management overhead.
An Institution That Invests in Its Engineers: Access to modern infrastructure, strong internal tooling, and a team that takes the craft seriously.

Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
Master’s degree preferred

jobs.title: Chef(fe) de l’analyse marketing / Head of Marketing Analytics
jobs.description:
Brief Description

Qui est Manmade?

Nous sommes un détaillant en ligne de produits essentiels de première qualité basé à Montréal, connu particulièrement jusqu'à présent pour nos boxer pour hommes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide depuis notre lancement en 2021, et la marque est véritablement à un tournant pour devenir un nom familier au Canada, et elle se développe déjà en parallèle sur le marché américain.

Qui recherchons-nous?

Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de l’analytique marketing
pour bâtir et diriger la fonction d’analytique marketing de Manmade.

Vous serez responsable de la façon dont nous mesurons et interprétons la performance marketing, en regroupant les données de nos différents canaux pour offrir une vision claire et fiable des facteurs qui contribuent aux résultats de l’entreprise. Une priorité sera de créer une source de référence unique et centralisée
pour la performance marketing et de mettre en place les tableaux de bord, les indicateurs clés de performance et les cadres de mesure qui guideront les décisions de nos équipes.

Il s’agit d’un poste de niveau senior avec une forte implication opérationnelle
. Vous devrez explorer les données, créer des tableaux de bord, analyser la performance et résoudre vous-même les problèmes, tout en établissant les bases d’une équipe et d’une fonction capables d’évoluer avec Manmade.

Si vous aimez transformer des données complexes en décisions d’affaires claires et souhaitez bâtir une fonction à partir de zéro, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ?

Nous nous développons rapidement, les choses changent vite et une présence en interne est nécessaire.

Ce que nous offrons?
Nous pensons qu'un travail de qualité commence par un environnement de qualité. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous bénéficierez de déjeuners quotidiens gratuits, de collations et de boissons pour vous permettre de rester en forme et concentré. Nous offrons une assurance de groupe payée à 100 %, des salaires compétitifs qui sont révisés régulièrement avec des augmentations annuelles garanties, et une structure de primes de partage des bénéfices pour que tout le monde participe à notre succès.

Nous sommes dans une phase de croissance, ce qui signifie de réelles opportunités pour vous d'apprendre, de vous développer et de faire passer votre carrière au niveau supérieur. Avant tout, vous ferez partie d'une culture amusante, innovante et respectueuse où vos idées sont valorisées et où votre impact est réel.

Responsabilités

Bâtir et prendre en charge la fonction d’analytique et de mesure marketing de Manmade, tant pour l’acquisition que pour la fidélisation de la clientèle.
Créer une source de référence unique pour la performance marketing en regroupant les données de Meta, Google, TikTok, du marketing par courriel, du marketing d’influence, de Shopify et de l’analytique Web.
Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord, des cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance et des rapports offrant aux équipes Marketing et à la direction une vision claire de la performance.
Analyser les indicateurs clés, notamment le coût d’acquisition client (CAC), la valeur vie client (LTV), le rendement des dépenses publicitaires (ROAS), le ratio d’efficacité marketing (MER), la rétention, la conversion, les cohortes de clients et la performance des canaux.
Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing et Finance pour relier les investissements et la performance marketing aux revenus, à la rentabilité par client et à une croissance rentable.
Évaluer la performance des canaux, des campagnes, des audiences et des créations publicitaires, puis traduire les résultats en recommandations claires et concrètes.
Développer l’approche de Manmade en matière d’attribution, d’incrémentalité, d’expérimentation et de mesure marketing, notamment au moyen de tests A/B, de tests géographiques et de groupes témoins.
Consolider et valider les données provenant des différentes plateformes afin de garantir l’exactitude et la fiabilité des rapports.
Mener des analyses approfondies pour répondre à des questions d’affaires complexes et repérer des occasions d’amélioration en matière d’acquisition, de fidélisation et de valeur vie client.
Mettre en place des processus, des outils et une infrastructure analytiques capables de soutenir la croissance, et définir la feuille de route de la fonction.
Maintenir une forte implication opérationnelle tout en bâtissant et en dirigeant, à terme, une équipe d’analytique marketing performante.

Éxigences

De 7 à 10 ans d’expérience progressive en analytique marketing, en analytique de croissance, en intelligence d’affaires, en analyse de données ou dans un domaine connexe.
Solide expérience en commerce électronique, en vente directe aux consommateurs (DTC), dans le secteur des produits de consommation ou au sein d’une autre entreprise numérique à forte croissance.
Expérience démontrée dans la création ou le développement d’une fonction d’analytique marketing, notamment les tableaux de bord, les cadres d’indicateurs clés de performance, les rapports et les processus de mesure.
Maîtrise avancée de SQL et d’Excel, ainsi qu’une solide expérience avec des outils d’intelligence d’affaires comme Looker, Tableau, Power BI ou des outils similaires.
Expérience avec Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok et d’autres plateformes de marketing numérique.
Compréhension approfondie du CAC, de la LTV, du ROAS, du MER, de la rétention, de la conversion, de l’analyse de cohortes, de l’attribution et de la rentabilité par client.
Expérience en expérimentation marketing et en mesure de l’incrémentalité, notamment les tests A/B, les tests géographiques et les groupes témoins.
Solide sens des affaires et capacité à relier la performance marketing aux résultats commerciaux et financiers de l’entreprise.
Capacité à définir la stratégie analytique tout en explorant personnellement les données et en développant des solutions.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à traduire des données complexes en constats clairs pour les équipes Marketing, Finance et la direction.
Une expérience dans la constitution d’équipes, le mentorat ou la gestion de professionnels en analytique est fortement souhaitée.
Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

Who is Manmade?

We’re a Montreal-based online retailer of premium quality essentials, known particularly so far for our men’s boxer briefs. We have been rapidly growing since launching in 2021, and the brand is truly at a turning point to becoming a household name in Canada, and already growing rapidly in parallel in the US market.

Who is Manmade looking for?

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing Analytics
to build and lead Manmade’s marketing analytics function.

You’ll own how we measure and understand marketing performance, bringing together data across our channels to create a clear, trusted view of what’s driving the business. A key priority will be building a unified source of truth
for marketing performance and establishing the dashboards, KPIs, and measurement frameworks our teams use to make decisions.

This is a senior but deeply hands-on role
. You’ll be expected to dig into the data, build dashboards, analyze performance, and solve problems yourself while creating the foundation for a team and function that can scale with Manmade.

If you love turning complex data into clear business decisions and want the opportunity to build something from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Is this for you?

We are growing so rapidly so things are changing so quickly and an in-house presence is required

What are we offering?
Aside from a competitive compensation package, the opportunity in itself is what you make of it. With the company growing 250%+ year over year for the past 3 years, and with expected growth to continue at a high pace for the next 2-3 years, there will be many different ways to grow within the company as it enters new markets, channels, and so on.

We offer extended health and dental benefits, 100% fully paid by the employer. We offer catered lunches every day and all the snacks, drinks, coffee, and fruit you could want.

Responsibilities

Own and build Manmade’s marketing analytics and measurement function across customer acquisition and retention.
Create a unified source of truth for marketing performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, Email, Influencer, Shopify, and web analytics.
Build and maintain dashboards, KPI frameworks, and reporting that give Marketing and leadership a clear view of performance.
Analyze key metrics including CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, customer cohorts, and channel performance.
Partner with Marketing and Finance to connect marketing investment and performance to revenue, customer economics, and profitable growth.
Evaluate channel, campaign, audience, and creative performance and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Develop Manmade’s approach to attribution, incrementality, experimentation, and marketing measurement, including A/B tests, geo studies, and holdouts.
Consolidate and validate data across platforms, ensuring reporting is accurate, reliable, and trusted.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to answer complex business questions and identify opportunities across acquisition, retention, and customer lifetime value.
Build scalable analytics processes, tools, and infrastructure, and establish the roadmap for the function as Manmade grows.
Remain deeply hands-on while eventually building and leading a high-performing marketing analytics team.

Qualifications

7–10 years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong experience in e-commerce, DTC, consumer, or another high-growth digital business.
Proven experience building or scaling a marketing analytics function, including dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting, and measurement processes.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel, with strong experience in BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Experience with Shopify, GA4, Meta, Google, TikTok, and other digital marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, retention, conversion, cohort analysis, attribution, and customer economics.
Experience with marketing experimentation and incrementality, including A/B testing, geo testing, and holdouts.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect marketing performance to broader business and financial outcomes.
Ability to operate at both levels: setting analytics strategy while personally digging into the data and building solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights for Marketing, Finance, and leadership.
Experience building, mentoring, or leading analytics talent is strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY BACKGROUND \& CULTURE
  
UPP is the first pension plan of its kind in Ontario’s university sector, proudly serving over 46,000 members across six universities and nineteen sector organizations. Our purpose is to bring greater retirement peace of mind to the university sector by investing with integrity and serving members with care. As a sector\-wide plan designed for growth, our doors are open to all Ontario universities.
  
UPP is recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2026\. Together, we’re a team of progressive thinkers and agile doers operating within a fast\-paced culture of collaboration and respect. We believe in bringing smart and capable people together to create, solve, and grow with a clear shared vision and values of integrity, inclusivity, ingenuity, and impact.
  
Our culture is intentionally welcoming and purposefully rooted in equity, diversity, inclusion, and reconciliation (EDI\&R). We believe diverse teams, perspectives, and lived experiences contribute to better decisions and a better workplace.
  
As a pension plan, UPP approaches investing through a long\-term lens to generate and safeguard value. Our commitment to investing responsibly accounts for material risks that impact our investment portfolio to generate sufficient risk\-adjusted returns to meet the pension needs of our members.
  
Join us in building a bright future for our members, our organization, and each other.
  
  

THE ROLE
  
We are seeking a forward\-looking Senior Director, Data \& Analytics to lead and evolve UPP’s enterprise data capabilities. Reporting to the Managing Director, Data and Technology, this role will work with business and technology leaders to improve how data is governed, integrated, managed and used across UPP. Its scope includes data in UPP’s enterprise data hub and across the broader cloud solutions ecosystem, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The Senior Director will help ensure data is trusted, accessible and fit for business reporting, analytics, automation and emerging AI workloads.
  
This is an opportunity for an experienced data leader to shape an important enterprise capability and help UPP make better use of its data as the organization grows.
  
This role is based in downtown Toronto under a hybrid work policy, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in\-office (two days per week in\-office).
  
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
  
SPECIFIC ACCOUNTABILITIES
  
The Senior Director, Data \& Analytics will lead and evolve UPP’s data capabilities, including the following:
  
* Develop and evolve UPP’s enterprise data strategy and practices so data is well governed, reliable, discoverable and useful across the organization.
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team responsible for data quality, data engineering, data integration, data operations and analytics enablement.
* Establish data standards and practices in partnership with business data owners, Architecture, Cybersecurity and other technology teams.
* Guide the use of cloud\-based data capabilities, including GCP, to support reliable data integration, reporting and analytics. Improve data quality, access, lineage and governance so data is ready for responsible automation and AI workloads, in partnership with the teams accountable for AI platforms, architecture, privacy and cybersecurity.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to prioritize data needs and enable trusted, data\-informed decisions. Establish the access patterns, tools, standards, training and controls that allow business users, including citizen data users, to work with data safely and at scale.
* Improve the reliability, quality, reuse and maintainability of data integration and transformation flows that support key processes, including pension data conversion, regular employer reporting, and Finance reporting and analysis.
* Leverage leading frameworks (such as DCAM) to continually mature and evolve the data strategy and frequently self\-asses the capabilities for progress
* Define and communicate data priorities, target capabilities and roadmaps, aligning plans with enterprise needs and available capacity.
* Research and establish peer connections to understand industry trends and their applicability to support data plans and strategies for the enterprise
* Explain the value of trusted data and sound data management practices to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Oversee UPP’s data catalog and related metadata practices, working with Architecture and data owners to improve data discoverability and stewardship.
* Contribute to UPP’s reputation as a respectful employer, partner, and participant in the financial sector


QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE

$150,000 USD (for U.S based candidates)

The Senior Strategy Director plays a central role in shaping how the agency thinks, plans, and delivers impact for clients. This role is responsible for defining strategic direction across priority accounts and ensuring that media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams are aligned to a unified business objective.

This role requires an insight-driven mindset and the ability to translate complex business challenges into clear strategic direction. The Senior Strategy Director will guide growth diagnosis, define strategic priorities, and create the connective tissue across disciplines that ensures execution consistently ladders up to clear intent and measurable outcomes.

At our agency, strategy is not a service line, it is how we work.
The Senior Strategy Director ensures that insight, planning, and decision-making are embedded throughout the lifecycle of our client partnerships.

About Level

We're an AI-powered performance marketing agency — built for precision, designed to scale, and powered by a scientific mindset. At Level, we blend strategy, media, creative, and machine intelligence to deliver outcomes that matter. Every time. At scale.

We've been named one of Pittsburgh's Best Places to Work and an Inc. 500 Fastest-Growing Company. Our clients span B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, and more.

Your Role (and Impact)

What You'll Own:

Strategic Direction for Priority Accounts: You'll lead strategic direction on high-impact client engagements, ensuring that marketing activities align with clear business objectives and growth opportunities. You'll guide discovery, develop strategy briefs, and translate business challenges into structured, actionable plans
Strategic Planning & Roadmapping: You'll contribute to annual and quarterly planning cycles by developing growth roadmaps tied to measurable outcomes. You'll clarify priorities, define success metrics, and ensure teams are aligned around a shared understanding of strategic intent
Strategy Brief Development: You'll own the development of strategy briefs that define business objectives, growth priorities, audience insights, positioning, channel approach, investment logic, and measurement frameworks. These briefs will serve as the foundation that aligns cross-functional teams before execution begins
Audience, Market & Category Insights: You'll lead the development of audience insights, competitive analysis, and market intelligence that inform strategic recommendations. You'll translate research and performance data into clear implications that guide decision-making across teams
Channel Strategy & Investment Planning: You'll bring deep media strategy and planning expertise to define channel mix, sequencing, and investment logic that support growth objectives — fuelling full-funnel media plans that mature clients' media programs beyond performance marketing and extend coverage across every stage of the customer journey, from awareness through retention. You'll collaborate with media, CRM, SEO, and digital experience leaders to ensure channel decisions and budget allocation are aligned with the broader strategic framework
Measurement Frameworks & Performance Interpretation: You'll establish measurement frameworks that define success before activation begins. You'll help teams interpret performance signals, ensuring insights drive decisions rather than simply informing reporting
Strategic Performance Storytelling: You'll lead strategic narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews and planning discussions, articulating what happened, why it happened, what was learned, and what actions should follow. Your storytelling will connect data, insights, and business implications into clear recommendations
Client Strategic Partnership: You'll serve as a strategic partner for client stakeholders, confidently leading conversations around growth opportunities, planning priorities, and strategic recommendations. You'll guide discussions beyond tactical execution toward long-term business impact
Cross-Disciplinary Strategic Alignment: You'll act as the connective tissue across media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams to ensure that strategy is consistently integrated into execution. You'll align KPIs, messaging, channel strategies, and measurement frameworks to ensure clear business intent
Strategy Enablement Across Teams: You'll equip account and delivery teams with frameworks and guidance that elevate the quality and consistency of strategic thinking across the agency. Your work will help simplify planning and bring clarity to complex challenges
Strategic Standards & Framework Development: You'll contribute to the evolution of agency-wide strategy frameworks, playbooks, and planning tools. You'll help embed strategy into briefs, planning cycles, and optimization rhythms so that it becomes a core operating discipline
Thought Leadership & New Business Support: You'll contribute to agency POVs, category playbooks, and growth narratives that strengthen our market differentiation. You'll support new business opportunities through strategic storytelling and insight-driven positioning

Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences.

Skills & Qualifications:

Strong experience developing integrated marketing strategies across multiple channels and disciplines
Proven media strategy and planning experience, with the ability to architect full-funnel, multi-stage media plans that mature clients' programs beyond performance marketing into upper- and mid-funnel brand and demand strategies
Ability to translate business objectives into clear strategic direction that guides cross-functional teams
Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from performance data, research, and market intelligence
Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand how messaging, channels, customer experience, and measurement connect
Excellent storytelling and communication skills, able to frame complex ideas in a clear and compelling narrative
Strong facilitation and collaboration skills, able to align cross-disciplinary teams around shared strategic priorities
Executive presence and confidence when presenting strategic recommendations to senior client stakeholders
Growth-oriented mindset with openness to feedback and continuous improvement
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple planning cycles and strategic initiatives simultaneously
Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and bringing clarity to complex business challenges

Education & Experience:

5+ years of experience in marketing strategy, integrated strategy, brand strategy, media strategy/planning, or growth strategy within an agency or client-side environment
Demonstrated experience building and evolving media strategies across the full customer journey, not limited to lower-funnel performance channels
Demonstrated experience developing cross-channel, integrated marketing strategies
Experience guiding annual planning, strategic roadmapping, and growth discussions with clients
Experience collaborating across media, creative, digital experience, CRM, and analytics teams
Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field
Industry experience in CPG or B2B is an asset but not required
Experience in the education sector (for-profit and/or not-for-profit institutions) is strongly preferred

AI Expectations

At Level, proficiency with AI tools is a core part of your role—not a nice-to-have. Your success in this position depends not only on your functional expertise, but also on your ability to actively integrate AI into how you work
You are expected to:
Experiment continuously with AI tools (eg, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) to improve the speed, quality, and impact of your work (eg, draft briefs, summarize research, analyze data trends, generate initial strategic frameworks, identify patterns in large datasets)
Proactively document and share what you learn—your prompts, process improvements, and use cases—so others can benefit and we can grow together
Approach AI with an iterative mindset, refining how you apply it to your work over time. The first idea is rarely the best; testing, tweaking, and improving is part of the process
Lean into discomfort, especially when tools or workflows feel unfamiliar. Growth happens when you're stretching beyond what's comfortable or routine

AI is not a shortcut—it's a skillset. You're expected to use it as a force multiplier for creativity, strategy, and execution, not as a substitute for thoughtful work. As our tools evolve, your ability to adapt and lead through change will be a key part of your performance and growth at Level

Our Core Values

No Ego, All In We don't do "that's not my job." We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart
Better Every Day We want the feedback — even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar
Relentless for Results Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward
Driven by Truth We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear — not just what is easy to say

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

Remote First

Ready to Apply?

We care more about how you think, how you build, and how you create impact than whether your path has been perfectly linear.

Let's build something together.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
NWI Precision specializes in high-precision machining of helicopter masts, turbine shafts, engine thrust links, and nuclear pressure vessel components used in the aerospace and nuclear industries worldwide. NWI Precision’s 120,000 sq. ft. facility is located at 9 Fenmar Drive in Toronto. Our dedicated team pride themselves on delivering the highest quality products, to specifications and on time. NWI Precision is currently seeking a Vice President, Finance.

The Vice President, Finance is the financial leader of the manufacturing facility, accountable for safeguarding assets, ensuring the accuracy of financial reporting, and providing actionable insights that directly improve P&L results and cash flow. This role partners closely with the CEO, the Senior Leadership Team, Corporate Shared Services and Board of Directors to enhance profitability, improve cost controls, accelerate operational efficiency, and deliver measurable financial outcomes, while ensuring compliance with corporate and regulatory requirements. This role has full leadership responsibility for the finance function at the site, with all finance team members reporting into the position directly or indirectly, and is accountable for building a high-performing finance organization that supports both operational execution and strategic decision-making.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :

Financial Leadership and Governance

Lead the full finance function for the site, ensuring strong execution, clear accountability, and alignment across financial reporting, FP&A, cost accounting, inventory management, and compliance activities.
Serve as the senior finance leader on the site leadership team, providing financial guidance to support both day-to-day decision-making and long-term business strategy.
Establish and maintain a disciplined finance operating model, including policies, processes, controls, and performance expectations across the department.
Lead the preparation and presentation of financial results, forecasts, and business risks to the Board of Directors, ensuring clear communication of performance, outlook, and key decision points.

Financial Reporting & Controls

Ensure timely and accurate reporting of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results in accordance with Canadian GAAP (ASPE) and corporate standards.
Oversee cost accounting, inventory valuation, and product costing processes to ensure accuracy and transparency.
Maintain strong internal control environment and compliance with corporate/business internal policies, audit standards, and safeguarding of plant assets.
Accountable for early identification and resolution of risks or discrepancies that could materially affect reported financials
Ensure finance processes and reporting structures are scalable, disciplined, and responsive to both business needs and corporate requirements.

Financial Planning & Analysis

Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning, ensuring alignment with company objectives and measurable performance targets.
Provide clear, actionable analysis of variances and trends that directly inform operational decision-making and drive corrective actions.
Evaluate, prioritize, and track financial impact of cost savings initiatives, capital investment projects, and productivity improvements.
Own delivery of cash flow visibility and forecasting accuracy, including proactive working capital management.
Lead an integrated planning process that connects financial forecasts, operational assumptions, capital requirements, and business priorities into a coherent view of plant performance.
Provide forward-looking financial leadership to support resource allocation, business cases, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.

Cash Flow Management

Own site cash flow planning, visibility, and performance, ensuring the business has timely insight into short, medium, and long-term liquidity requirements.
Drive cash flow 13 weeks forecasts, including analysis of operating cash flow, capital expenditures, inventory movements, customer collections, supplier payments, and other key drivers of liquidity.

Operational Partnership

Act as a strategic business partner to the President and the Senior Leadership Team
Provide financial guidance that results in improved margins, reduced waste, and achievement of plant productivity goals.
Support lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and efficiency projects with value-focused financial analysis and business cases.
Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs), linking financial performance with operational drivers and holding functions accountable to achieve targets.
Reduce production supplies costs over time through analysis of usage, benchmarking, and best practices adoption.
Increase plant profitability by driving costs down through improved productivity, efficiency, and elimination of non-value-added activities.
Guide operations and support functions in achieving profitability targets, ensuring accountability against plan.
Influence decisions across operations, supply chain, quality, engineering, and support functions by translating financial and operational data into clear priorities and actions.

Inventory and Cost Management

Ensure accurate tracking, valuation, and reporting of raw materials, WIP, and finished goods inventory.
Lead the physical inventory and cycle counting processes, ensuring variances are explained, contained, and prevented going forward.
Oversee cost roll-ups, bills of material, and program specific labor/overhead rate setting to ensure accurate product costing and accountability for margin realization vs. planned.
Initiate, evaluate, and deliver continuous improvement projects designed to remove costs month-over-month from the business.
Drive working capital discipline across the site, including inventory optimization, cash flow visibility, and timely escalation of inventory, receivables, or cost risks.

Compliance, Audit and Risk Management

Ensure compliance with tax, government, and corporate reporting requirements at the business unit level.
Support external and internal audit processes, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
Identify financial risks and recommend mitigation strategies with ownership of follow-through until risk is remediated.
Own the finance governance framework for the site, including audit readiness, policy compliance, control effectiveness, and escalation of material issues.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team, including performance management, succession planning, and capability building.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, ensuring a focus on results and operational excellence.
Partner with cross-functional leaders to provide financial insights and recommendations, building a responsive and trusted finance organization.

EXPECTATIONS

Consistently improve profitability by delivering measurable margin expansion and recurring cost reductions such as production supplies and other overhead versus plan.
Maintain accurate, timely financials and forecasts, with clear root-cause variance analysis and corrective actions that keep results within agreed tolerances.
Improve cash flow performance through accurate rolling forecasts, stronger working capital discipline, and proactive management of liquidity risks and opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement by initiating, evaluating, and delivering cost takeout and productivity projects that generate visible monthly savings and efficiency gains.
Strengthen working capital and operational performance through improved inventory accuracy and turns, effective cash flow management, and disciplined cost control across operations and support functions.
Build a high-performing finance team by coaching and mentoring staff, executing succession plans, and being recognized by Operations as a proactive, accountable business partner.
Establish a culture of accountability across the finance organization, where ownership, responsiveness, and measurable business impact are expected at all levels.

QUALIFICATIONS :

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration. MBA is an asset.
CPA, CA, or equivalent designation is an asset.

EXPERIENCE/KNOWLEDGE:

10+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant leadership responsibility in a manufacturing environment and prior ownership of plant controllership, finance management, or finance director-level responsibilities.
Experience building or upgrading finance processes, controls, and team capability in a manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of cost accounting, inventory management, operations and ERP systems (Syteline/Epicor or similar preferred).
Proven experience partnering with operations to drive cost improvements and efficiencies with demonstrated margin or cash flow impact.
Manufacturing environment mandatory, aerospace or other highly regulated manufacturing experience is an asset.

jobs.description:
Type de poste :
Permanent Modèle de travail :
Hybride Numéro de demande:
133501 Lieu principal :
Toronto, ON Emplacements additionnels :
Toronto, ON; Brossard, QC; Burlington, ON; Calgary, AB; Edmonton, AB; Fredericton, NB; Halifax, NS; Kitchener, ON; Laval, QC; Moncton, NB; Montréal, QC; Ottawa, ON; Régina, SK; Saint John, NB; Saskatoon, SK; St. John's, NL; Vancouver, BC; Victoria, BC; Winnipeg, MB; ville de Québec, QC

Notre raison d’être

Chez Deloitte, notre raison d’être est d’avoir une influence marquante. Nous existons pour inspirer et aider nos gens, nos organisations, nos collectivités et nos pays à prospérer en créant un avenir meilleur. Notre travail soutient une société prospère où les gens peuvent s’épanouir et saisir des occasions. Il renforce la confiance des consommateurs et des entreprises, aide les organisations à trouver des moyens créatifs de déployer des capitaux, habilite des institutions sociales et économiques justes, fiables et efficaces, et permet à nos amis, à nos familles et à nos collectivités de profiter de la qualité de vie qui accompagne un avenir durable. Étant le plus grand cabinet de services professionnels détenu et exploité à 100 % par des Canadiens dans notre pays, nous sommes fiers de travailler aux côtés de nos clients pour avoir une influence positive sur tous les Canadiens.

En incarnant notre raison d’être, nous aurons une influence marquante.

Diversifiez votre carrière au sein du Cabinet.
Tirez parti d’avantages souples, proactifs et pratiques qui favorisent une culture de bien-être et la création de liens solides.
Approfondissez vos connaissances grâce au mentorat d’experts et à du coaching au travail.

--

À quoi ressemblera votre journée type

En tant que leader principal(e) d’Oracle EPM Planning (directeur(trice) principal(e)), vous serez responsable des programmes de planification d’entreprise et de transformation de la fonction finance pour façonner des solutions, de la gestion de relations avec des clients et de l’exécution de nombreuses missions.

À ce titre, vous devrez faire ce qui suit :

Superviser simultanément la prestation de bout en bout de l’architecture de solutions et de nombreuses missions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris l’étendue, le plan de travail, la gestion des risques et des problèmes (RAID), la gestion financière, la gestion de la qualité et les résultats globaux de la prestation.
Fournir des conseils sur les stratégies de transformation de la fonction finance et de planification d’entreprise.
Assumer la responsabilité de la conception de la solution et des décisions en matière d’architecture.
Diriger la définition des processus de planification pour l’état futur et des modèles d’exploitation en tirant parti des capacités d’Oracle EPM pour rehausser l’efficacité et les perspectives d’affaires.
Favoriser l’harmonisation entre les finances, les TI et les parties prenantes de la direction pour favoriser des processus décisionnels efficaces et veiller à la réussite des programmes.
Assurer la direction fonctionnelle des solutions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris la gamme complète de modules EPBCS.
Superviser la conception du modèle de planification et l’architecture des solutions (catalyseurs, hypothèses, scénarios, flux des travaux, production de rapports) et s’assurer que les solutions sont adaptables, durables et harmonisées aux objectifs du client.
Veiller à l’exécution de cas d’utilisation de grande qualité sur le plan de la planification, des prévisions et de la gestion du rendement.
Superviser les activités de test et de déploiement, notamment la stratégie de test, le tri des défectuosités, l’état de préparation aux essais d’acceptation par l’utilisateur et la planification du déploiement, afin de s’assurer que les solutions sont adoptées avec succès et créent la valeur commerciale attendue.
Favoriser le développement des affaires en faisant preuve de leadership sur le plan des offres de service, en effectuant des présentations auprès des clients et en assurant la gestion des relations.
Contribuer aux stratégies de mise en marché, à l’élaboration d’offres de service et au leadership d’opinion au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Diriger et encadrer des équipes de prestation dans le cadre de nombreuses missions, afin de promouvoir une solide discipline d’exécution et leur perfectionnement grâce au coaching, au mentorat et à une rétroaction de qualité.
Contribuer au recrutement, à l’intégration et au développement de capacités au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Demeurer au courant des nouveautés liées au produit Oracle EPM et intégrer les innovations pertinentes à la prestation de services, en particulier les capacités d’IA/IGR telles que la planification prédictive, Auto Predict et IPM Insights.
Aider les clients à mettre en œuvre des capacités de planification habilitées par l’IA pour améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions, automatiser la création de perspectives et améliorer les processus décisionnels.
Façonner les réflexions de clients sur le rôle de l’IA dans le cadre de la planification d’entreprise, et la création d’un équilibre entre l’innovation et la mise en œuvre de mesures pratiques qui créent de la valeur.

La personne retenue aura l’occasion de faire partie de notre premier cabinet de services-conseils qui travaille à la fine pointe de mises en œuvre d’Oracle Cloud. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une grande variété de clients et jouerez un rôle important dans certaines des mises en œuvre les plus stimulantes à l’échelle mondiale.

Renseignements sur l’équipe

L’équipe adopte et incarne la raison d’être du Cabinet – c’est-à-dire avoir une influence marquante –, tout en vous poussant à vous surpasser, vous-même et votre équipe, afin de trouver des solutions aux problèmes les plus importants de nos clients, de nos gens et de la société.

Veiller au perfectionnement de gens et d’équipes hautement performantes en leur offrant des occasions stimulantes et pertinentes.
Offrir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en obtenant un rendement élevé, tout en favorisant la collaboration entre les équipes et les régions.
Exercer une influence positive sur les clients, les équipes et les gens en donnant l’exemple et en établissant de solides relations.
Veiller à ce que les gens soient sur la même longueur d’onde et à ce que les priorités soient harmonisées aux objectifs d’affaires des clients et de Deloitte.

Assez parlé de nous, parlons de vous

Vous Avez Le Profil Suivant

Au moins huit années d’expérience dans la prestation de solutions Oracle EPM Planning dans des environnements de consultation ou d’entreprise.
Expérience dans la supervision de programmes de transformation de la fonction finance et de la planification d’entreprise pour améliorer les processus de budgétisation, de prévision et de présentation de l’information.
Expérience éprouvée dans la mise en œuvre de bout en bout d’Oracle EPM Planning tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, des exigences au déploiement et à la stabilisation.
Expérience éprouvée en gestion de missions de grande envergure ou simultanées, ainsi qu’en gestion de l’exécution, des parties prenantes et des aspects financiers des missions.
Excellente expertise fonctionnelle liée aux plateformes Oracle EPM Planning, y compris les systèmes EPBCS, PBCS et Hyperion Planning), et aux modules associés (Workforce, Capital, Project, Strategic Modelling).
Compréhension approfondie des processus de planification et d’analyse financières, y compris la budgétisation, les prévisions, la planification à long terme et la gestion du rendement.
Expérience de la gestion des aspects financiers des projets, de leur étendue et des risques liés aux missions complexes.
Connaissances pratiques des intégrations, de l’architecture des métadonnées et des technologies connexes (p. ex., gestion des données, FDMEE, règles d’affaires Essbase, création de scripts dans Groovy, et IPA REST).
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et capacité d’analyser et de résoudre des problèmes d’affaires complexes au moyen d’approches structurées.
Excellentes aptitudes pour la communication et les relations interpersonnelles, capacité de produire du contenu prêt à l’emploi et de communiquer avec les parties prenantes de haut niveau avec assurance.
Compréhension des capacités de planification propulsées par l’IA dans Oracle EPM, telles que Auto Predict et IPM Insights, capacité à les utiliser de manière responsable afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions et l’efficacité de la planification, et expérience de leur application (ou soutien de l’application).
Baccalauréat en finances, en comptabilité, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise ou un titre professionnel (p. ex., CPA, MBA) est un atout.
Certifications Oracle EPM (p. ex., certification Oracle Cloud EPM) : considérées comme un atout important.

Le bilinguisme en français et en anglais est requis pour ce poste en raison de la nature du rôle ayant des interactions avec les clients et les équipes de projet nationaux et mondiaux.

Rémunération totale

L’échelle salariale pour ce poste est de 105,000 $ à 234,000 $. Certaines personnes peuvent être admissibles à notre programme de prime. Sur le plan salarial, Deloitte se concentre sur l’équité et la compétitivité. Nous établissons régulièrement des comparaisons aux données de référence du marché établies pour divers postes, secteurs, cibles et niveaux. Notre approche est fondée sur l’importance de reconnaître les forces et les contributions uniques de chaque personne et de récompenser celle-ci pour la valeur qu’elle apporte.

La rémunération totale offerte par Deloitte s’étend bien au-delà des programmes traditionnels de rémunération et d’avantages sociaux et est conçue pour reconnaître les contributions des employés, favoriser le mieux-être personnel et soutenir la croissance du Cabinet. En plus de nos jours de congé payés réguliers, quelques exemples incluent : 4 000 $ par an pour les avantages de soutien en santé mentale, un compte de dépenses flexibles de 1 300 $, des fermetures à l'échelle de l'entreprise connues sous le nom de "Jours Deloitte", des journées dédiées à l'apprentissage (connues sous le nom de Jours de Développement et d'Innovation), des arrangements de travail flexibles et une structure de travail hybride.

Notre promesse à nos gens : Deloitte est là où vous pouvez propulsez vos ambitions.

Vous, et plus encore.

Évoluez au sein d’une équipe passionnée et déterminée à apprendre et à développer de nouvelles compétences. Bâtissez votre réseau et faites le plein d’expériences qui vous permettront de vous épanouir et vous mèneront vers la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

Vos chemins nous portent plus loin.

La diversité de vos compétences, perspectives et expériences nous rend meilleurs. Nous voulons que vous vous sentiez comme chez vous, qui que vous soyez et d’où que vous veniez. Nous vous oﬀrons des options de travail ﬂexibles et personnalisées pour répondre à vos besoins, peu importe votre mode de vie.

Devenez le leader que vous désirez être.

Certains dirigent des équipes, d’autres sont au cœur d’un changement de culture, d’autres encore bâtissent une expertise de pointe. Nous soutiendrons votre croissance en tant que leader par l’entremise d’expériences, d’occasions et de défis variés et enrichissants.

Ayez autant de carrières que vous le souhaitez.

Nous sommes en mesure de vous offrir de nouveaux rôles et de nouvelles responsabilités, et de vous aider à vous y préparer. Notre objectif est de conjuguer vos aspirations à vos compétences et à l’excellence de votre savoir-faire. Nous sommes l’endroit pour développer un réseau durable d’amis, de pairs et de mentors.

La balle est dans votre camp

Chez Deloitte, nous avons à cœur de faire des affaires de manière inclusive – cela commence par une diversité parmi les collègues de toutes les compétences! Deloitte encourage tous les candidats qualifiés qui représentent la diversité des collectivités partout au Canada

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Strategy (AI, Data, Advertising)
jobs.description:
Publicis Groupe Canada
is the Canadian subsidiary of Publicis Groupe, the second largest communications group in the world and a global leader concentrated within four main activities: Communication, Media, Data and Technology. Publicis Groupe Canada represents the vision of a set of collaborative and integrated agencies that offer expertise and insightful services to many of the biggest brands in North America.

Canadian brands include:
Publicis Canada (Publicis Canada, Hawkeye, Razorfish, Publicis Health, ThePubProductions, Nurun, Moov AI, Publicis Sports & Entertainment), Publicis Media (Starcom, Spark Foundry, Zenith), Leo Burnett (Leo Burnett Canada, Ove Brand Design, Leo Burnett Design), Saatchi & Saatchi (Saatchi & Saatchi Canada, Synergize, TPM), MSL Canada/North Strategic and Publicis Sapient.

Overview

The Senior Director, Product Strategy
owns the enterprise vision, business roadmap and market adoption strategy for Connected Solutions (Publicis Groupe’s core AI and data products). This leader connects client business priorities, agency needs and product capabilities, turning complex opportunities into a clear portfolio direction and sequenced roadmap.

Operating as a senior individual contributor and trusted executive advisor, this person shapes strategic decisions across clients, agencies and internal leadership. They establish the narrative, commercial logic and adoption model for Connected Solutions, ensuring that individual client opportunities translate into repeatable products, scalable growth and sustained market relevance.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Product Vision & Portfolio Strategy

Set and champion the long-term product vision for Connected Solutions, aligning AI and data capabilities with client priorities, agency strategy and market opportunity.
Own the enterprise business roadmap and rollout sequencing for the core agentic solution, while identifying adjacent products and portfolio opportunities that can expand impact and revenue.
Establish portfolio-level prioritization criteria that balance client demand, feasibility, commercial potential, differentiation and strategic fit.
Make clear recommendations on where to invest, accelerate, pause or reposition, and build executive alignment around those choices.

Executive Leadership & Governance

Serve as the senior strategic voice for Connected Solutions in executive forums, client leadership meetings and cross-agency planning discussions.
Create decision frameworks and governance rhythms that keep business, product, delivery and technology leaders aligned on priorities, risks and expected outcomes.
Hold the strategic boundary between product vision, tactical product design and technical execution, ensuring accountability without dictating architecture.
Partner closely with the Product Lead and Delivery and Technology leadership to translate strategic intent into an executable plan.

Commercial Growth & Market Positioning

Identify and shape growth opportunities across existing and prospective client relationships, connecting product capability to meaningful business value.
Define positioning, packaging, adoption pathways and service models that enable agencies and account teams to bring Connected Solutions to market consistently.
Partner with growth and account leaders on pitches, proposals and strategic pursuits, strengthening the commercial story and value proposition.
Turn high-value client use cases into repeatable offerings that can scale across accounts, markets and agency disciplines.

Client Advisory, Storytelling & Influence

Act as a trusted advisor to C-level clients and senior internal executives, helping them understand where AI, data and automation can create measurable value.
Shape and deliver compelling narratives for pitches, demonstrations, executive presentations and strategic workshops.
Translate complex product and technical capabilities into clear business choices, outcomes and trade-offs for non-technical audiences.
Build consensus across clients, agencies, product, technology and delivery teams, especially when priorities compete or strategic pivots are required.

Adoption, Impact & Continuous Learning

Define what successful adoption and rollout look like, including client outcomes, adoption signals, repeatable use cases and indicators of commercial scale.
Develop executive-level measures of product value and use them to guide roadmap decisions, investment conversations and market expansion.
Establish structured feedback loops with clients and agencies to identify friction, unmet needs and emerging opportunities.
Serve as the senior escalation point for product-related concerns or strategic pivots, coordinating resolution with the Product Lead and relevant partners.

What Success Looks Like

Connected Solutions has a clear, prioritized and commercially grounded roadmap understood by senior stakeholders.
Clients and agencies understand the portfolio’s value and how to adopt it.
Product decisions reflect client feedback, adoption signals and market opportunity.
Individual client needs become repeatable use cases, scalable offerings and sustained commercial momentum.

Qualifications

What we are looking for:

12+ years of progressive experience in product strategy, marketing strategy, innovation or commercial growth, including significant leadership at the Director, Group Director or equivalent level.
Experience owning enterprise product or portfolio strategy, business roadmaps and rollout plans across external clients, agency networks or complex organizations.
Deep understanding of the agency ecosystem, ideally across creative, media, CRM and data disciplines.
Strong knowledge of marketing and media workflows and a practical understanding of how agentic AI and automation can improve them.
Proven ability to advise C-level stakeholders, simplify complex topics and influence cross-functional decisions in a matrixed environment.
Strong commercial mindset, with experience connecting product capabilities to packaging, adoption, client value and scalable growth.
Ability to partner credibly with engineering and technical leadership while owning business strategy rather than technical delivery.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Product, Strategy or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Stand-Out Experience

Launching or scaling agentic AI, automation, data or marketing technology solutions within CRM, media or creative organizations.
Familiarity with agency commercial models, including licensing, packaging, service tiers and value propositions.
Experience leading product advisory boards, executive workshops, innovation councils or structured client discovery programs.
New business, growth strategy or enterprise transformation experience across multiple agencies, markets or global stakeholder groups.

Additional Information

Eligibility: Candidates must be based in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), possess valid Canadian work authorization, and be willing to commute to our downtown Toronto office.
Hybrid schedule: Rotating 2-day / 3-day in-office schedule (Tue/Thu one week, Mon/Wed/Fri the next).
Competitive annual vacation program, enhanced between Christmas and New Year’s when our offices are closed.
Extended statutory holidays (we give our employees the Mondays and Fridays of provincial holidays so you can enjoy long 4-day weekends).
6 sick days per year and 2 personal days per year.
Monthly cell phone allowance
Employer RRSP matching contributions of up to 2%
“Work Your World” program, allowing you to work remotely for up to 6 weeks in any country where we have an office (50+ countries).
Comprehensive group insurance benefits (medical and dental care, vision care, psychological and paramedical services, disability insurance, fertility support, and gender-affirming care).
Internal support and guidance program for cancer, fertility, and gender transition.

The salary for this position is $160,000 - $210,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.

Publicis Canada is committed to building a diverse workforce representative of our community. We encourage and are pleased to consider all qualified candidates, without regard to race, colour, citizenship, religion, sex, marital / family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, aboriginal status, age, disability or persons who may require an accommodation, to apply. If you require a specific accommodation, please contact Human Resources at inquiries@publicisna.com.

jobs.title: Directeur Financier | Finance Director
jobs.description:
Description

Qui sommes-nous : Manos

Manos Software Group fait partie de Valsoft Corporation, un investisseur à long terme dans les entreprises de logiciels de marchés verticaux. Valsoft acquiert et exploite des sociétés de logiciels avec une vision de détention permanente, en mettant l’accent sur l’autonomie, une croissance disciplinée et la création de valeur à long terme. Manos se concentre sur des secteurs connexes à la santé, notamment les logiciels dentaires, médicaux et vétérinaires.

Description Du Poste

Dans le cadre de l’expansion continue de notre portefeuille d’entreprises de logiciels spécialisés par secteur d’activité, nous recherchons une personne dynamique et expérimentée pour rejoindre notre équipe en tant que Directeur.trice Financier·ère. Relevant directement de l’un des Partenaires d’Investissement, la personne retenue sera responsable de la supervision de la performance financière et du développement stratégique de notre portefeuille. Ce rôle implique une prise en charge complète de la planification financière, du reporting et de la gestion de la performance.

La personne idéale est un.e leader stratégique doté.e d’une forte expertise financière, capable de favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle, d’optimiser la rentabilité et d’assurer un flux de trésorerie positif. Cette personne travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, en favorisant la coopération pour exécuter avec succès les stratégies d’entreprise tout en maintenant des contrôles financiers rigoureux et une conformité exemplaire.

Responsabilités principales

Piloter la planification financière en analysant la performance et les risques du portefeuille
Définir les objectifs et superviser l’ensemble du personnel comptable et financier (comptabilité, FP&A, comptes clients, comptes fournisseurs)
Préparer les rapports financiers mensuels, trimestriels et annuels
Élaborer et gérer les prévisions financières mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles ; suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPIs)
Surveiller et analyser les performances pour identifier des axes d’amélioration et mettre en œuvre des plans d’action permettant d’atteindre ou de dépasser les objectifs financiers
Suivre la santé financière du portefeuille et garantir un flux de trésorerie positif
Diriger et organiser les audits légaux annuels, en veillant au respect de toutes les obligations réglementaires
Développer des stratégies pour améliorer la rentabilité et le retour sur investissement
Superviser et réviser les activités comptables, y compris la fiscalité et la conformité
Veiller à l’efficacité des contrôles financiers internes et évaluer en continu les politiques et procédures en place
Collaborer avec l’équipe chargée de l’intégration des entreprises nouvellement acquises, notamment pour la production des bilans d’ouverture, des états financiers complets, et pour assurer leur intégration aux processus financiers de Valsoft
Maintenir une communication régulière avec le département Finance du groupe
Participer activement aux processus d’acquisition et de cession d’entreprises
Accomplir toutes autres responsabilités confiées par l’employeur, que la personne s’engage à exécuter avec diligence, conformément aux termes de l’accord

Prêt(e) à joindre une équipe collaborative et innovante où vous pourrez avoir un impact immédiat?

#Manos

Manos Overview

Manos Software Group is part of Valsoft Corporation, a long-term investor in vertical market software businesses. Valsoft acquires and operates software companies with a permanent ownership mindset, emphasizing autonomy, disciplined growth, and long-term value creation. Manos focuses on healthcare-adjacent verticals, including dental, medical, and veterinary software.

Position Description

As we continue to expand our portfolio of vertical market software businesses, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to join our team as Finance Director. Reporting directly to one of our Investment Partners, the Finance Director will be responsible for overseeing the financial performance and strategic development of our portfolio. This role involves full ownership and accountability for financial planning, reporting, and performance management. The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with a strong financial acumen, capable of driving operational excellence, optimizing profitability, and ensuring positive cash flow. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration to execute business strategies successfully while maintaining rigorous financial controls and compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Drive the financial planning of the company by analyzing portfolio performance and risks
Set targets for and supervise all accounting and finance personnel (Accounting, FP&A, AR, AP)
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
Build and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasts; track KPIs
Monitor and analyze performance strategies to identify areas of opportunity and implement action plans to meet or exceed financial targets
Monitor the financial health of the portfolio and ensure positive cash flow
Lead and organize annual statutory audits and ensure all required filings are completed
Develop strategies to increase return on investment and profitability
Oversee and review accounting tasks, including tax and compliance
Ensure effective financial internal controls and continuously evaluate established policies and procedures
Collaborate with the integration team of newly acquired companies by producing opening balances, complete financials, and onboarding on Valsoft finance procedures
Maintain high-level interaction with the corporate finance department
Actively participate in processes related to the sale or acquisition of companies
Perform all other applicable responsibilities as delegated by the Employer, which the Employee agrees to carry out diligently under the terms of the Agreement

Ready to join a collaborative and innovative team where you can make an immediate impact?

jobs.title: Director, Wealth Strategy & Research - 12-month contract - Tangerine
jobs.description:
Requisition ID
: 273102

At Tangerine, we’re redefining banking. As Canada’s leading digital bank, we thrive on innovation, agility, and bold thinking, tackling every challenge head-on with leading technology and the unstoppable power of collaboration.

Our client-obsessed teams deliver flexible, accessible banking solutions, breakthrough products, and award-winning service. Beyond banking, we’re committed to making an impact in the communities we serve and across our organization. We foster a culture built on integrity, inclusion, and fearless ambition – where diverse perspectives are valued, and people are empowered to do their best work.

Are you ready to disrupt the status quo? Do you crave challenges that push boundaries? If you’re a high performer looking to accelerate your career and reimagine the banking landscape, this is your moment.

Let’s shape the future of banking together!

What You Will Be Doing

The Director, Wealth Strategy & Research will lead the development and execution of strategic initiatives that shape the future of our wealth offerings. This role carries enterprise-level accountability, executive decision support, and stakeholder influence across the organization. The Director will serve as a thought leader, driving insights that inform product strategy, market positioning, and long-term growth.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will be:

Define and execute the Tangerine Wealth product roadmap in alignment with business strategic objectives.
Provide strategic insights and recommendations to senior executives, influencing enterprise priorities and business decisions.
Represent Tangerine Wealth in executive forums and prepare board reports, C-suite briefings, and steering-committee updates.
Work closely with market research and competitive intelligence teams to identify actionable insights to inform product development and business decisions.
Continuously monitor the traditional wealth, digital wealth, and fintech landscape for emerging trends, competitor moves, regulatory developments, and technology innovations.
Translate research findings into actionable strategies that drive innovation and client-centric solutions.
Develop and manage structured frameworks for competitor benchmarking, client segmentation, pricing, and go-to-market strategies.

We Are:

Accenture Data & AI — the people who love using data to tell a story. We're the world's largest team of data scientists and experts in machine learning and AI. We believe a mix of data, analytics, automation, and responsible AI can do almost anything — spark digital reinvention, widen the range of what humans can do, and breathe life into smart products and services.

In the Public Sector, we partner with government agencies, crown corporations, and public institutions to drive meaningful, citizen-centred transformation. We bring the full depth of Accenture's AI and data capabilities to solve complex challenges that matter at a societal scale.

You Are: A thought leader and practitioner at the intersection of AI strategy and data delivery — As a senior leader in the Data & AI practice, you will coach and mentor up-and-coming leaders, guide diverse multi-disciplinary teams, and help clients embed AI and data capabilities as a lasting part of their organisational culture — with a strong focus on responsible AI, data governance, and public trust.

Role Summary

As a Senior Leader
in Accenture’s Data &AI
practice, you will lead the strategy, design, and scaled delivery of AI & Data solutions for Utilities
industry and clients
. You will build reusable data/AI capabilities—covering ingestion, orchestration, governance, data products, analytics enablement, and model/AI lifecycle—so clients can accelerate time-to-value while meeting enterprise-grade requirements for security, privacy, quality, and responsible AI. The Utilities industry is at the center of the largest infrastructure transformation in a generation—the collision of decarbonization, unprecedented load growth from electrification and data centers, grid resilience against extreme weather events, affordability and regulatory pressure, and the shift to distributed, digitized, AI-enabled operations. You will own the Data & AI agenda for our Utilities portfolio across Canada, personally leading the most consequential CxO relationships, and set the pace for how the portfolio grows, delivers and shows up in the market.

Set direction for AI & Data Utilities: Own the target-state vision, architecture, and roadmap for data/AI utilities across complex enterprise landscapes (multiple systems, domains, and stakeholders).

Lead large-scale client engagements: Drive end-to-end delivery leadership across strategy, design, build, and transition-to-run, ensuring outcomes and adoption.

Operationalize reusable accelerators: Establish standards and scalable patterns (reference architectures, reusable pipelines, governance workflows, data product frameworks, and MLOps/LLMOps practices).

Shape the Utilities Data & AI agenda: own the industry point of view and go-to-market, including energy-transition advisory, rate case and regulatory environment, OT/IT convergence, grid-modernization and DERMS-enabling data platforms, wildfire and resilience analytics, customer-experience transformation and AI-enabled workforce and field operations. 12+ years of relevant experience in enterprise data platforms and/or AI/ML engineering, including architecture and operationalization.

Proven track record of building and growing an industry portfolio – origination, sales and expansion – with personally attributable multi-$MM record in annual originated sales and ownership of multi-$MM in managed revenue at portfolio scale, sustained across multiple years and through all least one full economic or industry cycle.

Recognized trusted advisor to C-suite and Board-level executives at large enterprise Utility industry clients, with the credibility and presence to lead the most challenging conversations on strategy, investment, and transformation outcomes in a rapidly changing Utilities landscape.

Strong background in enterprise data architecture and delivery for utility-style platforms (integration, orchestration, data products, governance, and data operations).

Strong experience in stakeholder and executive management and ability to translate technical strategy into business value.

Track record of building, leading & developing high-performance teams at scale and influencing without authority across client organizations and internal leadership.

Recognized eminence and thought leadership in Data & AI for Utilities – evidenced by such recurring keynote or mainstage presence at flagship industry forums (e.g. DistribuTECH, CERAWeek, Enlit, WEF Energy), published points of view carried by tier-one industry or business media in the last 24 months, and standing relationships with the leading Utilities in Canada as well as AI/Data analysts (Gartner, Forrester, Wood Mackenzie, S&P Global).

What is the opportunity?

The Senior Director-Head of CNB Wealth Business Architecture is a senior leadership role within City National Bank (RBC) Wealth Technology, reporting directly to the Head of CNB Wealth Technology.

The role is responsible for leading the CNB Wealth Business Architecture organization, with approximately 30 professionals, and driving the product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and execution of technology capabilities that support City National Bank’s Wealth Management business.

The successful candidate will serve as a strategic partner to CNB Wealth business leadership, bringing deep Wealth Management industry expertise and a strong understanding of the products, platforms, workflows, operating models, and client experiences that underpin a modern wealth management organization.

In addition to the functional leadership responsibilities, the individual will serve as the Head of Toronto for CNB Wealth Technology, providing local leadership, employee engagement, talent development, and organizational oversight for the Toronto-based CNB Wealth Technology community.

What will you do?

Wealth Product Leadership

Lead the Wealth Business Architecture organization of approximately 30 professionals, establishing a high-performing, product-oriented culture focused on business outcomes and client value.
Define and execute the Wealth Product Development strategy in partnership with Wealth business leadership and the Head of Wealth Technology.
Own the product development lifecycle from ideation and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and continuous enhancement.
Translate Wealth business strategy and client needs into clear product strategies, roadmaps, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Establish and maintain a disciplined product prioritization framework that balances strategic initiatives, business growth opportunities, client experience, regulatory requirements, technology modernization, and operational needs.
Ensure product roadmaps are aligned with the broader Wealth Technology strategy and enterprise technology architecture.
Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Cybersecurity, Operations, and other technology functions to ensure successful delivery of product capabilities.
Drive transparency into product investment, priorities, dependencies, delivery progress, and business outcomes.
Establish appropriate product management practices, standards, governance, metrics, and operating rhythms across the organization.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

The Consulting Director will be a key member of Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA), a team within Visa Advisory Services that drives tangible, impactful and financial results for Visa’s network clients, including both financial services and merchants. Drawing on our expertise in strategy consulting, data analytics, brand management, marketing, operational and macroeconomics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients.

Potential engagements could include market expansion, revenue uplift, segmentation, portfolio management diagnostics, authorization optimization strategies, assessments of digital product and marketing programs, development of new products with implementation roadmaps, and optimizing client customer servicing processes.

Proactively engage and manage advisory relationship with key clients and Visa client leadership in regular strategic & planning discussions

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a product leader to own the roadmap for RBC's internal agentic AI platform end-to-end — from intake and prioritization through delivery and measurement. As Director, Product Strategy & Roadmap, you will decide what ships and when, ground those decisions in user value and adoption evidence, and own the product experience and analytics that make the platform usable and valuable at scale.

You will bring rigour to prioritization, fluency in agentic AI, and the credibility to partner with engineering on how the roadmap gets built — without owning the technical implementation.

Your responsibilities will include:

Roadmap ownership: Maintaining and communicating a rolling 12-month roadmap with clear, evidence-based prioritization rationale
