jobs.description:
At Alto, we are actively contributing to the transformation of Canada's future with our high-speed train project connecting Quebec City and Toronto. With the support of the Government of Canada, this innovative project aims to improve the quality of life of our citizens, strengthen ties between communities and stimulate economic growth.

Would you like to take on a stimulating, high-impact challenge? We are looking for a Senior Director, Real Property Strategy and Asset Management.

Please note that the candidate may be based in one of our 4 offices: Montreal, Quebec City, Toronto or Ottawa.

The role

Reporting to the Vice President, Real Property, the Senior Director, Real Property Strategy and Asset Management is responsible for providing strategic leadership for Alto’s Real Property function through the development of acquisition strategies, governance frameworks, business planning processes, risk management practices, and portfolio management programs.

Working in close collaboration with the Senior Director, Real Property Acquisitions, the Private Development Partner (PDP) Cadence’s Lands Team, the Project Management Office (PMO), and other internal functions including Engineering, Construction, Finance, Commercial, Government Relations and Information Technology, this position is responsible for ensuring the Real Property function is supported by the strategies, processes, tools, partnerships, reporting, and operational frameworks required to successfully deliver Alto’s land acquisition mandate. The position will lead Alto’s strategic relationship with Cadence’s Lands Team, oversee the Permission to Enter (PTE) Program, support the development of land acquisition strategies, provide oversight of Real Property business planning and risk management activities, and establish the policies, governance, and controls required to manage Alto’s growing real property portfolio.

The Responsibilities

Leadership & Stakeholder Relations

Lead Alto’s Strategy and Asset Management team and serve as the senior strategic counterpart to Cadence’s Lands Team and other relevant workstreams.
Serve as Alto’s primary Real Property representative with government, agency stakeholders and other key external partners on land acquisition strategy, processes and policy matters.
Provide strategic guidance on landowner engagement approaches, communications strategies, escalation pathways, and stakeholder management practices in support of Alto’s acquisition objectives.
Drive alignment across Real Property, PMO, Engineering, Construction, Commercial, Finance, Government Relations, and other functional teams to ensure consistent planning assumptions and effective delivery.

Planning & Program Development

Lead the development and maintenance of Alto’s Real Property Land Acquisition Strategy in collaboration with the Senior Director, Real Property Acquisitions, ensuring alignment with acquisition priorities, funding requirements, risk considerations, and project delivery needs.
Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of governance frameworks, reporting structures, business processes, performance measures and operating practices that support Alto’s land acquisition mandate.
Oversee the planning, governance, stakeholder coordination, performance monitoring and reporting of Alto’s Permission To Enter campaign.
Oversee Real Property business planning activities, including the development, review and coordination of scopes of work, procurement requirements, budgets, funding requests, and project cost estimates with the Private Development Partner, ensuring alignment with Alto’s acquisition mandate.
Lead Alto’s agricultural strategy, including policy development, stakeholder considerations, operational requirements, and alignment with acquisition and property management activities.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives through process optimization, strategic planning, performance measurement, and operational efficiency reviews.
Work with the PMO, IT, and other internal functions to define, prioritize, and drive delivery of Real Property technology requirements supporting acquisition, portfolio management, reporting, and decision-making.
Prepare detailed briefings, reports, and presentations for senior management, senior Government stakeholders, and the Board of Directors.
Integrate risk management principles into real property planning and pre-acquisition activities, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks associated with land acquisition and portfolio management.

Property Management Oversight

Develop and oversee Alto’s property management policies, governance framework and operating model, providing strategic oversight of property management activities, compliance, operating costs, land stewardship, lease administration, property access, security requirements, etc.

Competencies

Strategic Vision: Ability to develop and implement a strategy that aligns with organizational goals and drive the success of real property and asset management initiatives.
Risk Management: Skilled in identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to property acquisition.
Relationship Building: Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, which facilitates collaboration and alignment across diverse teams.
Leadership: Mentors, coaches, and develops high-performing teams; fosters a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Communication & Influence: Communicates complex ideas clearly to senior management, boards, and external stakeholders; presents reports, briefings, and recommendations with impact and clarity; influences decision-making.

The Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Urban Planning, Engineering, Business Administration, Law, Public Administration, or a related discipline.
Minimum of 12-15 years in real estate, land acquisition, infrastructure development, transportation, or related fields, including experience in complex transactions and multi-stakeholder environments.
Significant experience supporting major infrastructure, transit, transportation, real estate development, or land-intensive projects involving regulatory approvals, stakeholder engagement, and project delivery considerations.
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing governance frameworks, business planning processes, performance measurement programs, and risk management practices.
Experience overseeing real property portfolios, asset management programs, property management functions, or land stewardship activities.
Strong understanding of land acquisition strategies, negotiations, due diligence, regulatory requirements, and risk management principles.
Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary teams and influencing executive-level stakeholders across government, private sector, and complex project environments.
Proven ability to develop strategic recommendations and communicate complex issues effectively through executive briefings, reports, and presentations to senior leadership and Boards.
Experience working within public sector, Crown corporation, transportation, or large infrastructure environments is considered a strong asset.
Bilingualism (English and French) is considered an asset.

The opportunity

Aequilibrium (AEQ) is a Canadian technology company, listed among the Top 5 Digital Agencies, Fastest Growing Tech Companies, and Top Employers in British Columbia. AEQ is looking for a technology leader to help shape and drive our next stage of growth. You will be a strategic partner to the CEO and business leaders, a credible adviser to clients, and a leader who develops our technical teams.

AI is changing what clients need from professional services. We want to help them make sound choices, improve how work gets done, and bring valuable solutions into production. You will help define where AEQ should lead, build the capabilities behind that direction, and create opportunities with clients.

This is an active role with substantial client involvement. You will lead senior technology conversations, help originate and win engagements, work directly on selected client assignments, and remain accountable for the quality of the solutions we propose and deliver. You will bring particular credibility to our credit union work while helping AEQ grow in healthcare, government, and other sectors.

What you will own

Set direction and build the practice

Develop and execute AEQ’s technology and AI strategy, with a focused set of priorities, investments, and measurable outcomes
Identify emerging client needs and turn them into advisory offerings, pilots and repeatable services
Build a point of view on how AI changes software delivery and the value clients expect from a technology partner
Decide, with our business leaders, where AEQ should build expertise, form partnerships, or pursue new markets
Take ownership of progress: bring the right people together, resolve obstacles, and move priorities from discussion to delivery

Create opportunities and lead clients

Build trusted relationships with senior client leaders and help them navigate complex technology and AI decisions
Work with Sales and Delivery to develop opportunities, lead discovery, and shape proposals, architectures, estimates, and delivery plans
Serve on selected client engagements as a principal architect, strategic adviser, or fractional technology leader
Connect technology choices to business outcomes, commercial realities, implementation risk, and the client’s ability to sustain the solution
Provide technical leadership from the first client conversation through delivery, especially when an engagement changes direction or encounters a difficult decision

Make AI useful and responsible

Lead AEQ’s AI initiatives with a clear purpose, committed capacity, and a small number of valuable initiatives
Work with clients and teams to identify uses of AI with a credible path from experiment to production
Establish practical approaches to human review, privacy, security, quality and measurement
Turn successful work into capabilities AEQ can demonstrate, deliver and support, not isolated experiments

Develop our people

Coach senior technologists and help them grow as architects, client advisers and leaders
Set clear expectations for technical ownership, decision-making and collaboration across teams
Strengthen engineering and architecture practices using lessons from client delivery
Help recruit people who add technical depth, sound judgment and initiative to AEQ

What you bring

A demonstrated record of initiating, winning, and delivering technology consulting or professional services work. We will ask what you personally identified, built, and brought to a result
Deep enough technical experience to earn the trust of architects and engineers, combined with the judgment to lead business conversations
Experience advising senior clients, shaping complex proposals and making commitments that delivery teams can meet
Practical understanding of modern software architecture, cloud, integration, data and AI—including where AI is useful and where it introduces risk
Experience developing technical leaders and building capabilities that extend beyond your own contributions
Commercial understanding of a services business: scope, pricing, staffing, utilization, partnerships and client outcomes

Experience with credit unions, digital banking, or core modernization is a strong advantage. We also welcome leaders with relevant experience in healthcare, government, or other complex environments. Expertise in a particular vendor platform is not required.

How you will work at AEQ

You will report to the CEO and partner closely with the leaders of Financial Services sales, Delivery, and Innovate. You will lead our technology direction while giving senior technologists meaningful ownership in their areas of expertise.

We expect approximately half your time to involve clients and pursuits as the practice develops, including paid advisory work, solution leadership and strategic presales. We will set billable and commercial targets separately so the time required to build the practice is clear.

What success looks like after six months

AEQ has a focused technology and AI plan that the leadership team and technical leads are actively executing
You have helped originate or advance meaningful client opportunities, with clear evidence of your contribution
Major pursuits and engagements have credible technical leadership, sound estimates, and clear delivery ownership
The AI pod has demonstrated a valuable capability and has a defined route to a client pilot or production use
Clients seek AEQ’s advice on consequential technology decisions, and our technical leads have grown through your coaching and trust

Why join AEQ

AEQ is at a point where a technology leader can shape what we become. You will work directly with our founder and business leaders, influence which opportunities we pursue, and help turn promising ideas into services clients use. Our work spans credit unions, healthcare, government and immersive technology, giving you room to build an AI practice with real client problems, experienced technologists and a clear path from strategy to delivery.

Compensation

This full-time executive role offers a base salary of CAD $160,000–$200,000
, plus a performance bonus tied to agreed business growth, client, and leadership outcomes. The successful candidate will also be eligible for consideration for stock option grants under AEQ’s executive stock option plan, subject to the plan terms and grant approval. The package includes benefits and support for professional development.

Who We Are: Durham Community Health Centre (DCHC) is a charitable registered organization that provides integrated, accessible, and equitable community-based primary care, wellness services, and health education for Durham community members facing barriers to health and well-being.

Who We Serve: DCHC offers equity-focused programs and services for priority populations, including Indigenous peoples, Black communities, 2SLGBTQI+ community members, newcomers to Canada, seniors, and clients without a family doctor. Provide the CEO and ELT with timely intelligence focusing on trends to support strategic decisions and performance improvement

Establish clear governance framework, milestones, accountabilities, and measures for all organizational initiatives aligned to DCHC corporate balance scorecard
Enterprise Risk, Quality & Organizational Excellence

Integrate quality, risk, performance, evaluation, and continuous improvement into one enterprise framework
Strengthen organizational resilience, accountability, and readiness for emerging challenges

Lead CEO Office strategic operating plans and priority tracking

Champion One DCHC, One Strategy, One Enterprise

The Senior Director ensures DCHC has the clarity, intelligence, discipline, and execution capability to turn strategy into measurable organizational and community collective impact.

Qualifications & Experience

Education & Certifications

Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, Business Administration, or a related field (master's preferred)
PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Change Management or a relevant performance excellence certification is an asset

Experience & Skills

Proven success in leading high-impact initiatives, enterprise-wide projects, and complex change management efforts
Strong ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into strategic action
Deep understanding of Ontario's healthcare transformation, integrated care models, and emerging policy trends
Exceptional leadership, stakeholder engagement, and executive communication skills
Demonstrated ability to lead in a collaborative, fast-moving, and high-accountability environment

What Sets This Role Apart?

This is a high-stakes, high-impact leadership role. It requires:
A strategic powerhouse who can execute with precision
A collaborative leader who thrives in a multi-disciplinary, fast-paced environment
A change agent who is comfortable leading transformational initiatives and navigating complexity
A data-driven decision-maker who can synthesize insights into actionable strategies

Leadership Growth - Competitive compensation, HOOPP pension, and ongoing professional development

Benefits

Full vaccination against COVID-19 is mandatory for this position (DCHC will however adhere to its duty to accommodate those who are unable to be fully vaccinated for a reason related to a human right protected ground).

 As part of the Group Risk Management team, the Associate Director, Global Risk Analytics is responsible for the conceptual design, development, and ongoing maintenance of the mathematical models used for the measurement and capitalization of the market risk of RBC's trading portfolio.

About The Role

Establish and lead a global ontology and semantic data strategy for the Digital Energy software organization. This role defines how products, systems, devices, points, relationships, behaviors, and operational concepts are represented consistently across the portfolio.

This is not a purely theoretical or governance-focused position. The successful candidate will combine deep semantic-technology expertise with the practical engineering ability to build and apply ontologies in real software products.

What You Will Do

Establish and lead the global ontology and semantic data strategy for DE Software.
Define a common approach to semantic modeling, entity relationships, metadata, classifications, and data tagging.
Develop practical ontologies for buildings, energy management, automation systems, and related domains.
Apply RDF, RDFS, OWL, SHACL, SPARQL, JSON-LD, and knowledge graphs where appropriate.
Establish processes for ontology development, versioning, validation, extension, and governance.
Create reusable semantic models that can be adopted across multiple products and engineering teams.
Translate operational concepts into machine-understandable models with product architects, software teams, data teams, AI teams, and domain experts.
Identify opportunities to use semantic models to improve interoperability, analytics, search, engineering efficiency, and AI capabilities.
Partner with the applied AI team to provide structured domain knowledge, grounding, and contextual relationships.
Develop reference implementations and working prototypes that demonstrate business and technical value.
Evaluate existing industry ontologies, taxonomies, schemas, and standards before creating proprietary extensions.
Build a global community of practice around ontology and semantic data.

What Will Help You Succeed

Significant professional experience with ontology engineering, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, or closely related disciplines.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing semantic models in production or product-oriented environments.
Strong understanding of RDF, OWL, semantic relationships, controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, and data classification.
Experience with data tagging, metadata management, entity modeling, and semantic validation.
Ability to explain what an ontology is, why it matters, and how it creates value for software products and customers.
Strong software, data engineering, or technical architecture background.
Demonstrated ability to influence multiple product and engineering organizations without relying solely on direct authority.
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in smart buildings, building management systems, industrial automation, energy management, IoT, or digital twins.
Experience with Brick Schema, Project Haystack, RealEstateCore, SAREF, BOT, or other relevant industry models.
Experience integrating semantic models with operational databases, event systems, APIs, analytics platforms, or AI applications.
Experience applying knowledge graphs or ontologies to retrieval-augmented generation, AI grounding, reasoning, or agent-based systems.
Experience leading an enterprise-wide semantic architecture or ontology program.
Familiarity with graph databases and semantic stores.

Highly articulate and able to create clarity from complex concepts.
Pragmatic rather than dogmatic.
Comfortable defining a long-term strategy while delivering near-term results.
A recognized expert who continues to work directly with technology.
Collaborative across product, architecture, engineering, and business teams.
Capable of becoming the trusted global authority for ontology within DE Software.

What Success Looks Like

Publish and align a DE Software ontology strategy.
Deliver an initial shared semantic model for a priority domain.
Create an ontology governance and versioning process.
Achieve adoption by one or more product or platform teams.
Demonstrate measurable value through an AI, interoperability, engineering, or analytics use case.
Establish a global ontology community of practice.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering - Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Engineering – Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns

Fitch Ratings

The Opportunity

Fitch Ratings is looking for a builder, a challenger, and a boundary-pusher to lead the engineering organization responsible for all applications and services powering our Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns lines of business. This is not a role for someone who optimizes within the status quo — it's a role for someone who questions it, reimagines it, and has the courage and capability to do something about it.

As Senior Director, you will have executive ownership of four engineering teams comprising a couple of dozen engineers. You'll lead a talented, multidisciplinary group tackling some of the most consequential technology challenges in global financial intelligence — maintaining and evolving the systems that analysts and clients depend on today, while simultaneously building the next generation of platforms from a position of real creative freedom and organizational backing.

This is a role for someone who moves fast, experiments boldly, and doesn't wait for permission to try something new. Someone who has broken things in the pursuit of building something better, who sees constraints as invitations to be clever, and who brings an infectious sense of possibility that raises the ambition of everyone around them. If you've spent time deep in machine learning or AI systems — not just using them, but building them — that's not just a bonus, it's the kind of background that makes this opportunity even more compelling. But this role goes far beyond any single discipline: it's about leading a culture of relentless innovation across every dimension of how software gets built and delivered.

We'll Count on You To

Challenge the conventional and set a bolder technical vision
Own the strategic direction, execution, and engineering culture of four high-performing full-stack engineering teams. But more than managing what exists — interrogate it. Ask the uncomfortable questions about why things are built the way they are, and lead your teams toward answers that are smarter, faster, and more powerful. Set a technical vision that doesn't just improve the current state but genuinely reimagines what's possible for the platforms powering Fitch's most critical analytical work.

Build, develop, and inspire exceptional people
Lead, mentor, and empower a team of team leads and engineers across a range of technical backgrounds and experience levels. Foster a culture where intellectual curiosity is celebrated, where experimentation is encouraged, and where people feel safe enough to take risks and learn loudly from what doesn't work. Attract and retain engineers who are hungry, inventive, and proud of both the quality of what they ship today and the audacity of what they're building toward.

Reimagine and modernize critical platforms
Oversee the full lifecycle of the applications and services central to Fitch's Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns analytical workflows. Balance the discipline of maintaining production-grade systems with the creative ambition to tear down and rebuild what no longer serves the business well. Be the person in the room who asks "what if we started over?" — and who knows when that's exactly the right call.

Drive greenfield innovation without apology
Identify and actively pursue opportunities to design and build net-new applications and platforms that replace or leapfrog legacy approaches. Embrace the blank canvas — and bring the rigor of world-class software delivery with you. This is an organization that wants to see bets placed, experiments run, and lessons learned fast. Be the kind of leader who creates that energy and channels it into things that last.

Push the frontier of AI, ML, and intelligent systems
Go beyond adopting AI tools — define how intelligent systems become structural, load-bearing parts of the platforms your teams own. Whether that's LLM-powered workflows, ML models embedded in analytical processes, agentic automation, or AI-augmented developer tooling, bring the depth to evaluate, architect, and champion these capabilities with real technical conviction. If you've built ML systems from the ground up, that experience will resonate deeply here — and you'll have the platform to apply it in genuinely high-stakes, high-visibility ways.

Influence across a complex and interconnected stakeholder landscape
Act as a strategic partner to a broad and diverse set of stakeholders — including senior leadership, analytical teams, operations, and business relationship management — whose workflows and outcomes depend directly on the platforms your teams own. Navigate a rich ecosystem of technical interdependencies, partnering with peer engineering teams whose systems integrate with, depend on, or are shaped by what your teams build. Build organizational credibility through consistent delivery, clear technical vision, and the ability to bring bold ideas to life in ways that earn trust across the business.

What You Need To Have

18+ years of hands-on software engineering experience , with substantial time in senior technical leadership roles overseeing multiple teams and disciplines
Proven multi-team leadership — demonstrated experience leading team leads and engineers across full-stack disciplines; a track record of building high-performing, inventive engineering cultures at meaningful scale
Deep technical credibility and hands-on instinct — strong command of modern software architecture, cloud-native platforms, and production-grade application delivery; you know when to go deep, and your teams and peers will know it too
Full-stack engineering expertise — proven background with modern enterprise technology stacks, including React, Java, and/or Python in production environments, deployed across AWS and/or Azure
A bias for experimentation and innovation — a demonstrable history of pushing technical boundaries, challenging inherited assumptions, and driving teams toward approaches that are meaningfully better — not just incrementally improved
Modernization and greenfield experience — proven ability to evolve existing platforms while simultaneously designing and delivering new systems; comfort making bold architectural decisions in both constrained legacy and open greenfield environments
People leadership and talent development — demonstrated ability to attract, grow, and retain exceptional engineers and engineering leaders; a builder of teams as much as systems, with a genuine investment in the growth of the people around you
Cross-functional stakeholder management — proven ability to partner effectively across analytical, operational, and business-facing teams as well as peer technical organizations; skilled at managing competing priorities and driving alignment across a complex interdependency landscape
Executive communication — the ability to translate bold technical vision for non-technical audiences, build trust through delivery, and make complex ideas land clearly at every level of the organization
Education: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent expertise demonstrated through impact

What Would Make You Stand Out

An ML or AI engineering background — if you've spent meaningful time building machine learning systems, training models, designing intelligent pipelines, or architecting AI-native applications, that depth is genuinely exciting for this role and will shape how you lead, what you build, and the kind of talent you attract
Deep cloud-native expertise — hands-on mastery of AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, microservices architecture, and sophisticated CI/CD and deployment pipelines for large-scale application delivery

Career acceleration at scale — high visibility to the most senior leaders at Fitch, a clear path to principal and executive roles, and the opportunity to define what AI-driven financial technology looks like in practice

Black & Veatch has an exciting opportunity for a Wastewater Infrastructure Planning Business Leader

Provide technical solutions and differentiation for the Collection System Planning team focused on wastewater infrastructure planning.
Evaluation of wastewater system capacity, condition, resilience, and operating efficiency.
Analysis and projections of wastewater flows.
Use of risk-based assessments to develop and prioritize capital improvement programs.
Integration of condition assessment and asset management data into system master planning and to directly support replacement & renewal planning.

Work closely with Client Directors to leverage existing and build new relationships with clients and decision makers in the GTA and beyond.
Lead and/or support pursuit, proposal, and project interview activities.

This job posting is for establishing a newly created position.

As an employee-owned, global leader in building critical infrastructure in the energy, water, telecommunications and government services markets, Black & Veatch has a long-standing reputation for providing world-class service to our clients.

Our North American Planning & Asset Management business has seen consistent growth driven by our clients’ needs to address challenges stemming from population growth, aging infrastructure, basement flooding, system reliability and resilience concerns, the need to improve operational efficiency, and the use of “big data” to help guide decision making.  This position represents a strategic business opportunity for Black & Veatch’s Distribution & Collection System Planning team to help the company grow its market share by providing world-class wastewater infrastructure planning services.

GTA experience in client-facing roles and with GTA Wastewater systems.

Proficient with report writing and PowerPoint presentations.
Experience in developing proposals and leading technical discussions during client interviews/projects.
Experience and/or familiarity with Geographic Information System (GIS) technology and software (i.e. ArcGIS).

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Almost 1.2 million residents call York Region home, making it one of the largest regions in Canada – and the fastest growing with a population that’s expected to grow to more than 2 million by 2041. Our geography, which is comprised of about 1,800 square kilometers over nine different municipalities, is as beautiful, interesting and diverse as our people. Local government is organized in a two-tier structure and we work together with our local municipalities to provide residents and businesses access to a broad selection of services and resources.

WHAT WE OFFER

Consistently named one of Canada’s Best Employers by Forbes, we offer a collaborative, progressive workplace that takes pride in our organizational culture and is committed to living The 13+ Factors of Psychological Health and Safety in the Workplace – aligned with our vision to create strong, caring and safe communities both within and outside our walls.

Defined Benefit Pension Program - With the Ontario Municipality Employees Retirement System (OMERS) defined benefit pension plan, you can confidently retire knowing that you will have income for life. Eligibility from date of hire as a full-time employee and includes employer-matched contributions. Employer of Choice - Recognized as the highest-ranking government employer in Canada and fourth overall among 300 organizations.

Benefits and Wellness - Employees and their loved ones have access to a comprehensive employer-paid benefits plan that includes extended health, dental and life insurance, access to a 24/7 Employee and Family Assistance Program and corporate discounts and purchase plans for day-to-day products and services.

Inclusive and Diverse Workforce - We’re committed to fostering an environment that celebrates all dimensions of diversity and ensures everyone can develop to their full potential, participate freely in society and live with respect, dignity and freedom from discrimination. Our robust Inclusion, Diversity, Equity and Accessibility program continues to grow, and has been recognized by the United Nations and many other organizations for our leadership.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting to the General Manager, Paramedic & Seniors Services, is responsible for the oversight of program planning and operational policy development for the branch including the developing and implementing a strategy for data, quality assurance and analysis needs to ensure value to drive continuous improvement processes and business decisions; man aging compliance and reporting metrics to quantify service quality standards, key performance indicators (KPI’s) and benchmarks; supporting operational divisions in the investigation of clinical performance concerns/issues; leading the development and implementation of the Paramedic & Seniors Services capital planning and delivery (asset management plans and facility maintenance) in consultation with Property Services; overseeing all contracts, agreement and procurement activities; supporting strategic planning, communication planning and budgeting for the branch; acts as Branch liaison with the Commissioner’s office on Department Strategic Planning and Performance; and overseeing branch information technology projects and on-going technology requirements in coordination with Information Technology (ITS) and Integrated Business Services (IBS) Branch.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Business/Strategic Planning, Budget and Financial Management Functions:

Responsible for the overall direction, goal and strategy setting, development of objectives, and for providing leadership oversight to policies and procedures for all of the division’s areas of business related to operational planning services.
Develops and monitors annual and multi-year branch budgets and business plans, grant application process for funding; and coordinates submission of the Branch budget with the support and guidance of the IBS and in accordance with Regional guidelines and by-laws.
Develops the division’s annual business plan, oversees implementation and monitors the action plan for achieving results, regular evaluation of targets and outcomes, taking corrective action where/when necessary and regularly reporting on progress.
Leads Branch management staff through a process of planning and developing long range objectives and continually promotes on-going management commitment to continuous improvement with respect to the division's areas of business.
Oversees preparation of branch decision documents for regional council and the Commissioner of Community and Health Services, including council reports, business cases, and briefing documents.
Coordinates Branch input into Corporate and Department strategic plans.

Data Analysis, Reporting, Quality Assurance and Performance Management Functions:

Leads Branch data strategy development and implementation in alignment with the Department and Corporate strategic initiatives
Develops and implements overarching short and long-term business plans and strategies related to data collection, analysis and metrics to ensure that data provides value add to support and drive future business decisions.
Oversees data and trend metrics, data analysis and CQI metrics required to define service trends, service gaps; utilizes data to determine the need for process reviews and process changes; and determines the applicability of data to support decision making related to programs and services.
Provides oversight to the development of reports on a variety of data analysis and metrics for senior management to support business decisions, resource needs and service delivery improvement.
Oversees the completion and submission of provincial and regional reporting requirements within the Branch
Leads the implementation of quality improvement frameworks for branch operations including quality assurance activities to monitor program effectiveness and support continuous quality improvement.
Oversees development of key program performance metrics; works with management staff to implement programs and manages performance to meet or exceed targets.
Oversees the attainment of accreditation requirements of Seniors Services with accrediting organizations and participates on provincial task force/committees or compliance reviews on issue (s) as directed.

Contracts and Procurement Management Functions:

Oversees the management of all aspects of the procurement processes and contract requirements for the Branch to ensure that all current and future goods and services requirements are met in consultation with Corporate Procurement office, IBS, Legal, Insurance & Risk and Finance.
Leads all procurement plans for the Branch and develops short / long term strategies to meet operational requirements.
Ensure adherence to the Region’s Purchasing By-law, policies and guidelines.

Capital Delivery, Asset Management and Technology Support Functions:

In partnership with the Property Services and the IBS branches, oversees the development and implementation of capital plans for Paramedic & Seniors Services facilities and in consultation with key stakeholders related to the building or replacement of Paramedic & Seniors Services facilities.
Provides oversight to the implementation of comprehensive systems and programs in the management and maintenance of branch facilities in accordance with legislation and regulations, and internal policies, including risk management and in partnership with Property Services and the Integrated Business Services (IBSB) branches.
Directs the development, implementation, and monitoring of Branch technology systems, processes and practices, including hardware/software requirements in collaboration with ITS and IBSB; liaises with vendors, consultants and provincial staff to integrate and implement communication and data base systems.
In partnership with ITS and the IBS branches, leads and manages project teams, technical and user support for the development, implementation, and evaluation of systems and related technology and network applications and voice/data communications that support programs and fleet, and makes recommendation on technology requirements.

4. Human Resource Management and Team Leadership Responsibilities:

Supervises staff, including recruitment, selection, hiring, assigning work, determining training and development needs, conducting performance appraisals and determining/recommending disciplinary action up to and including dismissal, in accordance with collective agreements, Regional policies and practices; ensures adherence to appropriate Regional HR policies and government legislation.

Communication, Liaison and Customer Service Activities:

In consultation with Strategic Department Communications, coordinates Branch internal and external branch communication planning activities
Represents the branch on negotiations with consultants, contractors, external agencies/groups, local municipalities, etc., as directed.
Chairs and/or participates on committees, task forces, working groups and special projects; represents the Region on external committees, meetings, as required.
Prepares Committee and Council reports as well as the preparation of detailed technical reports required for all processes, standards and materials required for project/program approval.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Successful completion of a University Degree in Business, Health, Public Administration, or a related discipline, or approved equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of seven (7) years’ program planning and administration experience, including significant direct senior managerial experience that includes, capital planning and delivery, budget administration and business planning, strategic planning, policy development and implementation, procurement, and experience managing data and quality improvement initiatives, including a minimum of three (3) years’ of direct senior managerial experience that includes program, financial, budget administration and human resource management.
Demonstrated knowledge of applicable legislation, municipal and Regional government organization and structure, industry standards, issues and communities served.
Knowledge of and demonstrated ability in strategic planning, change management design, process and implementation strategies to optimize both quality and cost-effectiveness of services.
Demonstrated political acumen and ability to negotiate, mediate, facilitate and present information to a varied audience.
Knowledge of and demonstrated ability in strategic planning, change management design, process and implementation strategies to optimize both quality and cost-effectiveness of services.
Demonstrated knowledge of the provincial health care system and experience working with local health care providers.
Demonstrated knowledge and application of financial budget and business planning processes.
Strong analytical, problem solving, decision making, report writing and presentation skills.
Computer literacy in a Windows environment utilizing Microsoft Office applications.
As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to provide a satisfactory Police Vulnerable Sector Check (PVSC), tuberculosis screening and proof of immunization in accordance with the Fixing Long-Term Care Act (FLTCA), 2021.
A valid Class “G” drivers’ license, clear of serious offences under the Highway Traffic Act.

jobs.title: (CAN) Senior Director, Digital Strategy and Media
jobs.description:
Position Summary...
The Senior Director, Digital and Media is responsible for setting and leading Walmart Canada’s enterprise growth marketing strategy across online and offline media, SEO, and customer engagement.

This role is accountable for building an integrated, full-funnel growth engine that drives customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, and lifetime value across omni-channel and eCommerce businesses, ensuring marketing investments are aligned to core business priorities and deliver measurable impact. Operating as a senior enterprise leader, this role sets growth priorities, governs investment decisions, and establishes performance standards that guide how media and customer engagement drive business outcomes.

What You'll Do...

Define and own Walmart Canada’s holistic growth marketing strategy across Paid Media, SEO, CRM, Walmart Delivery Pass acquisition and retention, and customer lifecycle management, ensuring alignment to enterprise business priorities.
Strategic leadership across owned marketing media investments for both Store and eCommerce, as well as advertiser-funded offsite retail media programs through Walmart Connect, ensuring media strategies are aligned to Walmart Canada business objectives while delivering measurable value for advertising partners.
Set the strategic vision and operating model for Walmart Delivery Pass marketing, including member acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and value communication, in close partnership with Product and Membership teams.
Lead customer engagement strategy across CRM channels (email, push, in-app, SMS, personalization, and others), defining lifecycle frameworks that drive frequency, retention, lifetime value, and customer advocacy.
Own enterprise SEO strategy across eCommerce, ensuring organic traffic growth complements paid media, improves efficiency, and strengthens long-term customer acquisition.
Own the enterprise measurement vision across media, CRM, SEO, and Walmart Delivery Pass, establishing KPI frameworks, attribution models, experimentation standards, and incrementality approaches that clearly quantify growth impact.
Provide executive oversight of marketing investment across paid media, lifecycle channels, and membership marketing, ensuring disciplined prioritization, trade-off decisions, and ROI optimization.
Serve as a senior marketing leader partnering with eCommerce, Merchandising, Membership, Walmart Connect, Analytics, Finance, Product, and Technology to align growth priorities, roadmaps, and investment decisions.
Leadership of multi-disciplinary internal teams and agency partners across media, customer engagement, SEO, and measurement, establishing modern operating models, performance standards, and capability roadmaps, while building strong talent pipelines and succession plans that scale with business growth.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of progressive experience across growth marketing, media, customer engagement, or digital commerce, including senior leadership roles.
Proven experience managing directors and senior leaders across multiple marketing disciplines.
Deep expertise in paid media, SEO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, and membership-based growth models.
Strong understanding of MarTech and AdTech ecosystems, measurement, attribution, experimentation, and privacy-safe data usage.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex performance data into executive-level insights and decisions.
Experience in retail, grocery, subscription, or omni-channel environments strongly preferred.

Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Builds high-performing teams; seeks, and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas and experiences; creates a workplace and experiences where all associates feel seen, supported and connected through culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all.

Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; builds the talent pipeline, fosters an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work, empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company, and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments; supports strategies and drives initiatives that attract and retain the best talent.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by taking action to advance opportunity, sustainability, community, and integrity (e.g., creating fair opportunities for associates and suppliers, driving local giving efforts).

Ensures that teams follow the law, our code of conduct and company policies; promotes an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns, and models our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action, and enables others to do the same; holds self and teams accountable for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Acts as an altruistic servant leader and is consistently humble, self-aware.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers expected business results while putting the customer first and consistently applying an omni-merchant mindset and acting with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a holistic perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans and implementing strategies.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions, and fosters an environment that supports learning, innovation, learning from mistakes, and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Drives continuous improvements, supervises the adoption of new technology, and supports digital disruption in line with Walmart’s business model.

jobs.title: Director, Talent Management & Workforce Insights
jobs.description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer and serving as a member of the HR Leadership Team, the Director, Talent Management & Workforce Insights
leads a broad enterprise portfolio spanning Total Rewards, Organizational Development, HR Operations and People Analytics. The role is accountable for the ongoing evolution of the firm's people programs, systems and enterprise HR services, ensuring they support business priorities and deliver a consistent and high-quality experience for our people.

Working closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition and leaders across the firm, the Director translates the firm's people strategy into practical, scalable and measurable outcomes. Through workforce insights, organizational expertise and disciplined execution, the role enables better people decisions across the firm while helping leaders strengthen organizational and business performance.

Key Accountabilities

Portfolio Leadership

Lead the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio, establishing clear priorities, accountabilities and measures of success.
Translate the firm's people strategy into firmwide initiatives, investments and outcomes that support business objectives.
Use market intelligence, workforce data and business insights to identify, inform and translate opportunities, strategies, risks and decisions into practical recommendations.
Ensure programs, systems and services operate as an integrated portfolio that delivers value for the business and our people.
Drive the ongoing evaluation and continuous improvement of enterprise people programs, policies and services.
Foster strong collaboration across HR to ensure firmwide solutions are practical, scalable and responsive to business needs.

Total Rewards, Performance & Wellbeing

Provide strategic leadership for the firm's Total Rewards portfolio, including compensation, recognition, benefits, wellbeing and performance management.
Ensure rewards programs remain competitive, sustainable and aligned with business priorities, market trends and workforce expectations.
Oversee the design and evolution of reward, recognition and performance practices that support attraction, retention, engagement and a high-performance culture.

Workforce Insights & Analytics

Advance the firm's workforce insights capability by evolving People Analytics into a strategic source of insight and decision support.
Identify workforce trends, risks and opportunities through reporting, analytics and data-driven analysis, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Strengthen workforce data governance, analytics capability and evidence-based decision-making across HR programs, workforce planning and talent strategies.

Organizational Effectiveness & Development

Lead the evolution of the firm's organizational effectiveness agenda, ensuring BDO has the leadership, organizational capabilities and workforce readiness required to support future business needs.
Partner with business leaders and HR Business Partners to strengthen leadership effectiveness, team performance, organizational design and change readiness across the firm.
Advance scalable organizational development practices that help the firm adapt to changing workforce expectations, emerging technologies and evolving business priorities.

HR Operations & Service Excellence

Provide strategic leadership for HR operations, systems and service delivery, ensuring efficient, consistent and high-quality support for employees, leaders and HR teams.
Modernize HR processes and ways of working by leveraging technology, automation and AI to improve efficiency, user experience and business outcomes.
Establish service standards, governance and performance measures that promote accountability, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder Relationships & People Leadership

Build trusted relationships across the firm and serve as a strategic advisor on talent, workforce and organizational matters.
Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation.
Strengthen leadership capability, succession and organizational effectiveness across the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio.

What You Will Help Us Achieve

Success in this role means:

A connected and high-performing Talent Management portfolio that delivers measurable value to the business and our people.
Modern, competitive people programs that support attraction, retention, wellbeing and performance.
A workforce insights capability that enables stronger business, talent and workforce decisions.
Enhanced organizational effectiveness and readiness for future business challenges.
Efficient, scalable and employee-centric HR operations and services.

What You Bring

Significant senior HR leadership experience within a complex organization, including leadership of multiple enterprise talent management or centre-of-expertise functions.
Experience leading complex talent management portfolios, combined with deep expertise in one or more areas such as Total Rewards, People Analytics, organizational development, workforce planning or organizational effectiveness.
Experience leading the design, evolution or transformation of enterprise HR programs, functions or operating models.
A track record of using workforce data, analytics and organizational insights to influence business decisions and improve outcomes.
Demonstrated curiosity and innovation mindset, with evidence of challenging traditional approaches and identifying opportunities to improve employee experience, organizational effectiveness and business outcomes.
Strong understanding of emerging workforce trends and technologies, including artificial intelligence, and the ability to translate new capabilities into practical business, talent and workforce solutions.
Exceptional relationship-building, communication and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior leaders.
Demonstrated ability to align and lead diverse specialist teams, fostering collaboration, shared accountability and enterprise-wide outcomes across multiple HR disciplines.
Strong judgement and business acumen, with the ability to balance employee experience, business priorities, risk and operational realities.
Experience within professional services or another complex, relationship-driven organization would be considered a strong asset.
University degree in Human Resources, Business or a related discipline. A relevant professional designation and/or advanced degree would be considered an asset.

Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars— Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next
- shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up:
Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

Total rewards that matter:
We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

Everyone counts:
We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us.

Flexibility:
All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role.

Code of Conduct:
Our Code of Conduct sets clear standards for how we conduct business. It reflects our shared values and commitments and includes guiding principles to help us make ethical decisions and maintain trust with each other, our clients, and the public.

BDO may use artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. While these tools assist our teams, our use of AI does not replace human decision making, and all employment-related outcomes are made by BDO personnel.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (Part-Time/Fractional)
jobs.description:
BIMM is a Toronto-based agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity, building high-performing digital products and connected customer experiences for clients across automotive, financial services, telco, and retail. Our technology practice has grown quickly: today it's roughly 60 people delivering close to $13M in direct technology work each year, spanning web, mobile, and backend engineering, QA, and a growing AI practice, in support of some of BIMM's most important client relationships.

Who we're looking for

BIMM is engaging a Fractional Chief Technology Officer to help shape the next phase of our technology organization. Our technology practice is scaling quickly, in size, in the breadth of what we deliver, and in the strategic weight it carries with clients, and we want experienced technology leadership to help design the structure, leadership bench, and operating model that carries us through that growth. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, working closely with BIMM's existing technology leadership team.

This is an active role with immediate impact and a clear place on the team.

Engagement:
Part-time / fractional, 2 to 3 days per week. 6-month initial term, with option to extend. We are looking for candidates (within the GTHA) that are able to work out of our beautiful office space in the Distillery District 2 days per week

In this role you will:

Shape the structure.
Partner with BIMM's CEO and technology leadership team to design an organizational structure and operating model that scales with BIMM's growth, across strategy, roadmap, presales, and delivery.
Develop leaders.
Coach and develop BIMM's existing technology leaders, building their capability and confidence to operate at the next level as the organization scales.
Strengthen partnerships.
Build a strong, senior relationship with BIMM's key technology partners, including our work with Audi RED, and help define how BIMM's architecture and delivery teams collaborate with partner organizations.
Govern initiatives & client focus.
Establish the governance and process that lets BIMM invest in its own technology initiatives while maintaining focus on clients, spanning web, mobile, AI, and emerging technology.
Support growth.
Provide senior technical leadership on new business pitches, proposals, and client opportunities.
Shape what's next.
Partner with BIMM's CEO on what long-term technology leadership should look like as the organization continues to scale.

Success in the first 90 days:

A clear view of BIMM's technology organization, its strengths, and where structure needs to evolve to support growth.
A proposed organizational and operating model, developed in partnership with the CEO and current leadership team.
Regular working sessions established with BIMM's technology leaders.

Success in the first 6 months:

New structure and ways of working in motion.
A sustainable model in place for balancing strategy, roadmap, presales, and delivery across a growing team.
A strong, senior relationship established with BIMM's key technology partners.
A clear recommendation delivered to the CEO on BIMM's long-term technology leadership needs.

Requirements

Extensive experience leading technology organizations, ideally within an agency, consultancy, or professional services environment.
Experience leading global teams that blend local, nearshore, and offshore resourcing, and able to advise on evolving BIMM's own model.
Experience operating in a fractional, interim, or advisory capacity.
A strong track record managing complex client and partner relationships, including joint venture or embedded delivery models; automotive experience is an asset.
A leader who develops people as much as technology, comfortable coaching and building senior teams.
Broad technical credibility across web, mobile, AI, QA, and architecture (BIMM's core stack includes React, Node.js, native Swift, and Kotlin Multiplatform).
Comfortable operating at the executive table and directly with clients and partners.

Even if you don’t meet all of the above requirements, we still encourage you to apply!

What’s in it for you?

Culture: Our squad is fun, friendly and entirely egoless. Our social committee plans BIMM bashes, Tasty Thursdays and quarterly outings like candle making workshops, board game nights, Jays games and cooking classes. Our summer and holiday parties are quite memorable as well! Having Fun Everyday is one of our core values.
Belonging: Our dedicated DEI committee provides thought-provoking insights which are reflected in our work; They also organize engaging awareness activities and events to showcase BIMMER’s professional talents and personalities. What talents might you bring? :)
Growth: BIMM is part of kyu collective which gives our employees access to the network’s resources, training, offices, and more. We also prioritize your personal and professional development with opportunities like on-site Lunch n’ Learns, conferences and online courses. Love 2 Learn.

BIMM is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all applicants for employment without discrimination. Please let us know if accommodation for the recruitment or interview process is required, and we will work with you to make sure your needs are met.

AI in Recruitment

While we are exploring ways to best utilize AI in our hiring processes, BIMM currently does not use AI-enabled tools in our hiring process. All candidates are screened by humans, and approved by humans.

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

The Chief Information Officer (CIO)
is responsible for establishing and executing the firm's enterprise technology strategy, ensuring technology capabilities enable business growth, operational excellence, security, and an exceptional people experience.

Reporting to the Chief Digital & Technology Officer, the CIO partners closely with Managing Partners, business leaders, and C-suite colleagues to align technology investments and services with strategic priorities. The CIO leads enterprise technology operations, architecture, infrastructure, end-user technology services, cybersecurity enablement, vendor partnerships, and workforce planning while fostering a modern, secure, and high-performing digital workplace.

The CIO is accountable for delivering reliable, scalable, secure, and cost-effective technology services that enable our people to do their best work and support the firm's continued growth and transformation. This role requires technical depth to guide architecture, platforms, security, data, integration, and service delivery decisions, combined with the business fluency to align stakeholders around practical outcomes.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

Enterprise Technology Strategy & Business Partnership

Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy, roadmaps, investment priorities, and operating plans aligned with firm priorities and business objectives.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, Managing Partners, and business leaders, translating business priorities into practical technology initiatives with measurable outcomes and clear value realization.
Anticipate emerging technology trends and assess opportunities to leverage AI, automation, cloud, and modern workplace capabilities to improve productivity, employee experience, and business performance.
Communicate technology strategy, risks, investments, and outcomes in clear business terms and represent technology leadership in executive forums, governance committees, and strategic planning discussions.

Technology Architecture, Platforms & Modernization

Provide senior technical leadership across enterprise architecture, infrastructure, applications, integration, identity, data, cloud, and solution architecture, establishing standards and decision frameworks that support secure, scalable, resilient, and maintainable solutions.
Lead technical trade-off and investment discussions across modernization, build-versus-buy decisions, platform consolidation, integration patterns, technical debt, resiliency, lifecycle management, and total cost of ownership.
Guide the evolution of cloud and hybrid platforms, enterprise integration, data platforms, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities in partnership with data, AI, security, and business leaders.
Drive modernization of infrastructure, networks, identity and access management, endpoint and collaboration platforms, monitoring, and operational tooling, supported by disciplined delivery practices such as DevSecOps, automation, observability, and continuous improvement.
Translate complex technical issues into clear business choices, risks, investment implications, and recommended actions for senior stakeholders.

Technology Operations, Digital Workplace & Resilience

Provide strategic oversight of enterprise technology operations, infrastructure, end-user services, service management, and the modern workplace, ensuring reliable, scalable, resilient, and productive technology experiences.
Establish service standards, operating metrics, and performance expectations, using employee feedback and service insights to continuously improve the technology experience.
Lead business continuity, disaster recovery, operational resiliency, and technology adoption efforts while balancing user experience, accessibility, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.

Security, Risk, Governance & Investment

Partner closely with Information Security leadership to maintain a strong enterprise security posture while enabling business agility, ensuring technology operates within established security, privacy, risk, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
Establish and maintain effective technology governance, architecture standards, policies, controls, and risk-management practices that are measurable, auditable, and aligned with enterprise risk appetite.
Develop and manage the enterprise technology budget and strategic vendor portfolio, overseeing sourcing, contract negotiations, performance, and investment decisions to maximize business value, service quality, and cost effectiveness.

People & Organizational Leadership

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization focused on service excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Attract, develop, retain, and succession-plan technology talent capable of supporting current and future business needs, partnering with Human Resources on workforce planning, career development, and organizational effectiveness.
Foster an inclusive, learning-oriented culture where people are empowered to grow, collaborate, challenge thinking, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

How Do We Define Success for Your Role?

You bring BDO's strategy to life by leading with genuine care, focusing on what matters most, embracing progress over preservation, and fostering a culture where people can do more together.
You establish technology as a trusted business partner and strategic enabler, translating firm priorities into measurable technology outcomes.
You deliver a secure, resilient, reliable, and modern technology environment that supports exceptional employee and client experiences while enabling innovation and business agility.
You build a high-performing, accountable technology organization with the talent and capabilities required to support the firm's continued growth and transformation.
You maximize value from technology investments through disciplined planning and execution, strong governance, strategic partnerships, and continuous improvement.

Your Experience & Education

You are a forward-thinking, people-focused technology executive with significant experience leading enterprise technology functions within large, complex organizations.
You have a proven track record developing and executing enterprise technology strategies and leading significant modernization, transformation, operating model evolution, and organizational change.
You bring practical technical fluency across enterprise architecture, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, data platforms, integration, automation, identity and access management, service management, and modern workplace technologies.
You understand how AI, automation, cloud, cybersecurity, and emerging digital capabilities can be applied responsibly to improve productivity, resilience, service quality, and employee experience.
You are an exceptional communicator and business partner who can influence C-suite executives and senior leaders, translate complex technology decisions into clear business implications, and align investments to organizational priorities and measurable outcomes.
You have significant experience managing enterprise technology investments, budgets, strategic vendors, service performance, risk, governance, and operational resilience.
You bring strong leadership, talent development, and coaching capabilities, with a demonstrated ability to build inclusive, high-performing technology teams.
You are familiar with recognized technology, architecture, security, and service-management frameworks such as ITIL 4, COBIT, TOGAF, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, Zero Trust, Agile, DevSecOps, SRE, FinOps, and cloud well-architected practices.
You hold a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. An advanced degree or relevant executive technology certification is considered an asset.
Experience within professional services, consulting, or a similarly complex, relationship-driven organization is considered a strong asset.

Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars— Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next
- shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up:
Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

Total rewards that matter:
We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

Everyone counts:
We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us.

Flexibility:
All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role.

Code of Conduct:
Our Code of Conduct sets clear standards for how we conduct business. It reflects our shared values and commitments and includes guiding principles to help us make ethical decisions and maintain trust with each other, our clients, and the public.

BDO may use artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. While these tools assist our teams, our use of AI does not replace human decision making, and all employment-related outcomes are made by BDO personnel.
