About the Organization

Our client is a family-owned, international food and beverage organization with restaurant operations spanning multiple countries, including Canada. The company operates a growing portfolio of globally recognized quick-service restaurant brands.

With a strong track record of growth and an entrepreneurial culture, the organization continues to invest in its people, operations and finance infrastructure to support its expanding business across multiple entities, brands, jurisdictions and currencies.

About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking a Vice President, Finance to join its senior leadership team and play a critical role in strengthening and evolving the finance function across Canada and the UK.
Reporting to the CFO, this is a broad, highly visible leadership role that combines strategic finance leadership with hands-on ownership of core financial processes. The successful candidate will oversee financial and management reporting, FP&A and commercial finance, treasury and banking relationships, and provide financial leadership on M&A and other strategic initiatives.
The role is well suited to a finance leader who can operate comfortably at both the VP and Controller level - someone who can provide strategic insight and decision support to senior leadership while maintaining a strong grasp of the underlying financial detail and reporting infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Reporting

Take ultimate ownership of the financial and management reporting function across Canada and the UK.
Review and ensure the accuracy, integrity and timeliness of financial reporting prior to presentation to the CFO.
Oversee the preparation and review of monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting.
Partner with internal and external stakeholders, including auditors and advisors, on financial reporting matters.
Ensure appropriate reporting processes, controls and accounting policies are in place across the organization.
Provide financial insight and analysis to support senior leadership decision-making.

FP&A & Commercial Finance

Lead the annual planning, budgeting and forecasting processes across the business.
Develop and maintain the company's business plan and financial models.
Establish reporting and performance measurement frameworks that connect financial results to business decisions.
Partner with operational and commercial leaders to evaluate performance, identify trends and develop actionable recommendations.
Track performance against budget, forecast and strategic objectives, providing meaningful variance analysis and recommendations.
Support decision modelling and scenario analysis for major business initiatives.
Work closely with the UK finance team, leveraging its established commercial finance and FP&A capabilities while strengthening the Canadian function.

Cash Management & Treasury

Take ownership of cash management and treasury activities across Canada and the UK.
Develop strong relationships with banking partners and financial institutions.
Oversee liquidity, cash flow forecasting and working capital management across two countries and two currencies.
Develop improved visibility and controls around cash movements between Canada and the UK.
Provide senior leadership with clear insight into liquidity, funding requirements and cash flow.

M&A & Strategic Projects

Provide financial leadership and support throughout M&A and other strategic transactions.
Act as a key finance point of contact during transaction execution and subsequent integration.
Partner with the CFO and external advisors on financial analysis, due diligence and transaction-related activities.
Serve as the bridge between transaction execution and the operational transition of acquired businesses.
Lead or participate in other strategic finance initiatives and projects as the business evolves.

Finance Transformation & Systems

Serve as the finance project owner for the company's transition to IFRS 16 lease accounting.
Act as the primary finance point of contact for auditors, consultants and other external advisors throughout the implementation.
Lead the financial requirements and stakeholder coordination associated with the project rather than performing the underlying transactional work.
Support the organization's evolution from its current Sage ERP environment toward Sage Intacct.
Bring experience with ERP implementations, finance transformation and process optimization to help build a more scalable finance infrastructure.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be a commercially minded finance leader who combines strong technical accounting and controllership fundamentals with sophisticated FP&A and business partnering capabilities.
You will likely bring:
12+ years of progressive finance experience, with experience operating at a senior finance leadership level.
Experience leading financial reporting and controllership functions in a complex, multi-entity organization.
Strong FP&A, budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling capabilities.
Experience managing cash flow, treasury functions and banking relationships.
Experience working across multiple entities, currencies and/or jurisdictions.
Exposure to M&A, transaction execution and post-transaction integration.
Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementations or major finance systems projects.
Strong understanding of IFRS and financial reporting requirements.
Experience with IFRS 16 / lease accounting is an asset.
Sage Intacct experience is an asset; broader ERP implementation experience is highly relevant.
Interest in AI as it relates to data analysis and process automation
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with executives, operational leaders, auditors, consultants and banking partners.
A hands-on, entrepreneurial approach and the ability to move seamlessly between strategic thinking and detailed execution.
A CPA or equivalent professional accounting designation is preferred.

Food & beverage or restaurant industry experience is not required. The organization is more interested in the complexity, breadth and quality of a candidate's finance leadership experience.

jobs.title: Director, Finance
jobs.description:
About the Organization

Our client is a family-owned, international food and beverage organization with restaurant operations spanning multiple countries, including Canada. The company operates a growing portfolio of globally recognized quick-service restaurant brands.

With a strong track record of growth and an entrepreneurial culture, the organization continues to invest in its people, operations and finance infrastructure to support its expanding business across multiple entities, brands, jurisdictions and currencies.

About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking a Director, Finance to join its Canadian finance leadership team and play a key role in strengthening the organization's financial reporting and controllership capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Finance and CFO, this role will have primary responsibility for entity-level and brand-level financial reporting across the Canadian business, with a particular focus on the organization's largest brand portfolio. The Director will also oversee Canadian cash forecasting and provide financial insight and support to senior leadership.

This is a predominantly controllership-focused leadership position, ideally suited to a strong accounting and finance professional who combines technical depth with commercial awareness and the ability to operate in a growing, multi-entity organization.

While the immediate mandate is focused on Canada and core controllership responsibilities, there is meaningful opportunity for the successful candidate to expand their scope over time into group-level FP&A, commercial finance, M&A and broader strategic finance responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Reporting & Controllership

Take ownership of financial reporting across all Canadian legal entities.
Oversee the preparation, review and delivery of accurate and timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements.
Ensure appropriate accounting policies, controls and reporting processes are maintained across the Canadian organization.
Review financial results and investigate significant variances, trends and anomalies.
Ensure the integrity and consistency of financial data across entities and reporting periods.
Partner with the VP, Finance and CFO to ensure Canadian reporting meets group requirements.
Coordinate with external auditors, advisors and other stakeholders as required.
Support the ongoing enhancement of financial controls, processes and reporting infrastructure.
Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, accuracy and scalability of the Canadian finance function.

Brand-Level Reporting

Own financial reporting and analysis across the Canadian brand portfolios.
Develop and maintain brand-level reporting that provides leadership with clear visibility into financial and operating performance.
Analyze brand performance against budget, forecast and prior periods.
Provide meaningful variance analysis and identify key drivers of financial performance.
Partner with operational and brand leadership to translate financial results into actionable business insights.
Ensure consistency between entity-level accounting and brand-level management reporting.

Cash Flow & Treasury

Own cash flow forecasting across the Canadian entities.
Develop and maintain short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts.
Monitor cash requirements, working capital and liquidity across the Canadian business.
Partner with the VP, Finance and CFO on broader treasury and cash management activities.
Provide visibility into upcoming funding requirements and significant cash movements.
Support relationships with banking partners and other financial institutions as required.

FP&A & Commercial Finance

Support the annual budgeting, forecasting and planning processes.
Provide financial analysis and decision support to Canadian leadership.
Partner with operational stakeholders to understand business performance and financial drivers.
Support scenario modelling and analysis for key business initiatives.
Contribute to the development of management reporting and performance metrics.

The precise scope of FP&A and commercial finance responsibilities will evolve as the finance organization continues to develop.

Strategic & Group Finance

Support the VP, Finance and CFO on broader finance initiatives and special projects.
Provide financial analysis and support for strategic initiatives, including potential M&A activity where appropriate.
Participate in finance transformation, systems implementation and process improvement initiatives.
Contribute to initiatives designed to create greater consistency between Canadian and broader group finance processes.
Develop the capability to take on broader group-level responsibilities as the organization and the individual's experience evolve.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be a strong controllership and financial reporting leader who is comfortable operating in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment.

You will likely bring:

8–12+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including significant controllership or financial reporting responsibility.
Strong technical accounting and financial reporting capabilities.
Experience overseeing multiple legal entities and/or business units.
Experience producing entity-level and management-level financial reporting.
Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis.
Experience with cash flow forecasting and working capital management.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify the underlying drivers of financial performance.
Experience working with external auditors and other professional advisors.
Experience in a multi-entity, multi-location or complex operating environment.
ERP experience; exposure to Sage or Sage Intacct would be an asset.
Experience with finance transformation or ERP implementation would be considered an asset.
CPA designation or equivalent professional accounting qualification is preferred.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships with senior stakeholders and operational leaders.
A hands-on approach and willingness to operate at both the detailed and strategic levels.
Restaurant or food & beverage industry experience is not required. Experience within a complex, multi-entity organization is more important.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique

This role provides the opportunity to join a growing organization and take meaningful ownership of the Canadian finance and reporting function across multiple entities and brands.

The immediate mandate is strongly rooted in controllership, financial reporting, brand performance and cash forecasting, providing the successful candidate with a broad understanding of the Canadian business.

At the same time, the role has significant room to evolve. As the finance organization grows, there is an opportunity for the Director to expand into FP&A, commercial finance, M&A and broader group-level responsibilities, creating a strong path toward future senior finance leadership opportunities.

Lead end-to-end payroll transformation initiatives, including solution design, system configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities.

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

We are seeking a Senior Director of AI Solutions to lead the design, engineering, and deployment of generative AI and machine learning systems across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for building and scaling production-grade AI systems that directly drive revenue outcomes, including pipeline growth, deal acceleration, customer retention, and operational efficiency.

You will operate at the intersection of AI engineering, enterprise architecture, and go-to-market strategy, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering leaders to translate AI capabilities into measurable business value.

Lead End-to-End GenAI and ML System Delivery

Build and Lead High-Performing Teams

12–15+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science, or distributed systems engineering. 8+ years leading ML or AI engineering teams in platform or infrastructure environments. Experience with building AI solutions for Enterprise and driving value through revenue growth like New Logo’s, Recommendations for Crosssell-Upselll

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we work to weave diversity, equity, and inclusion into our work and foster a sense of belonging throughout the company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centers driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

The Building Engineering Services Business Group (BES BG) Director of Technology will work as part of our Professional Services leadership team, with the primary function of driving a strategic vision and leading a team of experts in the implementation of technology solutions across the multidisciplinary BES consulting practice. In this role, you will collaborate closely with BES leadership, Corporate Technology, operational leadership, technology leaders from throughout the organization, vendors, and other stakeholders to identify, evaluate, and deploy technology initiatives that enhance project execution, efficiency, and innovation.

This position reports to the Professional Services Director and success is measured by the development of effective technology solutions for consulting and project delivery, talent-oriented growth, fostering a technology-focused community of practice, shaping long-term strategic plans, leveraging technology as a market differentiator, and positioning HDR as an industry leader.

Primary Responsibilities

In this role, we'll count on you to:

Lead a team of technical experts to develop and execute a BES technology vision and roadmap, including strategy and investment planning.
Integrate market-driven, innovative strategies with practical implementation and risk management.
Develop communication strategies to connect BES technology professionals and inform key stakeholders.
Develop and implement communication strategies to engage and inform critical BES stakeholders of technology program, including geographic leadership and market sector leadership.
Standardize technology workflows and delivery practices to improve efficiency and quality
Promote thought leadership through strategy regarding industry awards, publications, speaking engagements, and leadership roles in technology relevant industry organizations.
Lead visioning for technology workforce of the future. Recruit, develop, and retain technology talent.
Partner with key stakeholders to identify and develop a network of Technical Experts/Subject Matter Experts as needed to support the HDR enterprise.
Work to identify programmatic hardware and software needs, such as high-powered computing and modeling, and work with corporate information technology to facilitate and implement solutions.
Develop strategies and support practice and professional discipline groups to foster technology talent collaboration and skills development.

Preferred Qualifications – experience with a few of the following is a plus:

Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, information science, systems administration, or similar related field.
Minimum of 8 years of experience with at least 5 in the consulting Architecture & Engineering industry

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

Reporting directly to the CEO, the CTO will lead the company’s technology strategy, engineering organization, product development, and adoption of engineering automation and applied AI. The role combines executive technology leadership with strong hands-on engineering judgement across software, embedded systems, electronics and hardware/software integration. The CTO will establish the company’s technical architecture and roadmap, maintain a sustainable engineering foundation and technology capability, lead complex international programs, and support demanding customers and manufacturing activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Define and maintain the company’s technology architecture, product roadmap and engineering priorities with the CEO; lead technology-selection decisions, establish technical standards, prepare engineering resource and budget plans, and manage approved resources within delegated authority.
Lead and develop the existing engineering organization, including recruitment as required, technical ownership, people development, performance management and resource allocation; maintain a scalable technical foundation and organizational capability to support current products and future growth.
Lead complex software, electronics and embedded-product programs across distributed and cross-functional teams, covering product definition, feasibility, architecture, development, integration, validation, release, manufacturing support and lifecycle maintenance.
Provide technical leadership for embedded and hardware/software co-development, including STM32 and comparable MCUs, FPGA-based systems, ARM/SoC platforms, board-level design and integration, component and peripheral selection, low-level software, device drivers/HAL, system bring-up, debugging and production issue resolution.
Lead sustained technical engagement with Mandarin-speaking customers, manufacturing operations and engineering partners, including requirements analysis, design reviews, tailored solution development, factory and system integration, project coordination, technical escalation and major issue resolution.
Lead engineering automation and applied-AI initiatives that improve development efficiency, quality and product value, including evaluation and integration of modern AI/agent technologies with appropriate validation, security, reliability controls and human oversight.
Establish project-management, development-process, quality-control and technical-risk practices appropriate for complex commercial products; monitor delivery commitments and report progress, significant risks, resource requirements and technology investment needs to the CEO.
Participate in international customer, partner, factory and project-site activities as required, including technical assessment, integration, project delivery and support.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

A master’s degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related engineering or technical discipline.
At least 15 years of technology and product-development experience in software, embedded systems, semiconductors, intelligent systems, industrial technology, automotive electronics, mobile platforms or related fields, including substantial responsibility in large-scale, cross-functional and internationally distributed R&D environments.
At least 6 years of technology-management experience with responsibility for multidisciplinary engineering teams. Demonstrated experience building or substantially scaling an engineering organization and establishing effective technical ownership, people-development, accountability and resource-management mechanisms.
A sustained record of leading large and technically complex programs across countries, time zones and engineering disciplines, with responsibility for architecture, delivery, quality and technical risk.
Strong embedded and systems-engineering background, including Linux, processor/SoC/MCU platforms, hardware/software integration, low-level interfaces, device drivers/HAL and system debugging; ability to lead architecture reviews and make sound trade-offs across performance, reliability, cost and maintainability.
Experience delivering and supporting demanding international customer programs, translating complex requirements into practical and customized technical solutions, and leading major technical issue resolution; strong understanding of mature project-management, development-process, quality-control and release practices.
Practical experience applying modern AI-assisted development and/or agent technologies to real engineering or product-development workflows, including integration, validation, effectiveness assessment and appropriate human oversight.
Advanced professional English sufficient to independently lead international technical and business meetings, architecture and solution discussions, customer coordination and professional documentation; approximately CEFR C1 level or equivalent.
Professional working proficiency in Mandarin sufficient to independently conduct technical requirements discussions, design reviews, project coordination, factory/system integration, technical escalation and complex issue resolution with Mandarin-speaking customers, manufacturing operations and engineering partners.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Interdisciplinary expertise combining electrical/electronic engineering with intelligent systems, automation, computing or AI.
Broad hands-on embedded/software experience involving ARM platforms, STM32 or comparable MCUs, FPGA-based systems, board/peripheral integration, JTAG/SWD, TRACE32 or comparable professional embedded-debug environments, together with experience integrating and maintaining open-source or third-party software in commercial products.
Experience in automotive electronics, mobile computing, semiconductor platforms, industrial/manufacturing systems or marine-related technologies; multimedia, audio/video, DSP or graphics expertise is an advantage.
Advanced AI engineering experience involving coding agents, engineering toolchain/workflow integration, reliability and security controls, performance optimization and organization-wide adoption.
Engineering-management experience in a large international technology company, with exposure to mature global project-management, quality-control and customer-delivery practices.

jobs.title: VP Senior Applied AI Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a senior technical leader specializing in building high-performance, interactive data visualization platforms and enterprise reporting engines. This is an expert-level role focused on creating advanced, web-based analytical applications that combine rich, interactive frontends with highly optimized, data-intensive backends and distributed query engines. A mandatory and critical secondary focus of this role is the design and creation of custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. You will build the bridge between LLMs/AI agents and our enterprise data layers, including Starburst, enabling AI to autonomously and securely query, analyze, and report on massive datasets.

Core Responsibilities

You will own the end-to-end design and delivery of sophisticated FinTech tools used directly by investment bankers, front-office traders, and financial analysts. This requires translating complex financial workflows into intuitive, high-fidelity web interfaces. Your primary focus will be on architecting and building highly interactive, web-based analytical dashboards using Angular and React, allowing users to slice, dice, and explore massive datasets in real-time.

A key function is leveraging Starburst (Trino) to query massive, distributed datasets with sub-second latency. You will design and implement robust backend microservices (Java/Spring Boot) optimized for low-latency data retrieval, heavy aggregation, and streaming large datasets to the frontend. Furthermore, you will be responsible for designing and optimizing scalable ETL processes to manage huge volumes of financial data.

A mandatory responsibility is to design, build, and maintain custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools. This enables AI agents and LLMs to securely interface with internal databases, APIs, and reporting engines. You will also architect enterprise-grade document generation engines using the Aspose suite to programmatically create high-fidelity financial reports from complex templates.

As a hands-on player/coach, you will deliver complex data visualizations and reporting engines while mentoring junior engineers. This includes critically reviewing and taking ownership of all AI-generated code (Java, Angular, React, SQL) to ensure structural integrity, security compliance, and production readiness, while applying a deep functional understanding of Corporate and Investment Banking (CIB) to all projects.

Key Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience:

Systems Fundamentals: Strong foundation in systems analysis, design patterns, data analysis, and the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including unit testing and CI/CD practices.
Backend Development: Extensive hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building scalable, low-latency microservices and reactive data streaming APIs.
Frontend & Visualization: Strong, hands-on experience with Angular 19+, React, TypeScript, HTML5, and Web Sockets for building interactive, data-intensive dashboards.
Data Federation & Querying: Hands-on experience with Starburst (Trino) for querying massive, distributed datasets across federated enterprise data sources.
Databases & Data Modeling: Deep experience with relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB), including physical/logical database design, data modeling, and performance tuning.
ETL & Data Processing: Proven experience designing high-throughput ETL pipelines and optimizing data flows for real-time reporting.
Enterprise Reporting: Experience building document generation engines using the Aspose suite (Aspose.Words, Aspose.Cells, Aspose.PDF).
MCP Tool Creation: Demonstrated ability to design and build custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to securely connect LLMs and AI agents to enterprise data.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Hands-on proficiency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and the ability to write structured prompts and engineer high-quality context (schemas, API specs) for AI agents.
Collaboration Tools: Strong experience with GitHub for source control and Jira for project management.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

8+ years of relevant experience
Experience designing and implementing agentic AI workflows and integrating AI agents directly into CI/CD pipelines.
A strong understanding of event-driven systems and real-time message streaming platforms like Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.

Domain

Functional understanding of Banking — able to articulate why their work matters, not just how it is built.

What Sets This Role Apart

This is not a conventional engineering role. You are expected to operate as a force multiplier — directing AI agents across multiple workstreams, validating output for production safety, and coaching others to do the same. The measure of success is not lines of code written, but outcomes delivered, quality maintained, and the team's collective capability raised.

jobs.description:
Position Description

Artificial Intelligence is reshaping every industry, transforming how organizations operate, innovate, and create value. But organizations aren't looking for more technology. They're looking for trusted advisors who can help them modernize operations, transform how work gets done, and realize measurable business outcomes.

At CGI, we're building on decades of consulting excellence, proven AI capabilities, and global innovation to help clients navigate this transformation. We're looking for a business consulting leader who can help expand that capability while influencing how we continue to bring AI enabled business transformation to market.

As Canada's largest IT and business consulting services firm, and a global leader with more than 400 offices worldwide, CGI combines the entrepreneurial spirit of a local business with the strength, scale, and expertise of a global organization. We call our employees Partners for a reason: 90% are shareholders who take ownership of our success. Here, you'll have the autonomy to influence strategy, the resources to make an impact, and the opportunity to help shape the future of consulting.

Your Role: Lead Transformation. Shape Strategy. Enable Growth.

As a Director Consulting, Business Transformation & AI, you'll serve as a senior business transformation consultant and trusted advisor, helping organizations understand how AI can create practical, measurable business value and realize sustainable value from their AI investments.

Working alongside CGI's Directors of Consulting Services, you'll bring deep expertise in business transformation and AI to strengthen client relationships, shape strategic opportunities, and guide organizations through complex transformation initiatives. Rather than owning client accounts, you'll complement our account leaders by helping clients develop transformation strategies, modernize business processes, and accelerate responsible AI adoption.

You'll also help shape the continued evolution of CGI's Business Transformation & AI consulting capabilities across the Atlantic Business Unit. Building on CGI's established consulting practice, global AI expertise, and proven client success, you'll have the opportunity to influence our strategy, evolve consulting offerings, strengthen our market presence, and help define how we continue delivering AI enabled transformation for our clients.

You'll collaborate closely with CGI's technical AI specialists, architects, and delivery teams, serving as the bridge between client business objectives and successful implementation.

If you're passionate about business transformation, executive advisory services, emerging technologies, and helping organizations prepare for what's next, we'd love to hear from you.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Client Leadership & Strategic Advisory

Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, business leaders, technology leaders, and executives on business transformation, AI adoption, and digital modernization.
Lead executive workshops that help organizations define transformation priorities, AI strategies, investment roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.
Advise clients on operating model redesign, organizational change, Responsible AI, governance, and workforce transformation.
Build trusted relationships with key client stakeholders, decision makers, and influencers, strengthening CGI's position as a trusted transformation partner.

Opportunity Shaping & Business Development

Provide business transformation and AI expertise that strengthens client relationships and shapes strategic opportunities.
Support executive presentations, discovery workshops, proposals, business cases, and transformation roadmaps.
Collaborate across CGI consulting, engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, data, and account and delivery teams to recommend and shape integrated client solutions.
Bring innovative thinking, market insight, and consulting expertise to strategic pursuits and client engagements.

Practice Leadership & Thought Leadership

Help shape and evolve CGI's Business Transformation & AI consulting capabilities across the Atlantic Business Unit.
Contribute to consulting methodologies, reusable assets, market offerings, executive workshops, and leading practices.
Mentor consultants and help build AI fluency across CGI's consulting Partner community.
Represent CGI through conferences, executive forums, industry events, and thought leadership initiatives while staying current on emerging business and technology trends.

Solution Leadership

Translate client business challenges into practical transformation opportunities enabled by AI and digital technologies.
Connect clients with the right CGI capabilities, technical specialists, delivery teams, and alliance partner solutions.
Help ensure consulting engagements deliver measurable business outcomes and long term client value.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

12+ years of experience in management consulting, business transformation, digital transformation, technology consulting, or advisory services.
Demonstrated success advising organizations on complex business transformation initiatives and translating emerging technologies into measurable business outcomes.
Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Data & Analytics, Digital Transformation, and the evolving technology landscape.
Demonstrated executive presence with the ability to influence senior client stakeholders, facilitate strategic discussions, and build trusted relationships.
Experience supporting business development through executive advisory, opportunity shaping, proposals, workshops, and strategic consulting engagements.
Comfortable collaborating with technical AI specialists and delivery teams without needing to be the primary solution developer.
Exceptional communication, facilitation, presentation, and relationship building skills.
Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Familiarity with Responsible AI, AI governance, enterprise transformation, and organizational change management.

Asset Qualifications

MBA or graduate degree in Business, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Organizational Change, or a related discipline.
Certifications in AI, Cloud, Business Architecture, Digital Transformation, Change Management, or related disciplines.
Experience working with public sector, healthcare, credit unions, financial services, utilities, or other regulated industries.
Bilingualism (English/French) is considered an asset.
Willingness to travel within Canada and internationally as required (travel estimated at 25% and primarily within Atlantic Canda).

Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $100,000–$190,000. This role is an existing vacancy.

Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. With over 20 years of service excellence, LHG is one of the largest, most trusted, and most comprehensive providers in Canada. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts, and team members in almost 400 locations coast-to-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. With that growth is a vision to be the most innovative healthcare provider in community rehabilitation, workplace health and wellness, and medical assessment services. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022.

Role Overview:

Lifemark Health Group is hiring a Director, Technology Delivery and Enablement to lead our Application Development Team and advance the modernization of our enterprise application landscape. Reporting to the VP, Engineering and Security Services, you will oversee the development, implementation, modernization, and ongoing reliability of critical business applications supporting Lifemark’s national operations.

In this hands-on technology leadership role, you will lead teams of developers, DevOps engineers, and QA specialists to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient solutions while evolving our engineering practices and technology platforms. You will champion modern approaches including cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps, platform engineering, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted software development, while improving application observability, engineering productivity, and delivery effectiveness.

Working closely with business and technology leaders, you will help shape Lifemark’s application modernization and technology strategy, including the responsible adoption of generative AI and emerging technologies, reduction of technical debt, modernization of legacy platforms, and continued evolution of our Azure ecosystem. You will also collaborate across departments, security and infrastructure teams, architecture, data and analytics, and external technology partners to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.

About You:

You are an experienced technology leader with a strong background in software and application development and a track record of leading high-performing technical teams. You combine hands-on technical depth with strong people leadership, delivery discipline, and the ability to translate business needs into secure, scalable technology solutions.

You are comfortable managing multiple concurrent initiatives, guiding application architecture and development practices, building strong cross-functional and vendor relationships, and continuously improving release management, DevOps, monitoring, quality, and reliability. You communicate clearly, develop talent, and stay current with emerging technologies and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership and Team Management

Manage the development and maintenance of Lifemark websites and enterprise applications, providing technical leadership, oversight, and execution.
Plan, organize, prioritize, and delegate work assignments; oversee team results for quality, timely delivery, and adherence to policies and procedures.
Attract, mentor, develop, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.

Architecture, Development and Reliability

Provide guidance on application architecture, UI/UX, database design, and integration with back-end applications.
Maintain high stability, uptime, and reliability of enterprise applications through robust monitoring and QA practices.
Experience leading modern DevSecOps and platform engineering practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security, observability, cloud-native architecture, and AI-assisted software development.

Project Execution and Release Management

Lead and support concurrent initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals, schedules, and quality standards.
Plan, coordinate, and execute successful software releases using disciplined release management practices.

Vendor and Cross-Functional Collaboration

Manage relationships with third-party agencies and technology vendors to deliver robust and scalable solutions.
Build strong relationships across departments to align technology solutions with business objectives and improve operational efficiency.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation

Research and evaluate emerging technologies to meet business needs and continuously enhance development practices and tools.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI technologies, including machine learning and cognitive services, for automation solutions where appropriate.

What we’re looking for:

Post-secondary education in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
10+ years of software/application development experience, including 3+ years in leadership roles.
Strong understanding of application lifecycle management, system architecture, and development methodologies.
Proficiency in .NET development, relational databases, and cloud platforms; Azure experience is preferred.
Experience managing parallel projects, with strong time-management and organizational skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Exceptional project and account management abilities, with a demonstrated ability to establish and meet schedules.
Current knowledge of industry trends and development best practices.
Collaborative mindset with proven team leadership experience.
Strong release management experience, including planning, coordinating, and executing software releases.
Demonstrated success attracting, mentoring, and retaining top talent and supporting career development and succession planning.
Proven record of maintaining high stability, uptime, and reliability of enterprise applications through robust monitoring and QA practices.
Expertise implementing DevOps best practices, including automated pipelines, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience evaluating and applying generative AI, large language models, AI agents, machine learning, and intelligent automation to improve business processes, engineering productivity, and customer or employee experiences. jobs.description:
Deputy Chief Technology Officer - Trading Firm

Funding: Series C

About The Company
Since 2017, The Company has grown into a leading digital asset market maker and infrastructure provider. Today, our team of 200+ professionals across 42 nationalities powers trading on 80+ exchanges. Operating across Capital Markets and Asset & Wealth Management divisions, we combine algorithmic trading innovation (pioneering Rust in Web3) with institutional-grade financial services. Backed by our recent Series C, we are actively building the future of digital assets through organic innovation and strategic M&A.

Role Overview
The Deputy CTO partners with the CTO to lead the day-to-day operations of The Company’s global engineering organization. You will hold near-executive authority over engineering delivery, operational resilience, organizational health, and budget across all divisions. By connecting business strategy to world-class technical execution, you will ensure our high-frequency trading and asset management platforms scale reliably, freeing the CTO to focus on long-range AI transformation and external representation.

What Success Looks Like (12–18 Months)
Operational Excellence: A unified engineering cadence (OKRs, KPIs, delivery flow) is consistently adopted across divisions, enabling VPs to operate with high autonomy.
Platform Modernization: The multi-year trading platform consolidation transitions successfully from design to MVP with clear improvements in latency and deployment velocity.
Data Governance: A centralized, group-level data capability is live with a published catalog and cross-divisional SLAs.
Regulatory & Cost Control: Engineering consistently hits all MiCA, DORA, and SOC 2 milestones while managing cloud and vendor spend against clear business-unit baselines.

Key Responsibilities
Engineering Delivery & Cadence: Run day-to-day global engineering operations. Own OKRs, monthly business reviews, and delivery pipelines. Deputize for the CTO with the Board, ExCo, and external partners.
Platform Consolidation & Data Strategy: Lead the multi-year unification of The Company's trading infrastructure across 80+ venues and 1,400+ markets. Oversee the creation of shared group data pipelines and governance.
Cybersecurity Execution & Compliance: Own the on-the-ground execution of The Company’s security and regulatory commitments (MiCA, DORA, SOC 2). Foster a "controls-by-design" engineering culture while respecting regulated divisional information walls.
Talent, Budget & Scale: Manage the global engineering budget, vendor relationships, and M&A engineering integrations. Mentor divisional VPs, refine career frameworks, and scale the team across Europe and the US.

Core Competencies
Scale Operational Leadership: Proven ability to design and run engineering operating models (metrics, governance, delivery) for global teams.
Technical Depth & Decision-Making: Comfortable challenging senior architects on system design and making decisive, firm-wide trade-offs under constraints.
Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical risks, budgets, and timelines into crisp, actionable insights for ExCo and the Board.
Regulatory Execution Fluency: Expert at translating high-level security strategies into practical, everyday engineering workflows and compliance outcomes.

Key Experiences & Target Background
Trading & Crypto Infrastructure: Substantial experience with low-latency distributed systems, algorithmic trading infrastructure, and digital assets (CEX/DEX market structure, custody, on-chain settlement). Familiarity with Rust is a strong plus.
Multi-Division Scale & Consolidation: Proven track record running global engineering across multiple business lines, including executing large-scale platform consolidations and managing shared data/infra functions.
Regulated Environments: Experience operating within strict regulatory frameworks (MiCA, DORA, SOC 2) and managing engineering across compliance-driven information walls.
Operational #2 Profile: Prior experience as a trusted senior deputy or operational partner to a technical founder or CTO, taking true ownership of execution while strategy is held by the principal.
Growth & M&A Integration: Experience scaling engineering organizations through rapid maturity phases and integrating acquired technical teams.

What We Offer

We recognize that elite engineering leadership requires a world-class environment. As a key executive, this is a highly influential role where you will drive our overarching technology strategy, shape the engineering culture, and have the direct ability to make major company decisions.
To support your success, we offer a top-percentile compensation and benefits package designed for global leaders:
Financial & Equity

Competitive Base Salary:
A highly attractive, top-market base salary reflective of elite engineering leadership in the proprietary trading and HFT space.
Stock Option Plan:
Significant equity participation, giving you a vested stake in the long-term success and growth of the firm.

A highly lucrative, discretionary annual bonus structure tied directly to firm and individual impact.

Ultimate Working Flexibility:
Choose the environment where you perform best, with fully remote, hybrid, or premium office-based options.

The seamless ability to travel to, work from, and collaborate across our international office hubs.

Full statutory benefits, pension contributions, and leave entitlements tailored to maximize the standards of your country of residence.

Fully funded company offsites and leadership retreats to foster strategic alignment and innovation.
Company Socials:
Regular regional team events and socials to build deep relationships across our engineering and trading desks.

Position Title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Founding Financial Partner

Employment Classification: Executive Co-Founder / Equity-First (Vesting Matrix Triggered)

THE MANDATE AND THE STANDARDS
Our Lord's Kingdom INC. is a dual-incorporated federal entity transitioning from an agricultural foundation into a high-volume Modern Method of Construction (MMC) footprint. We have engineered proprietary light-gauge steel structural panel systems paired with non-combustible Magnesium Oxide (MgO) composite cores to undercut legacy stick-built developers and permanently rewrite housing security models across Canada.
Our Year 1 scaling matrix dictates a rapid, uncompromising expansion requiring the direct and indirect recruitment of nearly 100 industrial fabrication specialists, certified field installers, and corporate logistics personnel. We do not require a standard accountant or a passive portfolio manager. We are headhunting an institutional-grade financial architect to command our balance sheet, manage deep capital stacks, and bare the company's teeth to commercial lenders.
CORE OPERATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Capital Procurement: Commandeer, engineer, and defend the absolute financial underwriting portfolios for an immediate, high-volume Canada Small Business Financing (CSBF) loan application and commercial credit lines with primary Schedule 1 Banks.
Sovereign Grant Administration: Systematically orchestrate, model, and draw down multi-tier funding streams, maintaining absolute compliance infrastructure with FedNor's Regional Homebuilding Innovation Initiative (RHII), the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation (CMHC) MLI Select framework, the Build Canada Homes accellerator grant, and Transfer Payment Ontario (TPON).
Governance and Risk Mitigation: Enforce absolute corporate treasury audits, risk mitigation metrics, and multi-jurisdictional tax compliance frameworks under the Canada Business Corporations Act (CBCA).

COMPENSATION, EQUITY, AND PROTECTIVE BYLAWS
Initial Compensation: 20% Founding Equity Allocation issued exclusively via Class B Common Non-Voting Shares.
Bylaw Firewall Protection: All executive equity is strictly subject to a 36-month Milestone-Based Vesting Schedule, contractually tied to verified capital procurement and plant operational targets. Under Chapter 4 of the Federal Articles of Amendment, Class B shares carry zero voting power on corporate resolutions, securing absolute visionary command to the holder of Class A Voting Shares in perpetuity.
Cash Backstop Activation: An industry-competitive corporate executive salary matrix, retroactive adjustments, and performance bonuses automatically unlock the exact business day the initial commercial credit line or milestone grant draw is executed by the financial institution.

CANDIDATE ENTRY PROFILE
Proven, auditable history directing commercial financing, investment banking infrastructure, or high-volume capital procurement within the industrial manufacturing, logistics, or large-scale construction sectors.
Flawless personal and corporate credit registry profile, with zero active consumer defaults or regulatory disclosure issues, required to pass rigorous Schedule 1 Bank underwriting audits immediately.
Complete alignment with an aggressive, unyielding execution timeline; built to handle high-stress institutional barriers and drive capital timelines head-first without hesitation.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS
Submit a comprehensive professional dossier detailing total lifetime commercial loan procurement volumes, verified capital stack designs, and infrastructure financing backgrounds directly to the Chief Executive Officer.

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. Our Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) team provides strategic and financial partnership to EA’s Leadership team. We achieve this through engaging with our partners to influence and help deliver our broad strategy, providing strategic decision support and insights to guide EA’s performance.  

This Sr. Finance Director will lead business support for our central EA Studios organizations, serving as:

An embedded and trusted senior advisor to Studio & Franchise businesses & teams; and
An experienced & demonstrated leader in the Global Finance organization, contributing to strategic functional initiatives and transformation.

Supported by a team of ~10 employees, you will report to the Vice-President of FP&A, EA Studios, while partnering closely with EA Studios central leadership. You will work a hybrid work model defined as 3 days a week in an EA office.

Responsibilities

You will partner with senior leaders across the business, including our SVP / General Managers, Heads of Operations & Publishing, Executive Producers and their leadership teams to support all financial elements associated with the successful strategy execution of our central EA Studios organizations, including Central Development Partners (CDP), Central Technology and TRACAB. Additionally, this role will own consolidated EA Studios planning & reporting, portfolio & performance management, and investment prioritization to support organization-wide decision-making.

Business Partnership:
Partner closely with studio and finance leaders to drive the business and ongoing value creation & profitable growth. Provide actionable insights with a lens towards strategic execution and return on investments.
Manage the holistic health of our various & collective EA Studio business, including full P&L responsibility.
Lead the financial planning process, including the long-range, annual, and in-year planning cycles. Partner cross-functionally to develop& manage operating metrics that support financial planning. 
Manage other recurring, enterprise processes on behalf of EA Studios, including title plan, investment prioritization & gating, management reporting.
Drive regular communications with President / Chief Studios Officer, COO EA Studios, and broader EA Studio Leadership Team to ensure connectiveness on activities above and facilitate alignment &key decision-making.
Establish and track performance measurements across all major offerings and projects.
Provide ad-hoc financial and decision support analysis in service of strategies & performance.
Serve as a leadership partner on behalf of EA Studios FP&A with other Finance teams / disciplines, including Enterprise & Experiences FP&A, Finance Transformation, Controllership.
Organizational Leadership:
Lead the team responsible for financial planning, budgeting and forecasting processes across central EA Studios, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives and strategic initiatives.
Develop a high-performing FP&A team, fostering a culture of analytical rigor, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Contribute meaningfully at a leadership level to recurring, key Finance initiatives to evolve and improve our organization & impact.
Help lead & support EA Studios FP&A communications and recurring activities.

Qualifications

12+ years of progressive finance experience, including leadership in senior-level roles.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Advanced financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with hands-on experience using modern ERP and FP&A planning platforms.
Experience utilizing AI and technology solutions to improve financial processes, analytics and decision-making.
A people leader invested in the team's success and building an inclusive environment.
Excels in a dynamic business environment and can resolve complex business issues.
Builds trust, diverse relationships, and can move beyond reporting to synthesis and insight.
Experienced in evaluating performance metrics and implementing action plans.
Proven track record managing businesses & organization sat scale across a distributed team.
Strong business acumen with a strategic mindset, passion for innovation & transformation, and the ability to challenge self, teams & partners to grow & improve.

Pay Transparency - North America

Description

Senior Director, Business Architecture and Innovation

CTO Office – Information Technology Vice-Presidency (ITVP)

Build the Future with Us

Position Context

At a time when emerging technologies, new delivery models, and evolving customer expectations are reshaping financial services, the Information Technology Vice-Presidency is seeking to strengthen, within the CTO Office, its ability to connect corporate strategy, business capabilities, and transformation roadmaps.

Reporting to the CTO Office, the Senior Director, Business Architecture and Innovation plays a critical role in turning emerging signals into tangible impacts, actionable roadmaps, and meaningful experiments for the organization. The incumbent embodies an outward-looking CTO perspective, helping guide transformation decisions in close collaboration with business sectors, without replacing business leaders in defining business models or making business investment decisions.

Your Mission

The Senior Director, Business Architecture and Innovation
is responsible for leading a comprehensive and coherent enterprise business architecture that supports the corporate strategy and organizational transformation initiatives. Acting as both a strategic advisor and a bridge-builder between strategy, business capabilities, and execution, the incumbent monitors emerging trends, evaluates their relevance to iA, proposes evolution roadmaps, and structures experiments that test today what could transform the organization tomorrow.

In complement to the Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture, this role is responsible for business capabilities and value stream architecture, while the other role oversees enterprise technology directions, principles, and architectures.

What You Will Accomplish With Us

Business Architecture

Define and maintain an enterprise-wide business architecture vision encompassing business capabilities, value streams, key processes, and transformation initiatives.
Anticipate the evolution of business capabilities required to support organizational growth and operational efficiency, identify gaps with current capabilities, and guide the paths needed to develop them.
Develop and maintain, in collaboration with business sectors and key stakeholders, business architecture roadmaps that connect corporate strategy, business capabilities, and execution.
Ensure alignment among sector priorities, enterprise capabilities, and transformation roadmaps while supporting strategic trade-offs and key decisions.
Define business architecture standards, artifacts, tools, approaches, and methodologies to support consistent, comparable, and decision-oriented architectural viewpoints across iA.
Contribute, when required, to executive narratives supporting transformation initiatives presented to decision-making bodies.

Strategic Foresight and Innovation

Maintain an active watch on technological, competitive, societal, and organizational trends that may influence the future of financial services.
Identify emerging signals and translate their implications for business capabilities, processes, and target architectures to inform organizational transformation decisions.
Translate observed trends into tangible impacts on business capabilities, processes, platforms, and enterprise transformation priorities.
Contribute to assessing the impact of artificial intelligence and autonomous agents on business capabilities.

Translating Strategy into Capabilities and Execution

Translate strategic directions into business capabilities, transformation roadmaps, implementation paths, and tangible outcomes that can be leveraged by business sectors and the Project Office.
Ensure alignment between corporate strategy, business priorities, organizational capabilities, investments, and transformation initiatives.
Act as a bridge between business leaders, IT teams, and the Project Office to ensure strategic ambitions are translated into executable and clearly understood transformation roadmaps.

Foster a shared understanding among business leaders, IT teams, the Project Office, and partners.
Contribute to aligning business, data, technology, and innovation strategies in collaboration with enterprise architecture, without duplicating its role in technology foundations.
Work closely with the Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture to align business and innovation roadmaps with iAFG’s IT strategy led by Enterprise Architecture.
Collaborate with the leader responsible for Business Models and Business Intelligence by providing a business architecture perspective (capabilities, value streams, and transformation paths) that supports value creation hypotheses, without assuming responsibility for business model design or investment decisions.

Strategic Alignment and Architectural Positioning

Ensure alignment between corporate strategy, business capabilities, and business architecture decisions.
Provide business architecture recommendations and contribute to strategic initiatives presented to the CTO and executive leadership, making impacts, dependencies, and options visible.
Support decision-making by clarifying gaps between strategic ambitions, current capabilities, impacts, dependencies, and implementation options.

Leadership and Team Development

Provide strong leadership to directors and teams through clear direction, senior expertise, and empowerment.
Bring stakeholders together around a common understanding of emerging trends, transformation priorities, and experimentation initiatives.
Develop future-ready capabilities in business architecture, strategic foresight, experimentation, and innovation.

What Will Help You Succeed In This Role

Education and Experience

Relevant university degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Innovation, or a related field.
Significant experience in business architecture, innovation, or organizational transformation, ideally within a complex business environment.
Knowledge of the financial services industry (an asset).
Understanding of emerging technologies and modern transaction models (real-time processing, automated workflows, digital platforms), as well as their potential applications to business capabilities, platforms, processes, and the evolution of financial services.
Demonstrated ability to gain alignment and drive decisions without formal authority among business leaders, technology teams, and executives.

Strong business acumen, strategic curiosity, and an innovation mindset.
Ability to bring together strategy, business, technology, and financial services perspectives.
Ability to translate strategic directions and emerging trends into roadmaps, business capabilities, experiments, and actionable transformation paths.
Strong analytical and synthesis skills with the ability to put complex issues into perspective.
Clear communication and influence at strategic levels.
Ability to mobilize stakeholders around a shared vision.
Results-oriented approach focused on experimentation, value creation, and transforming ideas into meaningful learning and outcomes.
Understanding of artificial intelligence systems, including autonomous agents and their implications for business processes.
Advanced proficiency in both French and English, as the incumbent will be required to collaborate daily, both verbally and in writing, with unilingual English-speaking partners, teams, and stakeholders across Canada and internationally.

With a company culture rooted in collaboration, expertise and innovation, we aim to promote progress and inspire our clients, employees, investors and communities to achieve their greatest potential. Our work is the catalyst that helps others achieve their goals. In short, We Enable Possibility℠.

Job Summary

Reporting to the VP Finance, the Director of Finance will be responsible statutory and external reporting, corporate income taxes and financial audits. This role ensures financial information is prepared in accurately and on a timely basis and that appropriate internal controls are in place.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

Lead IFRS quarter end reporting process and ensure that Canadian statutory reporting requirements are met. This includes the preparation and filing of the annual and quarterly regulatory financial returns (P&C1, MCT), annual audited IFRS financial statements and auditor’s reports and other financial returns required by the regulators.
Work with the SVP Actuary to ensure that actuarial data inputs for the regulatory financial returns and MCT capital returns are reviewed and reconciled to the general ledger.
Work with external consultants to ensure that IFRS 17 SAS data inputs and outputs for the regulatory financial returns are prepared, reviewed and reconciled within the agreed upon reporting timelines.
Prepare quarterly IFRS financial statement analysis and commentary, including preparation of materials for the quarterly Board of Directors meetings.
Oversee the corporate tax function including the preparation of quarterly Canadian and USGAAP tax provisions, corporate tax remittances and providing external tax consultants with relevant working papers for the annual Canadian corporate tax filings.
Prepare annual financial statements, notes to the financial statements, shells and all necessary disclosures for external auditors.
Manage, coordinate and ensure successful completion of external and internal audits including external financial statement audits, corporate tax external audits, internal audits of the Finance function for SOX and internal audits of the MCT capital return for OSFI. This includes dealing directly with auditors to resolve issues.
Assess and implement changes in Canadian IFRS, corporate taxation, OSFI regulations and other applicable accounting standards and regulations related to the P&C1, MCT, IFRS financial statements and Canadian corporate taxes.
Develop and maintain corporate accounting policies to ensure the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls over external financial reporting and SOX compliance with respect to financial reporting processes. This includes preparation of internal control documents and accounting memos relevant to Canada for USGAAP and IFRS/statutory reporting and updating these documents at least annually and as needed.
Prepare annual capital plan and quarterly reforecasts. Prepare long range plan for the Financial conditions testing.
Oversee the completion of external surveys and data requests related to statutory financial statements.
Provide support to the Chief Risk Officer by preparing the quarterly CRO risk report for the Board of Director meetings and executing on the plan to complete the finance related disclosure requirements for ESG reporting /OSFI Guideline B15 Climate Risk Management.
Provide support to the SVP Actuary by filing actuarial related returns required by the regulators i.e. Appointed Actuary’s report and related schedules, external review reports, Financial Condition Testing, ORSA Key Metrics Report and Earthquake Exposure Data Return.
Initiate process improvements as necessary for IFRS accounting and reporting processes including automating of data workflows to enhance the reporting process.

Minimum 10 years of financial reporting experience
Experience in P&C Insurance accounting (including IFRS17) is essential
A high degree of technical and analytical expertise, excellent verbal, written and communication skills
Ability to work effectively with senior management and an individual who takes initiative, has a strong team orientation and able to prioritize responsibilities to meet tight deadlines with little to no supervision

Well organized, innovative with a high level of initiative; strong time management skills with the ability to establish priorities to meet tight deadlines while balancing multiple and constantly changing needs and schedules – flexibility is critical
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Detail oriented, able to manage several complex processes/tasks with a high level of accuracy

CPA designation
