jobs.title: Senior Director of Data
jobs.description:
The Company

Cover Genius is the global infrastructure for embedded protection. Active in over 60 countries and all 50 US States, we protect the customers of the world’s largest digital companies, including Klarna, Revolut, Stripe, Priceline, Agoda, Booking.com, Turkish Airlines, Tongcheng Travel, eBay, and Uber, with seamless, end-to-end experiences. Cover Genius has protected more than 73M customers globally across 240M policies with USD $3.2BN in gross written sales.

Coming off a stellar year with 40% YoY revenue growth and a recent $100M capital raise, putting our valuation at $1.9BN, we are accelerating into our next phase of growth. As part of our team, you’ll help drive our AI-first roadmap, developing hyper-personalization engines, agentic distribution, and automated claims infrastructure, while building the scalable technology powering the fast-growing $70B embedded protection market.

Our people are:
Accountable, customer-obsessed, collaborative, driven

Our people are not:
Passive, defensive, siloed, hesitant

About The Role

As Senior Director of Data on our Technology team, you will own Cover Genius' data strategy end-to-end and act as domain lead for Data Products, accountable for its OKRs, roadmap, and delivery. You will work closely with our partnership teams to understand what partners need to see, and give them a clear view of how their insurance business is performing.

To drive success in this role, you will bring a genuine blend of commercial instinct, product judgement, and deep technical credibility — the breadth to lead a business domain, not just an engineering function. You will be as effective influencing at exec level, ours and our partners', as you are leading the engineers and analysts who report to you. Close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, and our own commercial and partner-facing teams will be central to the role — ensuring data becomes a trusted, reusable foundation every other domain can build on with confidence. You will treat AI as a first-class concern of the role — building a platform that AI workloads can trust, exploring AI-enhanced partner propositions, and driving AI-assisted ways of working within your own org.

Key Responsibilities

Work closely with our commercial and partner-facing teams to understand what partners actually need and want from our data, and help shape that into offers they find compelling.
Set product direction for internal and partner-facing data products, partnering with the executive and senior leadership teams to define OKRs and roadmap, and own their execution.
Own the data platform strategy and architecture end-to-end, ensuring it keeps pace as our data grows in volume, velocity, and variety — including the data foundations that AI/ML workloads across the business depend on.
Drive adoption of the data platform across business domains, so Engineering, Data, and Product teams build their solutions on a shared data foundation.
Build governance and data-quality frameworks that make our key data assets trustworthy.
Develop a high-performing Data organisation where people love their work and grow into future leaders.

What You Will Bring

12+ years in data roles spanning platform, product and B2B partner-facing work, including 5+ years leading teams of managers and senior contributors — ideally in a regulated, high-growth B2B business.
You are comfortable working alongside commercial and partner-facing teams, can hold your own in a partner conversation, and have a track record of translating what customers want into propositions that land.
You have owned a roadmap, made hard prioritisation calls between platform investment and customer-facing delivery, and can explain the calls you got wrong.
Strong record of partnering with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics and other data consumers to turn data into a trusted, reusable foundation.
Deep, hands-on architecture credibility on a modern cloud data stack — ideally GCP/BigQuery, Airflow, dbt, and data observability tooling, including experience building and operating data platforms that serve AI/ML workloads.
Proven record of establishing governance and data-quality frameworks that enable delivery rather than block it, and that are adopted across large data-centric organisations.
Practical fluency in data security and privacy in a regulated context such as insurance or financial services.

What You Will Have

Bias for action — you ship incremental improvements continuously rather than waiting for perfect conditions, act decisively, and hold a high bar for what "done" means.
Ownership without excuses — you take personal accountability for team outcomes, including the misses and talk about failures as candidly as wins.
Growth mindset — you share knowledge generously, learn from setbacks and have a track record of developing engineers and managers who go on to bigger roles.
Influence over authority — you push teams to think bigger and drive adoption of standards through credibility and clear reasoning, not mandate.
Partner and customer obsession — you're truly curious about Cover Genius' partners and trace every decision back to the customer experience or partner outcome it improves.

🤔 Why Cover Genius?

At Cover Genius, We Create Magic By Turning The Archaic Into The Extraordinary. We Take One Of The World’s Oldest And Most Complex Industries And Reinvent It With World-class Technology. Cover Genius Doesn’t Just Disrupt Legacy Insurance; We Make The Impossible Feel Effortless. Our Operating Principles Guide Our Mission

Make today matter: We deliver with urgency and excellence. We act decisively, move with intention, and hold a high bar.
Act with accountability: We own our commitments and take pride in delivering results that move us forward.
Grow together: We are a collective of curious minds. We learn from wins and setbacks, share knowledge generously, and elevate each other every day.
Inspire Each Other: We push each other to think bigger and pull together to go further.
Champion Our Customers: We lead with empathy and center the customer, turning complex disruptions into seamless moments of trust.
Flexible Work Environment - Our teams are hybrid. We work from home on a Wednesday and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times.
Don't just take our word for it - hear about our culture straight from our people here: story time.

Ready to make an impact?
If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, trusted, and empowered, we’d love to meet you.

The Legal & Privacy Stuff

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may collect, store, and process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy .

Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.

If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.

At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!

Who We Are Looking For

Sr. Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics

The Senior Director, Enterprise Data leads Vetsource's enterprise data organization and is accountable for making data a trusted, high-value business asset to drive product innovation and business performance. This role brings together data engineering, analytics, MLOps, AI engineering, and data services under a common strategy and operating model.

Working closely with business leaders, product, security, and technology teams, the Senior Director, Enterprise Data translates business priorities into governed data products, scalable platforms, meaningful insights, and AI capabilities. The role is responsible for measurable improvements in data quality, adoption, and business value for associates, customers, and industry partners.

This is a full-time, remote position .

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Data Strategy and Leadership

Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.
Partner with executive and business leaders to identify the highest-value data opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, and translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps with clear outcomes.
Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.

Data Engineering Platforms and Integration

Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.

Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.

Adopt a data product approach for priority business domains, with defined customers, accountable business and technology owners, quality expectations, service levels, documentation, and adoption measures.
Partner with business teams to define critical data domains and common metrics so teams can make decisions using consistent, well-understood information.
Ensure analytical work addresses a clear business decision or workflow and produces measurable value, not simply reports or dashboards.

AI Enablement and Adoption

Experience leading analytics and business intelligence capabilities, including governed metrics, semantic models, dashboards, experimentation, or advanced analytics.
Experience establishing data governance, catalog, lineage, quality, access, ownership, and stewardship practices in partnership with business leaders.

jobs.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis - SLC Management
jobs.description:
SLC Management is a growing global asset management firm providing innovative and diversified investment solutions to institutional investors. We are breaking new ground with a full spectrum of solutions for a growing institutional client base of more than 1400 organizations. Our history of organic and strategic growth reflects this commitment with over CA$422/US$304 billion in assets under management (AUM). As a subsidiary of Sun Life, we are aligned with one of the world’s leading financial services companies, and benefit from the stability and strength of that relationship.

We are a performance-driven organization with a deliberate focus on fostering a development-focused, inclusive culture revolving around our Core Values of being client obsessed
, valuing each other
, acting with speed
and having an owner’s mindset
. As part of our team, you play a role in fulfilling our purpose and making a difference. We offer a rewarding work environment that is filled with opportunity for growth where you will be empowered to meet the challenges of a highly competitive landscape.

Visit our website to learn more and for the most up to date AUM information.

SLC Management offers a mix of in-office and virtual work where our employees are empowered to do their best. Generally, employees are expected to work three or more days in-office each week with flexibility depending on their business, client and team needs.

Job Description:

Join SLC Management's Toronto-based team as a Director/Senior Director, FP&A in a highly visible role that extends well beyond traditional financial planning and analysis. In addition to leading management reporting, forecasting, and strategic planning, you will support investor relations, financial modeling, business analytics, and corporate strategy across a global alternatives platform. The role offers regular interaction with SLC Management's executive team, business leaders, and Sun Life partners.
This position is ideal for a commercially minded finance leader who combines analytical rigor with sound business judgment and enjoys translating complex data into actionable insights. You will thrive in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment where priorities evolve quickly, continuous learning is expected, and there may be opportunities to lead and develop finance talent.
This is a unique opportunity to help shape the financial and strategic direction of one of the industry's fastest-growing alternatives platforms. As SLC Management continues to expand across private credit, real estate, infrastructure, and fixed income, you will partner directly with senior leadership on critical growth, investment, and business decisions while building a strong platform for future career advancement.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Management reporting — Lead the preparation of monthly and quarterly management reporting packages, including AUM and fee-earning AUM roll-forwards, fee-related earnings, management and performance fee revenue, expenses, margin, and headcount, with clear commentary on drivers, trends, and variances to plan
Planning and forecasting — Own key components of the annual budget, multi-year business plan, and rolling forecast process across business units and corporate functions; partner with business leaders to build, challenge, and validate assumptions
Business and strategic planning — Support the enterprise strategic planning cycle, including long-range financial projections, growth ambition setting, capital allocation analysis, and evaluation of new products, strategies, and investment platforms
Financial modeling — Build and maintain robust, auditable models covering fundraising and deployment pacing, fee revenue build-ups, seed and co-investment capital, expense structures, product-level and client-level profitability, and scenario and sensitivity analysis
Investor relations support — Prepare analysis, talking points, and supporting materials for Sun Life quarterly earnings disclosure, investor day content, analyst questions, and peer benchmarking against publicly traded alternative asset managers
Executive and Board materials — Develop clear, well-structured presentations and written analysis for the SLC Management executive team, Sun Life senior leadership, and Board audiences
Strategy and analytics — Conduct competitive, market, and peer analysis on AUM growth, fee rates, margins, fund performance, and industry trends; deliver insight-driven recommendations rather than data alone
Business partnership — Act as a trusted finance partner to business unit leaders, investment teams, distribution, and corporate functions, supporting ad hoc analysis, business cases, and decision support
Process improvement — Drive continuous improvement in planning tools, reporting templates, data quality, and dashboards to increase speed, accuracy, and insight
Generative AI adoption — Apply generative AI and emerging analytical tools to accelerate and strengthen FP&A work — from research and peer benchmarking to drafting, model documentation, data summarization, and reporting automation — and help establish practical standards for how the team uses these tools responsibly and with appropriate review
Cross-functional collaboration — Work closely with Controllership, Tax, Capital & Treasury, Investor Relations, Human Resources, and Sun Life corporate Finance to ensure consistency and integrity of financial information
Leadership — Where applicable, manage, coach, and develop finance talent, setting clear standards for analytical quality and attention to detail

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED:

Intellectual curiosity – actively seeks to understand what drives the business, asks the next question, and pursues the “why” behind the numbers
Exceptional attention to detail – produces work that is accurate, internally consistent, and executive-ready the first time; treats precision as non-negotiable
Strong business acumen – understands alternative asset management economics, including fee structures, fundraising and deployment cycles, fee-related earnings, carried interest, seed capital, and industry KPIs
Advanced financial modeling – advanced proficiency Excel skills with the ability to build, audit, and maintain complex, well-structured models
Excel and PowerPoint mastery – strong command of Excel is essential, along with the ability to build clean, compelling, executive-ready PowerPoint materials that communicate a clear story
Generative AI fluency and curiosity – hands-on experience applying generative AI to finance or analytical work, or clear aptitude and enthusiasm to adopt it rigorously; understands both the leverage these tools create and the need to validate outputs
Analytical rigour – structured, data-driven problem solver who can move from raw data to a defensible recommendation
Executive communication – distills complexity into clear, concise narratives and presentations for senior leadership, Board, and investor audiences
Stakeholder management – credible and collaborative with senior leaders and cross-functional partners; influences effectively without direct authority
Ownership and drive – self-starter who takes initiative, manages multiple priorities against tight deadlines, and follows through
Thrives in a fast-paced environment – operates effectively under tight deadlines and shifting priorities, maintaining quality and composure when timelines compress
Commitment to continuous learning – continuously builds knowledge of new asset classes, markets, tools, and technologies; treats learning as an ongoing expectation rather than an occasional exercise, and shares that knowledge across the team
Comfort with ambiguity – thrives in a dynamic, integrating, high-growth environment with sound judgement and a solutions-oriented mindset
Integrity and discretion – handles confidential and market-sensitive information with professionalism
Leadership potential – coaches and elevates others

PREFERRED SKILLS:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field
CFA, MBA, or CPA designation is an asset
Approximately 8–12 years of progressive experience in financial planning & analysis, corporate finance, strategy or management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or corporate development
Experience in asset management, alternative investments, or financial services is strongly preferred; familiarity with real estate, private credit, infrastructure, or fixed income strategies is a distinct advantage
Demonstrated career progression, with a track record of increasing responsibility, strong performance, and measurable impact
Proven experience preparing analysis and materials for senior executive, Board, or investor audiences
Experience partnering across multiple business units and corporate functions in a matrixed organization
Prior people leadership or mentorship experience is preferred
Strong, demonstrable proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint is required — advanced modeling in Excel and executive-quality presentation building in PowerPoint; experience with enterprise planning and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Anaplan, Hyperion, OneStream, Tableau) is an asset
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot or comparable platforms) to improve analytical output, research, or productivity is preferred; genuine curiosity to apply them more rigorously is essential

Why SLC Management?

Opportunity to work for a growing global institutional asset manager
Excellent benefits and wellness programs to support the three pillars of your well-being – mental, physical and financial – including generous vacation and sick time, market-leading maternity, parental and adoption leave top up program, a partially-paid sabbatical program and much more
Pension, stock and savings programs with an employer-paid match to help build and enhance your future financial security
A flexible work environment with a friendly, caring, collaborative and inclusive culture focused on career growth development #WeWinAsATeam
The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential
Award winning workplace culture - Great Place to Work® Certified in Canada and the U.S., “Best Places to Work” by Glassdoor, Award for Excellence for Mental Health at Work, “Best Places to Work in Money Management” by Pension & Investments

ZEISS is a global technology and innovation leader in optics and optoelectronics. Founded in Germany in 1846, ZEISS operates in 50\+ countries and offers career opportunities across engineering, manufacturing, research, sales, and technology.

With a strong North American presence since 1925 and 20\+ locations, ZEISS partners with industries including semiconductor, automotive, biomedical research, and medical technology, and is a leading manufacturer of eyeglass lenses, camera and cinema lenses, and precision optical systems.

jobs.title: Director, Pricing Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
At Varicent, we're not just transforming the Sales Performance Management (SPM) market—we're redefining how organizations achieve revenue success. Our cutting\-edge SaaS solutions empower revenue leaders globally to design smarter go\-to\-market strategies, maximize seller performance, and unlock untapped potential. Varicent stands at the forefront of innovation, celebrated as a market leader in the *2025 Forrester Wave Report for SPM*, *2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index*, *Gartner Peer Insights*, *2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide*, and *G2\.* Our solutions are trusted by a diverse range of global industry leaders like T\-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker and hundreds more. Here's why you'll thrive at Varicent:
* **Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.**
* **Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.**
* **Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.**
* **Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.**

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!  


**Summary of the Role and Team**



As Director of Deal Desk \& Pricing, you will lead and scale Varicent's Deal Desk function, serving as the central authority for deal governance, pricing operations, quote\-to\-booking processes, and commercial execution. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations to drive pricing accuracy, data integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance throughout the customer lifecycle. This role combines strategic leadership with hands\-on execution — you'll establish the processes, governance frameworks, systems alignment, and team structure that enable scalable growth. This is a people leadership role: you'll manage and grow Deal Desk professionals while improving deal velocity, profitability, forecasting accuracy, and operational excellence.


**What You Will Be Doing**



* Lead and develop the Deal Desk team, including coaching, performance management, capacity planning, and workload prioritization.


* Establish and run Deal Desk operating processes: deal intake, approvals, escalations, service\-level expectations, and stakeholder communications.


* Own quote\-to\-booking governance for new business, renewals, expansions, and cross\-sell opportunities, ensuring pricing accuracy and policy compliance.


* Work with Sales and Customer Success on deal structuring, pricing decisions, exception management, and commercial approvals.


* Maintain data integrity and system alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related commercial systems.


* Partner with Finance on forecasting activities, revenue recognition requirements, commercial risk assessments, and audit readiness.


* Build and maintain governance frameworks, policies, documentation, and enablement resources that drive consistent business practices.


* Lead process improvement and change management initiatives to reduce deal cycle times and improve scalability and reporting quality.



**What You Bring**



* Demonstrated expertise in Deal Desk, Pricing, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, FP\&A, Commercial Finance, or related business functions (typically gained over 10–12\+ years)


* Experience leading teams, programs, or cross\-functional operational functions (typically 5\+ years)


* Experience with complex B2B sales motions, including new business, renewals, expansions, and cross\-sell transactions


* Expertise in Deal Desk operations, pricing governance, quote\-to\-booking workflows, commercial approvals, and process design


* Experience working with Salesforce, DealHub CPQ, or comparable CPQ/CRM platforms


* Solid grasp of how pricing structures, commercial terms, ACV, and contract structures impact forecasting and revenue recognition


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a track record of using operational data to improve business processes and decisions


* Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations



**Success Outcomes**


***First 90 Days***


* Build a working understanding of Varicent's pricing structure, commercial processes, systems landscape, and quote\-to\-booking workflows.
* Establish strong relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.
* Assess current Deal Desk processes, governance controls, approval workflows, and reporting capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve deal execution efficiency, data quality, and process consistency.


***Within 6 Months***


* Roll out clear governance frameworks, approval structures, and operational standards across the Deal Desk function.
* Raise quote quality, pricing accuracy, and first\-pass approval rates while cutting rework and processing delays.
* Set up consistent forecasting workflows with Finance using Deal Desk insights and commercial data.
* Strengthen data integrity and alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related systems.
* Develop scalable team operating rhythms and performance metrics aligned to business objectives.


***Within 12 Months***


* Position Deal Desk as a go\-to strategic partner across Go\-To\-Market, Finance, and Executive teams.
* Show measurable gains in deal cycle times, pricing governance, compliance, and forecasting accuracy.
* Deliver scalable quote\-to\-booking processes that support growth while maintaining strong controls and audit readiness.
* Build a high\-performing Deal Desk organization with clear accountability and operational excellence.
* Create a sustainable operating model that supports revenue growth, profitability objectives, and commercial scalability.

  



This posting is for a **existing** vacancy.

jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

The Director of EIAM Strategy & Technical Product Management
is responsible for defining and executing integrated product strategy across Royal Bank of Canada's Enterprise Identity and Access Management (EIAM) platform.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role
requiring deep engineering involvement and direct accountability for identity lifecycle management, authorization frameworks, governance capabilities, privileged access management, secrets management, and enterprise-wide identity architecture. The successful candidate will drive technical excellence across core security and compliance requirements while leveraging advanced technologies—including AI where appropriate—to enhance EIAM capabilities.

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As the Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights, you are a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the Brand Leadership team and to the Enterprise organization, shaping the future of the Arc’teryx brand through deep consumer understanding and insight-led strategy. You will define and lead the company’s Consumer Insights vision, ensuring the voice of the consumer is embedded at the core of brand and business strategy, decision making and long-term growth.  In this role you influence critical business and brand decisions through compelling storytelling and foresight, translating complex data into clear direction for senior leaders.

Acting as a catalyst for a consumer-first culture, you lead the growth of the company’s insights capabilities, operating models, and tools while building a high-performing global team. You also champion innovation in how the organization anticipates and responds to shifting consumer behaviors, ensuring the brand remains culturally relevant and positioned for sustained growth.

Ideally this role is based out of our North Vancouver office.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Brand team is the direct connection between the guest and the core intention of the Arc’teryx brand. Leveraging an increasingly robust set of consumer insights, we specialize in storytelling and creating incredible experiences that connect people to the transformative power of the mountains. Our functions include enterprise strategy, brand marketing and creative, athletes/ambassador's programs, community, experiences, operations, communications, regional teams, and agency partners. This team is comprised of global HQ and regional offices who aim to become the voice of the consumer within the organization.  You will work in close partnership with functional leaders across channels and regions to bring added value to the business during this high growth era.

You and your team will also support wider executive leadership, aggregating data from commercial, product and business partners to derive insights that inform the enterprise growth strategy.

If you were in the VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

Setting the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for the global Consumer Insights function, strengthening brand equity, distinctiveness, and consumer connection while ensuring alignment to brand positioning, growth priorities, and long-term strategy

Serving as the enterprise leader and trusted advisor for consumer insights, embedding a consumer-first operating model and insight-led perspectives that shape executive decisions, strategic planning, and innovation across all functions, regions, and business units.

Building, leading, and developing a high-performing global Consumer Insights team, including organizational design, capability building, and succession planning

Translating complex, multi-source data into clear narratives and lead the evolution of advanced analytics, including predictive, prescriptive, and AI-driven approaches, next-gen measurement, and marketing effectiveness/ROI tools, to drive measurable business outcomes

Designing and scaling a global insights operating model and enterprise frameworks — tools, platforms, KPIs, and standardized methodologies — and build strategic external partnerships (agencies, data providers, industry experts) to democratize access and ensure best-in-class capability

Leading consumer segmentation and consolidate data and insights systems across the enterprise (with focus on product, channel, and regional data), anticipating emerging consumer behaviors and market dynamics to unlock acquisition, retention, and growth opportunities

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

Shaping the future of brand-building through next-generation insights, leveraging AI, real-time consumer signals, and emerging technologies to create more adaptive, responsive, and culturally relevant brand strategies

Pioneering new approaches to understanding consumer connection and brand experience, evolving beyond traditional research to integrate behavioral, emotional, and cultural intelligence at scale

Future-proofing the Brand by embedding predictive foresight and scenario planning, enabling the organization to anticipate disruption, stay ahead of shifting consumer expectations, and unlock long-term brand growth opportunities

Are you our next VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights?

You have 15+ years of progressive experience across brand, consumer insights, and strategy functions, with a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, and proven capability building consumer insights strategies and frameworks

You have demonstrated success influencing executive leadership, translating insights into brand strategy, positioning, and global brand-building initiatives that drive equity and long-term growth

You have strong analytical and technical fluency, including advanced analytics, predictive modeling, AI-driven insights, and consumer data ingestion, integration, and governance across a multi-market environment

You have an exceptional ability to synthesize complex data into compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive action

You are a proven people leader who sets clear vision, aligns global teams and cross-functional partners, and builds high-performing, diverse organizations within a complex matrix environment.

Your knowledge of technical apparel, outdoor, performance, or premium lifestyle categories, with in-depth understanding of the outdoor industry and the consumer culture Arc'teryx targets

You have a genuine passion for getting outside that matches your passion for the work

Compensation:
The salary range for this role is USD$224,000 - USD$336,000 

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

Health & wellbeing
- Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Financial wellbeing
- RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.

Time & Flexibilit
y - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).

Family support
- Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.

Growth, community & gear
- Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events) , Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).
  *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 

Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way. 

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world. 

Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better 
Disruptive evolution . In pursuit of better. Always. 
Commit.  We set bold objectives and see them through.

jobs.title: Head of Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Job Description

Toast is recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing public safety technology company that is transforming the global water rescue industry. Their flagship product is a handheld sonar device with built-in AI detection that helps first responders locate drowning victims faster and more effectively. As the company expands its global reach and develops new product lines, they are looking for a driven, hands-on Head of Machine Learning to lead ML strategy, oversee end-to-end development, and solve some of their most challenging embedded ML problems. This role sits at the centre of the company's core technology and strategic vision.

Responsibilities

Define and execute the machine learning strategy in line with evolving product and business objectives
Lead the design and evolution of signal processing and machine learning architectures for production systems
Establish technical standards, best practices, and development processes for ML systems
Evaluate emerging ML technologies and identify opportunities to strengthen product capabilities and competitive advantage
Provide technical leadership on architecture decisions, model selection, and system performance optimization
Oversee the development, validation, deployment, and lifecycle management of machine learning models
Oversee the design, optimization, and scalability of signal processing pipelines
Define model performance metrics and drive continuous improvement through rigorous evaluation and experimentation
Ensure production ML infrastructure, data pipelines, and supporting databases are robust, maintainable, and scalable
Oversee ML Ops practices including model versioning, reproducibility, and monitoring
Set standards for dataset acquisition, quality, governance, and lifecycle management
Lead planning and execution of field data collection initiatives to meet product development and validation goals
Innovate on methods for data labeling, preprocessing, quality assurance, and representativeness across operational scenarios
Continuously expand and refine training datasets to improve model accuracy and generalization
Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and executive leadership to define the AI roadmap and prioritize initiatives
Translate customer needs and operational challenges into innovative ML solutions and product capabilities
Provide technical leadership during customer demonstrations, field trials, and critical deployments
Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on machine learning, advising on technical direction and product strategy
Lead and mentor a high-performing machine learning team within the product development group
Set project priorities, resource allocation, and development plans to deliver on strategic objectives
Drive project execution through effective planning, risk management, and tools such as Jira
Build a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning through technical reviews and knowledge sharing

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
5 to 10 years of experience in machine learning, AI, and software development
Proven track record leading machine learning teams and delivering quality products
Experience with embedded ML on hardware or IoT devices
Experience translating real-world applications and customer needs into ML solutions
Strong proficiency in Python, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Scikit-learn
End-to-end ML project experience, including data pipelines, data cleaning, preprocessing, model design, training, validation, and deployment
Experience with project management tools such as Jira
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
Strong technical communication, documentation, and organizational skills

Nice to haves

Familiarity with sonar systems and sonar data would be a plus
Familiarity with signal processing is considered an asset
Experience with computer vision, such as object detection and Fourier transforms, would be a plus
Experience with IP strategy in AI innovation is considered an asset
Comfort working in open water settings year-round (with appropriate PPE) would be a plus

Benefits

Salary range of $160,000 to $180,000, plus performance-based incentives
Employee ownership opportunities, so you share in the value you help build
Health, dental, and vision coverage
4 weeks paid vacation plus a company-wide closure from December 24 to January 1
Relocation support available for candidates based outside of Vancouver
Flexible and dynamic work environment
Own the core algorithms behind a device first responders use in real rescues, where faster detection means victims are found sooner
Shape the AI roadmap as the company expands globally and launches new product lines
Build and lead the ML team from the ground up, with direct influence on the design and development of the end product
Application Review

Submit your application, including your resume and cover letter, through our online portal. Our team will carefully review your qualifications and experiences. We take pride in responding promptly, so if your application aligns with our current opportunities, you’ll hear back from us with next steps. Your journey with Toast begins here, and we’re excited to see what you bring to the table!

Vetting Call

If your application is successful, we’ll schedule a vetting call with a member of the Toast team. This 30-45 minute informal conversation is designed for us to get to know you better and assess your skills. Be prepared to discuss your past projects, the challenges you’ve tackled, and the impact you’ve made. This is your chance to shine and show us why you’re a great fit for the roles we offer.

Profile Creation

Once you’ve impressed us in the vetting call, we’ll create an unbiased profile that highlights your experience while minimizing common biases. Instead, we focus on your skills, industry experience, and the impact you’ve made. This way, your profile reflects your true potential and accomplishments.

Client Submission

After crafting your unbiased profile, we submit it to our trusted clients. We work closely with these clients to ensure they understand the value you bring. Throughout their interview process, we remain by your side, providing support and guidance. Our goal is to help you navigate the hiring process smoothly and confidently, ensuring you have the best chance to secure a role that fits your skills and aspirations.

jobs.description:
About Us

How many companies can say they’ve been in business for over 177 years?!

Here at ZEISS, we certainly can! As the pioneers of science, ZEISS handles the everchanging environments in a fast-paced world, meeting it with cutting edge of technologies and continuous advancements. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. We have a diverse range of portfolios throughout the ZEISS family in segments like, Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology, Consumer Markets and Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology. We are a global company with over 42,000 employees and have over 4,000 in the US and Canada alone! Make a difference, come join the team!

What’s the role?

The Head of Sales ZEISS Medical Technology Ophthalmology is responsible for leading the Canadian commercial strategy, sales execution, revenue growth, profitability and market development for the Ophthalmic Devices business.

This role provides leadership across key Ophthalmic Devices segments, including ophthalmic diagnostics, surgical ophthalmology, refractive solutions, retina, anterior segment and related clinical education or professional development activities, as applicable to the Canadian market.

The incumbent is accountable for achieving annual revenue and profit objectives, developing a high-performing sales organization, strengthening customer relationships and ensuring alignment with ZEISS Canada priorities, regional business objectives and global Ophthalmic Devices strategies.

The role is also responsible for providing business insights to Canadian and regional leadership on market trends, customer needs, competitive activity, product requirements, pricing, territory planning and growth opportunities within the Canadian ophthalmology and optometry markets.

Sound Interesting?

Here’s What You’ll Do

Commercial Strategy and Business Planning

Develop and execute the Canadian Ophthalmic Devices commercial strategy in alignment with ZEISS Canada, regional and global business priorities.
Lead the achievement of annual revenue, profit and market share objectives for the Canadian Ophthalmic Devices business.
Develop annual business plans, sales forecasts, expense budgets and growth initiatives.
Provide regular business updates, sales funnel reviews and forecast submissions to Canadian and regional leadership.
Lead monthly business reviews using data-driven performance analysis
Lead capital equipment opportunity planning from lead generation through installation, customer adoption and lifecycle management.
Monitor installed base performance, replacement opportunities and cross-selling opportunities across the customer portfolio.
Recommend pricing strategies, promotional programs, territory planning, resource allocation and future product opportunities based on Canadian market needs.
Identify incremental business opportunities with strategic partners, key accounts and healthcare institutions.

Sales Leadership and Performance Management

Lead the Canadian Ophthalmic Devices sales organization in achieving annual sales and profitability targets.
Build, coach and develop a high-performing sales team through effective recruitment, onboarding, motivation, mentoring and performance management.
Establish clear sales goals, territory expectations and accountability measures.
Support career development, succession planning and talent growth within the Canadian sales organization.
Operate as a player-coach by actively participating in strategic customer engagements, major sales presentations, executive-level negotiations, and key opportunity pursuits.
Conduct regular performance discussions and annual performance reviews in accordance with ZEISS Canada HR policies.
Partner with Regional Sales Managers and Account Managers to develop account strategies, advance complex opportunities, and accelerate sales cycle progression.
Conduct regular field coaching, joint customer visits, and opportunity reviews to improve sales effectiveness and support professional development across the commercial organization.
Leverage Salesforce as the primary commercial management platform and single source of truth for pipeline management, account planning, forecasting, opportunity coaching, performance management, and commercial analytics, ensuring data integrity, visibility, and sales execution across the organization.
Utilize CRM analytics to drive territory optimization, resource allocation, customer segmentation and business planning decisions.
Utilize Salesforce analytics and reporting to support territory optimization, customer segmentation, resource allocation, forecasting accuracy, and strategic business planning.
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, customer focus and achievement.

Market Development and Competitive Intelligence

Monitor and evaluate Canadian market trends, customer needs, competitive activity, procurement practices and emerging opportunities in ophthalmology and optometry.
Provide regular and meaningful insights to Canadian and regional leadership on market conditions, customer requirements, product needs and competitive positioning.
Analyze market intelligence, customer feedback, sales data and pipeline information to identify risks and growth opportunities.
Recommend strategies to strengthen ZEISS’s market position in Canada.
Reinforce ZEISS’s brand as a trusted market leader in ophthalmic technology and solutions.

Customer and Strategic Account Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, ophthalmologists, optometrists, clinics, hospitals, academic institutions and buying groups.
Lead complex sales opportunities involving Requests for Proposal (RFPs), public tenders, group purchasing organizations (GPOs), and hospital procurement processes.
Coordinate cross-functional resources including Clinical Applications, Marketing, Service, Finance, and Regulatory teams to develop competitive proposals and customer solutions.
Develop winning bid strategies and ensure timely submission of proposals aligned with customer requirements and ZEISS commercial objectives.
Monitor upcoming capital equipment procurement opportunities and healthcare funding initiatives to proactively position ZEISS solutions.
Represent ZEISS Canada at industry events, conferences, customer forums and strategic business discussions.
Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve customer issues and improve the overall customer experience.
Develop and oversee national strategic account plans for key customers, buying groups, hospital networks and academic institutions.
Establish executive engagement plans for high-value customers and strategic growth accounts.
Monitor account performance, share of wallet and customer retention metrics.
Ensure customer insights are communicated back to Marketing, Service, Finance, Clinical Education and regional leadership teams.

Marketing, Product and Commercial Excellence

Partner with Marketing and regional business leaders on product positioning, launch planning, promotional programs and market deve lopment initiatives.
Provide input into product line strategy, market penetration plans and future product requirements for Canada.
Support the implementation of sales contests, sales meetings, product launches and commercial initiatives.
Ensure effective use of CRM, pipeline management tools and sales reporting processes.
Collaborate with Clinical Education and Professional Development to support customer training, adoption and product utilization.

Financial Management and Forecasting

Manage revenue plans, expense budgets, sales forecasts and profitability objectives for the Canadian Ophthalmic Devices business.
Provide accurate and timely forecast updates to Finance, Canadian leadership and regional stakeholders.
Review monthly revenue and expense projections, customer issues, sales activity and competitive business encounters.
Maintain a rolling forecast and identify corrective actions where performance gaps arise.
Ensure business decisions are supported by sound financial analysis and commercial judgment.

Cross-Functional and Matrix Leadership

Work closely with ZEISS Canada leadership, regional Ophthalmic Devices leadership, Finance, Human Resources, Marketing, Service, Clinical Education, Regulatory/Quality and other internal stakeholders.
Contribute to Canadian leadership discussions on matters related to Ophthalmic Devices strategy, sales execution, customer experience and business performance.
Influence across a matrix environment to align priorities, resources and business outcomes.
Ensure communication of corporate goals, strategies and tactics to the Canadian sales organization.

Compliance, Quality and Policy Adherence

Maintain awareness of and adherence to applicable ZEISS policies, quality processes and regulatory requirements.
Ensure the Canadian sales organization operates in accordance with company standards, compliance expectations and ethical business practices.
Support adherence to applicable medical device quality, documentation and customer-facing processes.
Maintain a safe, respectful and professional work environment.

Do you qualify?

Experience And Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Business, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Engineering or related discipline.
MBA or advanced degree considered an asset.
Minimum 8-10 years of progressive medical device or healthcare sales leadership experience.
Medical device, healthcare technology or ophthalmology/optometry market experience strongly preferred.
Experience leading sales teams and achieving revenue and profitability targets.
Experience selling or leading teams that sell diagnostic, surgical, refractive or related ophthalmic products considered an asset.
Experience working in a matrix organization considered an asset.
Experience managing budgets, forecasts, sales performance and customer relationships.
Strong business acumen and financial analysis capability.
Strong understanding of sales strategy, forecasting, pipeline management and commercial execution.
Ability to analyze complex business situations and make sound recommendations.
Strong leadership, coaching and talent development skills.
Excellent presentation and executive communication skills.
Strong customer relationship management and negotiation skills.
Ability to influence across functions and organizational levels.
Strong planning, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM tools and business reporting systems.
Bilingual English/French considered an asset.

Working Conditions And Special Demands

Standard working hours are typically 40 hours per week Monday – Friday.
In some cases, especially with the advancement of technology, remote work or flexible work arrangement may be possible. This depends on company’s policies and the nature of the work.
Willing to travel over weekends and holidays, including domestic and international travel (up to 25% - 50%).
Ability to work in a multi-cultural business environment, foreign language skills are desirable.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Role

The Director of Data Delivery leads and empowers the teams responsible for the end-to-end, Agile delivery of data solutions and data products on the Azure/Databricks platform for International Banking, serving all business lines. This role owns delivery across the full lifecycle—data ingestion, provisioning, engineering, and productization—while ensuring strong governance, regulatory compliance, and strategic alignment. The Director provides senior leadership to Agile Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and cross-functional engineering teams, and partners with architecture, platform, and business stakeholders to scale a consistent, reusable Azure/Databricks delivery model across all International Banking markets and business lines.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Delivery of Solutions & Data Products on Azure/Databricks: Lead the Agile, end-to-end delivery of data solutions and data products—pipelines, Delta/Lakehouse datasets, analytics platforms, and reporting tools—built on Azure/Databricks for all International Banking business lines, ensuring engineering best practices, reusability, and alignment with business objectives.
Azure/Databricks Platform Enablement: Partner with architecture and platform teams to establish and scale Azure/Databricks workspaces, Unity Catalog, and declarative/Lakeflow pipelines as the standard delivery foundation, driving a consistent, secure, and cost-efficient operating model across all International Banking markets and business lines.
Governance and Compliance: Ensure all data products and initiatives adhere to international banking regulations, data governance frameworks, and internal compliance policies, maintaining the highest standards of security and regulatory compliance.
Management of Data Delivery Projects Across All Business Lines: Direct and manage data provisioning, ingestion, and product-delivery initiatives spanning every International Banking business line, coordinating resources, timelines, and deliverables to achieve strategic goals on the Azure/Databricks platform.
Leadership for Agile Delivery Managers: Lead, mentor, and develop Agile Delivery Managers, fostering a high-performing, collaborative culture and driving professional growth.
Leadership for Data Project Managers: Provide strategic direction and support to Project Managers, ensuring effective project execution and alignment with organizational priorities.
Data Strategy and Planning: Shape and execute the data strategy, leveraging emerging technologies and industry trends to enhance banking operations and maintain a competitive edge.
Support for Data Ops, Data Ingestion, and Data Provisioning Teams: Collaborate with Data Ops, Data Ingestion, and Data Provisioning teams, providing planning and facilitation services to optimize Azure/Databricks workflows (CI/CD and DataOps), resolve impediments, and enable seamless, reliable delivery across all business lines.
Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary point of contact for senior stakeholders, translating business needs into actionable data initiatives and ensuring expectations are met through clear communication and robust reporting.
Performance Metrics and Continuous Improvement: Define and monitor KPIs (delivery velocity, data quality, team productivity, stakeholder satisfaction) to drive process optimization and operational excellence.
Innovation: Champion a culture of innovation, leveraging Azure/Databricks capabilities, Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, and AI/ML, to deliver impactful, scalable data solutions and products for International Banking.

Education

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
Master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MS in Data Science) or advanced certifications (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), PMP) strongly preferred.

Experience

Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Agile project management, data product delivery, and data strategy within banking or financial services.
At least 5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing Agile Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and cross-functional data teams.
Demonstrated success delivering data solutions and data products on Azure/Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, pipelines), including leadership of Data Ops, Data Ingestion, and Data Provisioning functions.
Proven track record of implementing governance and compliance frameworks for data products, ensuring adherence to international regulations (e.g., GDPR, Basel III, MiFID II).
Extensive experience engaging with C-level stakeholders, translating business needs into actionable data initiatives, and driving stakeholder alignment.
Strong background in planning and facilitation services for technical teams, optimizing workflows, and resolving impediments.

Skills & Competencies

Expert knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and modern data engineering on Azure/Databricks, including the Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, declarative/Lakeflow pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data governance.
Exceptional leadership and mentoring abilities, with a focus on developing high-performing Agile Delivery Managers and Project Managers.
Strategic thinking and planning skills, with the ability to shape and execute data strategy and drive innovation.
Advanced stakeholder management and communication skills, capable of influencing senior executives and global teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills in complex, high-pressure environments.
Proficiency in Agile and DevOps tooling (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, CI/CD) and Azure/Databricks technologies (SQL, Python, PySpark, Delta Lake, and cloud-native services).
Deep understanding of performance metrics (KPIs) for data delivery, team productivity, and stakeholder satisfaction.

Other Requirements

Ability to foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Commitment to maintaining the highest standards of data security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience working in a matrixed, globally distributed organization.

Role

The Director, DataOps is a senior technology leadership role accountable for the operational excellence, reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency of the Azure Databricks platform and related data operations across Mexico, Caribbean, Chile, Peru, and Uruguay.

This role leads a distributed team responsible for production data pipeline operations, CI/CD enablement, platform onboarding, observability, incident management, governance controls, and continuous improvement of the Lakehouse operating model. The Director will partner closely with Data Engineering, Architecture, Platform Engineering, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure Databricks-based data products are delivered safely, reliably, and in alignment with regional priorities and enterprise standards.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Regional Leadership & Team Management

Lead, coach, and scale a regional DataOps organization across Mexico, Caribbean, Chile, Peru, and Uruguay, with clear accountability for production operations, engineering discipline, service reliability, and continuous improvement.
Define operating objectives, performance expectations, delivery metrics, and talent development plans for engineers, operations leads, and platform support roles.
Coordinate priorities across countries, time zones, and partner teams, ensuring transparent execution, consistent standards, and timely escalation of risks, blockers, and service-impacting issues.

DataOps Strategy, Operating Model & Execution

Define and implement the DataOps operating model for Azure Databricks, including platform onboarding, environment management, release controls, production support, change management, and operational governance.
Drive automation across the data delivery lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, deployment gates, code promotion, rollback patterns, and release traceability.
Establish and monitor service-level objectives for data pipelines and platform operations, including availability, data freshness, latency, job success rates, incident response, recovery time, and data quality.

Databricks Platform Operations & Reliability

Own the operational readiness of Azure Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, workflows, notebooks, libraries, secrets, service principals, and production deployment patterns.
Partner with Platform Engineering and Architecture to define secure, scalable workspace patterns, environment separation, cluster policies, runtime standards, capacity planning, and platform guardrails.
Build a strong observability practice for pipelines and platform services, including monitoring, alerting, logging, operational dashboards, root-cause analysis, and problem management.

Cloud Infrastructure Management

Oversee the design, deployment, and optimization of cloud-based data infrastructure supporting Azure Databricks, including secure connectivity, storage integration, workload isolation, and scalable compute patterns.
Lead FinOps discipline for Databricks workloads, including cost transparency, tagging, budget controls, rightsizing, auto-termination, utilization reporting, capacity forecasting, and optimization of compute spend.
Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud, cybersecurity, privacy, data residency, and regulatory requirements, coordinating with control functions and regional stakeholders as needed.

Governance, Security & Data Controls

Define and enforce governance practices for Databricks and lakehouse assets, including Unity Catalog adoption, access management, data lineage, auditability, ownership models, and production data controls.
Establish secure operating patterns for service principals, secrets management, privileged access, environment segregation, and production job execution.
Partner with Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, and Architecture teams to ensure controls are embedded early in the delivery lifecycle and continuously validated through operational reporting.

Stakeholder Engagement & Operational Excellence

Communicate operational health, delivery progress, risks, incidents, remediation plans, platform dependencies, and investment needs to senior leadership.
Establish executive-ready KPIs and dashboards covering platform adoption, pipeline reliability, SLA performance, data quality, incidents, cost efficiency, onboarding progress, and engineering productivity.

Innovation & Best Practices

Stay current with Databricks, Azure, DataOps, DevSecOps, FinOps, observability, and data engineering practices, translating relevant capabilities into practical standards for the organization.
Develop reusable playbooks, templates, reference architectures, onboarding guides, runbooks, support models, and engineering standards to accelerate safe and consistent adoption of Databricks.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
10+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or DataOps, including at least 5 years in a leadership role managing distributed technical teams.
Proven experience operating enterprise-scale data platforms in production, including incident management, release management, monitoring, SLA/SLO governance, and continuous improvement.
Deep hands-on knowledge of Azure Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows/Jobs, workspace administration, cluster policies, runtime management, and integration with Azure data services.

The Company

Cineflix Media

Cineflix creates, produces, and distributes must-watch TV for global platforms, with operations in Montreal, Toronto, Vancouver, New York, Los Angeles, London, and Dublin. A leading international media company, the group includes top-ranking sales and acquisitions division, Cineflix Rights, as well as production labels Buccaneer and C3 Media. With a catalogue of 7,600 hours of select programming across a wide range of genres and a collection of YouTube and FAST channels streaming 24/7, Cineflix is behind some of TV’s most popular and long-running shows.

The Role

Cineflix Media is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Systems & AI Enablement to lead the practical implementation of our enterprise AI and technology transformation agenda.

This cross-functional role will work across the organisation to identify opportunities, modernise systems, redesign processes and embed effective AI-enabled ways of working.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Senior Director will partner closely with IT and leaders across Cineflix to translate business priorities into practical, measurable outcomes. Initial areas of focus may include Cineflix’s finance, rights management, production budgeting, payroll and planning systems, but the scope of the role extends across the organisation. This is a full-time role based in our Toronto, Ontario office on a hybrid, in-office schedule.

The Salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 – $200,000

Key Responsibilities

Lead the implementation of Cineflix’s enterprise AI agenda across corporate and operational functions.
Identify and prioritise practical AI and automation opportunities that improve productivity, accuracy and decision-making.
Translate business requirements into scalable AI-enabled solutions and workflows.
Lead the development and deployment of Cineflix-owned LLM capability for internal processes, reducing reliance on external tools and ensuring solutions are tailored to Cineflix’s workflows, data, security and governance requirements.
Establish responsible AI practices in partnership with IT, Legal, Privacy and business leaders.
Collaborate with Creative AI leadership to align governance while maintaining clear areas of accountability.
Develop and deliver a roadmap for modernising, connecting and, where appropriate, consolidating Cineflix’s core business systems.
Improve the quality, accessibility and governance of enterprise data.
Reduce reliance on manual processes, disconnected systems and uncontrolled spreadsheets.
Lead systems integration, automation and modernisation initiatives in partnership with IT and functional leaders.
Evaluate technology partners and solutions based on business value, security, scalability and cost.
Lead the successful adoption of new systems, AI tools and redesigned processes.
Partner with business leaders and HR to support communications, training and skills development.
Help teams understand and adapt to changing roles, responsibilities and ways of working.

jobs.description:
This role is HYBRID, requires senior leadership and hands on capability to build complex AI solutions.

About the role:

BMO Canada Wealth Digital is accelerating the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its customer-facing digital platforms to enhance client experiences, improve operational efficiency, and enable innovative wealth management solutions. We are seeking an experienced AI Delivery Director to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic AI initiatives that support the evolution of our Wealth Management digital capabilities.

This is a senior delivery leadership role requiring the coordination of cross-functional teams across Engineering, Architecture, Security, Risk Management, Compliance, and Business organizations. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the delivery of secure, compliant, and resilient Multi-Agent AI solutions that leverage enterprise AI capabilities, including the AI Gateway, Policy Engine, Identity Fabric, AI Registry, Guardrails Runtime, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, and AI Observability platforms.

The AI Delivery Director will provide end-to-end leadership across the delivery lifecycle, from intake, discovery, and prioritization through implementation, deployment, adoption, and business value realization by adopting and utilizing AI tools in SDLC. Working closely with engineering leaders, product owners, architects, and executive stakeholders, the role will ensure AI-enabled solutions are delivered on schedule, aligned with enterprise standards, and integrated effectively within the broader technology ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Technology Delivery
Lead delivery across multiple cross-functional product and platform teams, establishing one integrated plan, clear critical path, transparent dependencies, and accountable owners.
Convert the product roadmap into executable technology increments, release plans, capacity models, milestones, and outcome-based commitments.
Drive delivery discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risk, and benefits, using forecasts rather than artificial certainty.
Identify constraints early, remove impediments, resolve cross-team trade-offs, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
Ensure each release has explicit entry, exit, acceptance, operational readiness, and rollback criteria.
AI Engineering and AI SDLC Leadership
Apply deep knowledge of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, guardrails, memory, and human oversight.
Embed full-lifecycle AI SDLC practices across requirements, design, build, test, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and model or prompt change management.
Ensure AI quality is measured using fit-for-purpose evaluations covering safety, groundedness, relevance, accuracy, latency, reliability, and client experience.
Champion specification-driven development, automation, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-assisted software delivery where approved.
Ensure deterministic software testing and probabilistic AI evaluation are integrated into CI/CD and release decisions.
Azure, Architecture and Platform Integration
Provide senior technical leadership for solutions deployed on Microsoft Azure and integrated with BMO InvestorLine and Wealth Management platforms.
Partner with solution, enterprise, security, data, and platform architects to maintain an approved, scalable target architecture and prevent local optimization or avoidable technical debt.
Ensure APIs, event flows, data services, identity, access, observability, resilience, and non-functional requirements are designed and delivered end to end.
Drive environment readiness, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, telemetry, performance engineering, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and production support readiness.
Promote reuse of enterprise AI capabilities, shared services, patterns, and controls while preserving clear service boundaries and ownership.
Advanced Agile and Value-Stream Delivery
Establish and continuously improve an advanced Agile operating model organized around persistent, cross-functional teams and measurable client or business outcomes.
Lead portfolio and product-level planning, backlog readiness, dependency management, release forecasting, and flow optimization across multiple teams.
Use evidence-based metrics such as lead time, cycle time, throughput, work in progress, predictability, escaped defects, reliability, evaluation performance, and value realization.
Reduce handoffs, unnecessary governance, meeting load, and blocked work; create fast decision paths and clear single-point accountability.
Coach delivery leaders, Scrum Masters, engineering leads, and teams in modern product delivery, DevSecOps, continuous delivery, and learning-driven retrospectives.
Quality, Risk and Responsible AI
Build quality, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model risk, accessibility, and responsible AI requirements into delivery from inception, not as release-end checkpoints.
Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Model Risk, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to establish proportionate controls and auditable evidence.
Ensure full-spectrum observability across application, infrastructure, data, model, prompt, agent, safety, and client-experience performance.
Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and learning reviews for technology or AI quality events.
Maintain transparent risk, issue, dependency, and decision records and ensure material risks are escalated promptly.
Stakeholder, Financial and Partner Leadership
Serve as the senior technology delivery voice for Em with InvestorLine, Wealth, Technology & Operations, Applied AI, governance partners, and executive forums.
Provide concise, fact-based reporting on outcomes, delivery confidence, risks, financials, quality, and decisions required.
Own technology delivery financial stewardship, resource planning, vendor performance, commercial dependencies, and delivery commitments.
Lead co-build and vendor engagements with clear accountability, knowledge transfer, architecture compliance, security obligations, and measurable outcomes.
Create an inclusive, high-accountability environment that develops leaders, strengthens technical depth, and keeps teams focused on client outcomes.

Key Success Measures

Predictable delivery of roadmap outcomes and releases, with transparent forecast accuracy and controlled scope change.
Measurable improvement in delivery flow, engineering productivity, automation, quality, and time to value.
AI evaluation thresholds and non-functional requirements met before release and sustained in production.
Stable, secure, resilient production performance with effective observability, incident management, and continuous improvement.
Clear ownership, faster decisions, fewer cross-team handoffs, and effective dependency resolution.
Measurable client adoption, experience, business value, and risk outcomes delivered in partnership with the Product Owner.
Effective financial, capacity, vendor, and technical-debt management.

Required Skills And Competencies

Expert-level technology delivery leadership in large, complex, regulated environments, with accountability for multiple teams and production outcomes.
Deep practical knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI delivery, including agentic architectures, LLM application patterns, evaluations, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI controls.
Strong knowledge of wealth management and digital investing platforms, including client journeys, advice or guidance experiences, market and portfolio data, trading-related integrations, and regulatory considerations.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Azure cloud architecture and delivery, cloud-native engineering, APIs, integration, identity and access, data services, telemetry, resilience, and DevSecOps.
Mastery of advanced Agile, product operating models, value-stream management, Lean flow, Scrum or Kanban, portfolio planning, CI/CD, test automation, and evidence-based delivery metrics.
Ability to challenge constructively, make decisions under ambiguity, translate technical complexity into business implications, and influence senior executives.
Commercial and financial acumen, including technology investment, capacity, vendor, contract, and delivery-performance management.
Exceptional leadership, communication, facilitation, negotiation, and talent-development skills.

Qualifications And Experience

Domain knowledge of investment, securities, trading from a technology perspective, having worked in such ecosystems.
