jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and creativity, where you can be on the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive work environment, join eBay – a company you can be proud to be with.

With more than 130 million active users across 190 countries and over 1 billion active product listings, eBay is the world’s most vibrant and dynamic online marketplace. Founded in 1995, eBay Inc. connects people around the world, enabling them to buy and sell online. eBay Inc. does this by providing the Internet platforms of choice for global commerce, payments and communications. eBay Inc. is headquartered in San Jose, California. For more information about the company and its global portfolio of online brands, visit www.ebayinc.com

About The Team

We are responsible for setting the strategic direction of eBay: our ambition, where we play, and how we win in the market. The team is responsible for deeply understanding the needs of our core buyers and sellers and crafting the strategies that will differentiate eBay relative to our competitors. We work very closely with product, technology, and regional business teams to ensure the strategy is translated into action across the end-to-end customer experience. Our work can be divided into 3 main topics: we develop eBay Inc’s strategy together with eBay’s executives, we run strategic projects to solve key strategic issues supporting select executives at eBay, we closely monitor the competitive environment & trends.

The opportunity

The Director, Corporate Strategy is a senior leader who will lead several cross-functional projects consisting of 2-6 Strategy Associates, Managers, and Senior Managers. You will bring both process and content leadership to strategy projects and act as the point person between Strategy and cross-functional business teams. Within this role, you will have the ability to influence key elements of eBay’s strategy and to help shape the strategic direction of eBay. The ideal candidate has a track record of making pragmatic, concrete recommendations with real world implementation experience. It is critical for the role that the candidate has strong analytic skills and is excellent in developing creative/ out-of-the-box and well-thought-out solutions for challenging business problems.

Role Responsibilities

Strategy Development: Develop the strategies for eBay to differentiate itself in the market. This will include crafting the strategies, developing the key initiatives to support the strategies and working closely with key eBay constituencies to gain consensus.
Project leadership: Independently, lead cross-functional projects involving executive and senior partners from various part of the organization.
Thought leadership: Develop content and topic expertise, as well as perspectives on issues important to eBay’s strategy. Structure problems. Develop creative solutions to challenging business problems
Strategy Mobilization: Work with the eBay line organization as needed to support mobilization and implementation of the business strategies.
Market and Competitive Analysis: Develop insightful market intelligence about key industry trends (technology, competitors, consumers, regulatory, etc.) and advise the organization of their strategic implications.
Business Analytics: Drive business judgment, market understanding, problem solving, and fact-based analysis to identify, prioritize, structure, and solve challenging business problems.
Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a driven strategy team in the development and execution of critical initiatives
Communication: Develop storylines for presentations, prepare and deliver presentations to senior leadership
Leading through uncertainty: Self-direct as well as manage resources on the strategy team and across the organization to deliver superior end-products in a dynamic industry and corporate environment

Job Requirements

Intellectual curiosity
Excellence in structured thinking, developing sensible, creative solutions to challenging strategic business problems. Creativity and “out of the box” thinking that drives innovation. The ability to “see around corners” and “connect the dots” that enable business to proactively drive business
Strong executive presence and ability to communicate strategy clearly and simply. Ease with executive-level interactions. Ability to create clear and simple storylines.
Proven track record to lead and mentor a driven strategy team in the development and execution of key initiatives. Ability to lead, empower and mentor project team members
Comfort in reaching out and prioritizing cross-functional collaboration in a highly matrixed environment
Outstanding analytical capabilities (quantitative and qualitative), ability to generate key insights
Comfort in handling uncertainty
Highly collaborative – be fun, and easy to work with!

Qualifications

Proven leader with at least 10 years of work experience - at least 2-3 years at a top strategy consulting firm at project management level are a must
Bachelors Degree required, MBA or equivalent preferred
Expertise in technology, ideally in e-commerce, retail, payments, and/or consumer facing products is highly desirable

Benefits are an essential part of your total compensation for the work you do every day. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, eBay offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefit programs to meet your needs. Including maternal & paternal leave, paid sabbatical, and plans to help ensure your financial security today and in the years ahead because we know feeling financially secure during your working years and through retirement is important.

Here at eBay, we love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. So, being diverse and inclusive isn’t just something we strive for, it is who we are, and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you feel eBay is a place where, no matter who you are, you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to bring your unique self to work. To learn about eBay’s Diversity & Inclusion click here: https://www.ebayinc.com/company/diversity-inclusion/

Additional Details

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within eBay.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Shared Health leads the planning and coordinates the integration of patient-centered clinical and preventive health services across Manitoba. The organization also delivers some province-wide health services and supports centralized administrative and business functions for Manitoba health organizations.

Position Overview

Digital Health focuses on supporting clinical and business systems as the foundation for leveraging electronic data in the delivery of health-care services.

We have an opportunity for an executive director clinical digital services, who will lead a consultative clinical digital solution practice in support of Manitoba’s Clinical Preventive Services Plan and the outcomes defined in the approved clinical digital strategic services plan and annual operating plan. Focused on providing effective clinical digital solutions, processes, systems and technologies for public health system clients in Manitoba including Shared Health and six provincial service delivery organizations, the executive director clinical digital solutions will establish health informatics processes, systems and provide technology advice that enables the achievement of innovative and sustainable health services. The executive director will provide service-focused leadership to the clinical digital solutions staff across the province, ensure the delivery on service commitments by staff and vendors, lead the service delivery, performance measurement, continuous improvement and efficiency of a provincially-focused interdisciplinary team with a culture of client service in Shared Health, and encourage provincial clients to engage the team as their primary resource for clinical informatics and digital health processes, systems and technology advice. The successful candidate will develop and recommend provincial standards for clinical informatics and digital health processes, systems and technologies, collaborate with senior leaders across the health system to ensure the effective delivery, implementation, ongoing support and adoption of effective clinical informatics and digital health processes, systems and technologies, and act as a primary contact for the engagement of external vendors.

Reporting to the provincial lead and chief information officer of Digital Health, this executive director will engage leaders and critical stakeholders to collaboratively realign and standardize the use of provincial clinical informatics and digital health systems. The successful candidate will lead organizational change, ensure ongoing adoption, optimization, deployment and maintenance of technologies and related equipment, support and manage vendor contracts, and ensure effective services are provided to support overall organizational and health-care system requirements. The successful candidate’s leadership, professionalism, diplomacy, and continuous improvement orientation will be evident as they collaborate with clients and colleagues to provide excellent customer service, identify system solutions, and support an integrated province-wide health-care system that provides multiculturally respectful health services delivery.

As this role is provincial in nature, the work location is flexible within Manitoba and will be made in consultation with the successful candidate. 5 years of experience leading a matrixed team to ensure collaboration and effective operations, working in a leadership role managing operational support for digital health systems, services and technologies.
5 years of experience applying strong program/project management in leading multiple, large, cross-functional teams on projects, delivering executive-level presentations and influencing, leading and managing negotiations with senior-level management and key internal and external stakeholders.
5 years of direct experience working in a clinical program with strong professional relationships with clinicians.

Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation certification, or higher.

If you’re looking for a fulfilling career that can make a real difference in your life, and the lives of others, you’ve come to the right place.

As a national health solutions partner, we put people first in everything we do — and that begins with our team of 8,000+ professionals who bring a cross-section of diverse life experiences and career expertise to Medavie. By collaborating and innovating together, our employees are creating industry-leading solutions in insurance, primary care and emergency medical services that impact millions of lives in Canada each year.

Our mission is to improve the wellbeing of Canadians so that every life can be lived to the fullest — and it’s reflected in our award-winning culture. We celebrate individuality and value the diverse perspectives and skills our employees contribute. We go beyond providing competitive pay and comprehensive benefits to offer opportunities for personal and professional growth, flexible work options, meaningful experiences, and supportive leadership. Medavie is where employees can be their best selves, feel they belong, and achieve their full potential. Be part of it by applying for a position with us today.

The Opportunity

Medavie is seeking an enterprise-minded leader to shape and advance our Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (DAA) agenda. Reporting to the EVP of the Enterprise Transformation Office, you will set strategic direction, establish the governance model for enterprise DAA decisions, and help ensure investments translate into measurable business outcomes.

In this leadership role, you will work across Business Lines, Technology, Risk, Privacy, Legal and executive leadership to create a consistent approach for identifying, prioritizing, governing and measuring DAA opportunities. You will bring clarity to decision rights, forums, escalation pathways, prioritization criteria and strategic guardrails, while building alignment around a practical, scalable and responsible enterprise direction.

Success in this role requires strategic thinking, sound judgment and the ability to influence across a complex organization. You will connect enterprise ambition to execution, strengthen value-based decision-making and foster a culture of responsible innovation, transparency and accountability.

What You Will Do

Define, maintain and execute Medavie’s enterprise DAA strategy and multi-year roadmap in collaboration with IT, translating strategic objectives into clear priorities, target outcomes, capability requirements and sequencing considerations.
Assess emerging technologies, vendor developments, regulatory changes and external practices, and translate them into strategic opportunities or roadmap implications.
Establish strategic guardrails to assess DAA opportunities based on enterprise alignment, business value and organizational readiness.
Align the DAA portfolio and foundational investments to enterprise ambition, partnering with portfolio intake and key stakeholders to prioritize initiatives.
Establish and maintain the enterprise DAA program governance operating model, including decision rights, governance forums, executive decision-making cadences and escalation pathways.
Facilitate enterprise governance forums that review DAA priorities, investment choices, strategic risks, dependencies and trade-offs.
Embed applicable data and AI requirements into governance processes so initiatives are assessed consistently before investment and prioritization decisions are made.
Define governance reporting that provides decision-makers with visibility into strategic alignment, portfolio direction, material risks, key dependencies and value realization.
Build strong relationships with executives, business leaders, IT teams and support functions to drive alignment around DAA strategy and governance expectations.
Act as a trusted advisor and enterprise subject matter expert on DAA strategy, governance model design, value realization and operating model practices.
Drive adoption of governance, portfolio management disciplines and value-based decision-making across the organization.
Establish meaningful metrics and key performance indicators to monitor strategy execution, portfolio alignment and governance effectiveness, using insights to continuously improve enterprise practices.

What You Need To Succeed

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in strategy, enterprise transformation or a related field.
Experience establishing operating models, governance models and strategic planning cadences within data, analytics, AI or technology environments.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide strategic initiatives across multiple business functions.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with executive and board-level stakeholders, influence decisions and build alignment across senior leadership.
Strong strategic thinking and synthesis skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights and executive-ready communications.
Experience developing and implementing enterprise AI and data literacy programs or capability-building strategies that increase adoption of data-driven and AI-enabled practices.
Strong understanding of AI literacy requirements, responsible AI principles and approaches for building organizational awareness and competency across diverse stakeholder groups.
Deep understanding of DAA program governance principles, operating model design and leading practices within data, analytics and AI environments.
Ability to lead through influence and build alignment across functions.
Strong knowledge of data privacy regulations and AI governance and model risk considerations.
Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, competing demands and a high degree of ambiguity.

Language Requirement:
Bilingualism (EN/FR) is considered an asset. English is requirement, written and verbal, to provide services to our customers and communicate with internal stakeholders

to lead the evolution of our US Retirement (USR) platform and SWIFT-enabled payment capabilities.

We are looking for a leader who is not afraid to roll up their sleeves, solve complex technical challenges, and partner closely with engineers to deliver scalable solutions.

What You'll Do

Engineering Leadership & Platform Strategy

Own the technology strategy, roadmap, and delivery for the US Retirement platform and associated SWIFT payment capabilities.
Lead the modernization of critical applications, services, and integrations to improve scalability, resilience, and customer experience.
Drive the adoption of cloud-native, API-first, and AI-powered engineering solutions.

Delivery & Technical Excellence

Lead multiple engineering squads responsible for platform development, enhancements, integrations, and production support.
Ensure the delivery of secure, high-quality, and scalable software solutions.

SWIFT & Enterprise Payments Leadership

AI & Innovation

Champion innovation and continuous improvement initiatives that create measurable business value.

People Leadership & Mentorship

Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams across multiple squads.

Hands-On Technical Leadership

jobs.title: Deputy Chief Financial Officer, Trilogy (Remote) - $800,000/year USD
jobs.description:
Most finance executives inherit a system. You will redesign one, then decide where the capital goes.

Trilogy is looking for the executive who can turn a portfolio of businesses into a capital allocation system: continuously ranking where the next dollar should go, backing those decisions with rigorous models, and moving capital toward its highest-return uses. You will own the calls that matter: fund or kill a business line; invest or hold; acquire or walk away; refinance or pay down debt. Every recommendation must connect strategy to cash, liquidity, covenants, risk, and enterprise value.

Just as important, you will architect an AI-native finance function built to scale without decision bottlenecks. This does not mean sprinkling AI tools onto a traditional finance organization. You will redesign reporting, planning, controls, portfolio monitoring, and decision support around what AI and automation can now do. You won't need to personally build every workflow, but you must use AI deeply enough to know its edges: where it accelerates analysis, where it fails, and where expert judgment must take over. The result should be a smaller, more senior, higher-leverage finance organization rather than a growing pyramid of people and processes.

You will operate directly with Trilogy's CEO, board, lenders, and capital partners, with personal accountability for the financial truth behind major decisions. As Deputy CFO, this is a $800K/year W-2 salaried role for someone who has already earned credibility at serious financial scale and now wants the mandate to compound enterprise value across an entire portfolio. If you want your impact measured by the quality of your capital decisions and the financial system you leave behind, apply.

What You Will Be Doing

Allocating capital across the portfolio: Run capital and portfolio reviews, rank competing uses of capital on risk-adjusted return, and make clear fund, hold, restructure, exit, debt-paydown, or acquisition recommendations.
Architecting an AI-native finance system: Redesign planning, reporting, consolidation, controls, portfolio monitoring, and financial workflows around AI, automation, and scalable systems rather than additional headcount.
Driving investments and transactions: Build and defend the financial case for strategic investments, M&A, financing, and refinancing, including integrated models, downside scenarios, capital structure, covenant implications, and execution plans.
Owning board and capital-partner communication: Give the CEO, board, lenders, and capital partners fast, quantified, defensible truth, with recommendations that make the decision and trade-offs explicit.
Building a high-leverage finance leadership team: Set the bar for a small group of exceptional finance leaders while creating systems that allow new ventures and greater complexity to be absorbed without linear organizational growth.

What You Won’t Be Doing

Running finance as a reporting factory. Closing the books and producing audit workpapers are the Controller's responsibilities. Your job is to turn financial information into better capital decisions.
Building a large finance organization to handle complexity. Scale should come from better systems, AI leverage, automation, and exceptional people, not layers of management.
Adding AI as a superficial productivity tool. You will architect workflows around its real capabilities and limitations, which requires substantial firsthand use.
Producing strategy decks without financial consequences. Major recommendations must carry the integrated model, downside case, capital implications, and execution guardrails behind them.
Managing the board through narrative. The numbers, assumptions, risks, and recommended action should be clear enough to withstand scrutiny.

Deputy Chief Financial Officer Key Responsibilities

Build a durable, AI-native finance function that compounds enterprise value across Trilogy's portfolio by allocating capital to its highest-return uses and creating financial systems and controls that scale without decision bottlenecks.

Basic Requirements

Experience as the most senior finance decision-maker, or their direct deputy, for a business or portfolio with $100M+ in annual revenue across multiple legal entities.
Personal ownership of major capital-allocation decisions, including the ability to explain what was funded, reduced, or rejected; the dollars involved; the trade-offs; and your recommendation.
Decision ownership on at least one $25M+ closed M&A, financing, or refinancing transaction, with direct responsibility for negotiation, financing selection, board recommendation, or post-close integration.
Direct experience presenting to and taking live questions from a board of directors.
Ownership of an external audit relationship under US GAAP or IFRS, directly or through a Controller reporting to you.
Hands-on experience with a true enterprise ERP such as SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, Workday, or equivalent.
Recent experience re-architecting a finance workflow around AI, with enough regular personal AI use to understand where the technology is reliable, where it is not, and how those boundaries should shape finance-system design.
Ability to operate integrated 3-statement models and defend assumptions, downside scenarios, covenant math, capital structure, and recommendations under live questioning.
Strong written and verbal English, with experience communicating directly with CEOs, boards, lenders, or capital partners.
Located within the UTC−8 to UTC+3 time-zone range.

Nice-to-have Requirements

CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CFA, MBA, or comparable finance credential.
Earlier career experience in private equity, investment banking, M&A, corporate finance, or another environment requiring rigorous modeling and high-stakes capital decisions.
Experience rebuilding a finance function rather than simply inheriting and operating one.
Experience across a portfolio, multi-entity, or PE-backed operating environment.

About Trilogy

Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses.

Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud-based stack.

Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career in leaps and bounds.

There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

Working with us

jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Systems & AI Enablement
jobs.description:
**The Company**

 **Cineflix Media**



Cineflix creates, produces, and distributes must\-watch TV for global platforms, with operations in Montreal, Toronto, Vancouver, New York, Los Angeles, London, and Dublin. A leading international media company, the group includes top\-ranking sales and acquisitions division, Cineflix Rights, as well as production labels Buccaneer and C3 Media. With a catalogue of 7,600 hours of select programming across a wide range of genres and a collection of YouTube and FAST channels streaming 24/7, Cineflix is behind some of TV’s most popular and long\-running shows.

  


**The Role**



Cineflix Media is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Systems \& AI Enablement to lead the practical implementation of our enterprise AI and technology transformation agenda.



This cross\-functional role will work across the organisation to identify opportunities, modernise systems, redesign processes and embed effective AI\-enabled ways of working.

  



Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Senior Director will partner closely with IT and leaders across Cineflix to translate business priorities into practical, measurable outcomes. Initial areas of focus may include Cineflix’s finance, rights management, production budgeting, payroll and planning systems, but the scope of the role extends across the organisation. This is a full\-time role based in our Toronto, Ontario office on a hybrid, in\-office schedule.

  



The Salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 \- $200,000

  


**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the implementation of Cineflix’s enterprise AI agenda across corporate and operational functions.
* Identify and prioritise practical AI and automation opportunities that improve productivity, accuracy and decision\-making.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI\-enabled solutions and workflows.
* Lead the development and deployment of Cineflix\-owned LLM capability for internal processes, reducing reliance on external tools and ensuring solutions are tailored to Cineflix’s workflows, data, security and governance requirements.
* Establish responsible AI practices in partnership with IT, Legal, Privacy and business leaders.
* Collaborate with Creative AI leadership to align governance while maintaining clear areas of accountability.
* Develop and deliver a roadmap for modernising, connecting and, where appropriate, consolidating Cineflix’s core business systems.
* Improve the quality, accessibility and governance of enterprise data.
* Reduce reliance on manual processes, disconnected systems and uncontrolled spreadsheets.
* Lead systems integration, automation and modernisation initiatives in partnership with IT and functional leaders.
* Evaluate technology partners and solutions based on business value, security, scalability and cost.
* Lead the successful adoption of new systems, AI tools and redesigned processes.
* Partner with business leaders and HR to support communications, training and skills development.
* Help teams understand and adapt to changing roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
* Build shared ownership across functions and address barriers to adoption and measure implementation progress, employee adoption and realised business benefits.

  


**Experience and Capabilities**

  

* Senior experience in enterprise technology, AI enablement, business systems or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated success implementing practical AI, automation and workflow solutions.
* Experience leading complex, cross\-functional transformation programmes.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise systems, data governance, cybersecurity and vendor management.
* The ability to connect business needs with practical technology solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management, change leadership and communication skills.
* A collaborative, pragmatic and execution\-focused leadership style.
* Experience in media, entertainment, production or another project\-based organisation would be an asset.

  



This posting reflects an existing vacancy. Cineflix does not use artificial intelligence in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this role.

  

If you are interested in this opportunity, please send your resume and cover letter to the Director, Human Resources, Mackenzie Graham via the provided link. No phone calls please. We thank all applicants, but only those selected will be contacted.

  

Cineflix Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a diverse environment. Cineflix welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.title: Director of Transformation
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Director of Innovation owns the organization's technology-led growth agenda - translating emerging digital, data, and AI capabilities into commercial outcomes. This is not an advisory or purely strategic role: the mandate is to architect, build, and scale the platforms and processes that drive measurable cost, revenue, and efficiency gains, while embedding the operating discipline (agile, human-centered design, structured innovation governance) needed to sustain that impact long-term.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

1. Innovation Strategy & Governance

Set the innovation roadmap and ensure every initiative is tied to a defined business outcome, not pursued for its own sake.
Build the structural backbone for innovation idea-sourcing frameworks, evaluation criteria, and prioritization processes so opportunities are assessed systematically rather than reactively.
Institutionalize agile product delivery across business units, replacing ad hoc development with a repeatable, measurable methodology.

2. Technology & Digital Transformation

Lead full-stack technology restructuring systems, integrations, infrastructure with a direct mandate to reduce operating cost while improving reliability and scalability.
Direct the build-out of enterprise data platforms that convert first-party data into actionable customer and business intelligence.
Own the design and deployment of AI-driven solutions where they create a defensible competitive or operational advantage.

3. Product & Platform Leadership

Run the end-to-end product lifecycle concept to launch with accountability for time-to-market and product quality, not just delivery.
Lead multi-market platform or payments initiatives, with revenue growth as a tracked and reported outcome.
Establish external partnership and market-scanning processes to identify and integrate capabilities the organization can't build fast enough internally.

4. People & Stakeholder Leadership

Build and lead cross-functional teams engineering, data, product, design structured for execution speed, not just headcount.
Operate as the connective layer between executive strategy and technical delivery, ensuring senior leadership decisions translate into shippable outcomes.
Represent the organization externally with technology partners and the start-up ecosystem, sourcing capability and talent the internal team doesn't yet have.

5. Performance Accountability

Define and own the KPIs that prove innovation is working: cost reduction, revenue contribution, time-to-market, adoption, and customer satisfaction.
Manage budget and resourcing with the same rigor applied to any P&L-owning function this role is judged on outcomes, not activity.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

Master's degree in Entrepreneurship, Innovation Management, Technology, or Business (required).
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline (required) the role requires enough technical fluency to challenge and validate engineering decisions directly, not just manage them.

Experience

15+ years progressing through technology, product, and innovation leadership roles, with a demonstrated arc from technical execution into enterprise-level strategic ownership.
A track record of leading large-scale, multi-market digital platform or payments initiatives with quantified commercial results not just delivery, but revenue and efficiency impact attached to that delivery.
Direct experience restructuring enterprise technology operations with documented cost or performance outcomes.
Background in financial services, telecommunications, or media preferred sectors where digital transformation is tied directly to competitive survival, not optional modernization.

Certifications (preferred)

ITIL, PRINCE2, SAFe Product Owner/Manager, or equivalent delivery-discipline certifications.
Applied technical certification in data science or AI — evidence of hands-on fluency, not just executive oversight.

Core Competencies

Converts ambiguous innovation mandates into structured, resourced execution plans.
Reads as credible to both engineering teams and executive leadership — can go deep technically and communicate commercially.
Demonstrated bias toward measurable outcomes over process for its own sake.
Comfortable owning budget and being held to P&L-style accountability for innovation spend.

Key Performance Indicators

Technology/infrastructure cost reduction achieved through restructuring.
Revenue attributable to new digital products or platforms.
Time-to-market improvement across product development cycles.
Customer adoption and satisfaction metrics tied to digital initiatives.

From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Who You'll Work With

Our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We connect across all technical and advisory capabilities, bringing strategy to life through delivery execution that is rigorous, adaptive and outcome driven. 
You'll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about helping clients solve their toughest business and technology challenges. Our teams lead high-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it is a multi-workstream delivery or PMO transformation, we bring clarity, structure and momentum to every engagement. 
We work in-person with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are, whether Agile, Waterfall, hybrid or product-based. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster and build better tomorrows.
As a Delivery Leader focused on AI-enabled client delivery, you will be a consulting leader who assesses how clients deliver projects and products, designs fit-for-purpose PMO and AI-PDLC operating models, and leads the creation and adoption of practical AI agents and accelerators. You will combine program leadership, product delivery, governance, change enablement, and hands-on solution shaping to move clients from current-state assessment through pilot execution, measurable value realization, and responsilbe scale.

Design PMO and AI-PDLC operating models, including governance forums, roles and responsibilities, decision rights, delivery standards, stage gates, escalation paths, metrics, and continuous improvement mechanisms.
Design, configure, and help build AI agents and agentic workflows by defining business outcomes, context, instructions, tools, data sources, rules, thresholds, human approval points, exception handling, and evaluation criteria.

Champion Delivery Excellence by creating repeatable frameworks, governance standards, quality practices, metrics, accelerators, and reusable assets across engagements.
Coach consultants providing feedback while contributing to capability development, and knowledge sharing.

8 + years of consulting experience leading business and technology transformation initiatives within a client-facing professional services or consulting environment.

P roven experience leading PMO, Delivery Office, Agile, product delivery, SDLC, or AI-PDLC maturity and readiness assessments and translating findings into operating models, roadmaps, pilots, and measurable improvement plans.

H ands-on experience identifying, designing, configuring, prototyping, or delivering enterprise AI agents, copilots, intelligent workflows, or AI-enabled delivery accelerators.

W orking knowledge of large language models, context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agent orchestration, APIs and integrations, knowledge repositories, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.

Experience moving AI solutions from use-case discovery and prioritization through prototype, pilot, validation, deployment readiness, adoption, value measurement, and responsible scale.
Strong understanding of responsible AI, privacy, security, model and agent risk, data governance, access controls, auditability, compliance, testing, and production-readiness practices.
Ability to define practical success measures and business cases for AI-enabled delivery, including improvements to cycle time, quality, forecasting, risk identification, administrative effort, adoption, and value realization.
Expertise in Agile, Waterfall, SAFe, hybrid, and product-based delivery models, with the judgment to tailor methods to client needs, maturity, risk, and regulatory context.
Demonstrated success managing engagement budgets, staffing, contractual commitments, forecasting, margin, utilization, profitability, and delivery quality.
Exceptional executive communication, facilitation, consulting, and leadership skills, with the ability to connect business, product, delivery, data, change, and technology stakeholders through complexity and ambiguity.
A growth mindset, and commitment to continuous learning, responsible innovation, delivery excellence, and Slalom's values.

jobs.description:
About Citco

JOB DESCRIPTION

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

A challenging and exciting role in a rapidly growing industry, Portfolio Analytics services across a diverse client base spanning hedge funds, private markets and multi-asset strategies across North America, the United Kingdom, Continental Europe and Asia. The Vice President of the Portfolio Analytics group will take a senior leadership role managing existing US client relationships, ensuring client retention, and driving sales, marketing and business development initiatives across the region. The team provides ad-hoc and regulatory risk reports that include, but are not limited to, exposure and P&L reports, limits monitoring, scenario analysis, stress testing, value-at-risk and fund performance analytics - supporting clients across a broad range of strategies and structures.

The role provides a unique opportunity to work closely with a wide range of securities, derivatives and structured products in many currencies traded across global markets, and to lead the build-out of a structured, high-performing client service model across the US book. The individual's duties will include, but are not limited to, client onboarding project management, senior client relationship leadership, team management, and the training and development of staff — mirroring and helping to embed a proven operating model already established elsewhere in the group.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Business Development & Commercial Acumen — Take an active, leading role in the CFS 'new business acquisition' process from a Portfolio Analytics perspective, effectively demonstrating our suite of Portfolio Analytics services to potential clients as well as new or enhanced services to existing clients, positioning this as a core driver of the role; evaluate the viability of current and new business proposals with emphasis on tactical issues and barriers
Client Relationship Management — Own and lead senior client relationships across the US book, participating in regular client calls and working closely with the global Client Integration team who oversee and project manage the firm-wide onboarding process
Reporting of Client KPIs — Own and maintain the KPI and RAG framework across the US client base, supervising junior team members in day-to-day tracking and reporting to support senior management oversight
Team Leadership & Management — Provide day-to-day leadership and management of the US Portfolio Analytics team, embedding a structured, KPI-driven client service model and ensuring consistent standards of client oversight and RAG reporting across the book
Communication — Use appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance and help others understand the importance of the vision on the day-to-day reality of the risk reporting process
Building Networks - Proactively build strong relationships with Client Service and Business Development colleagues across CFS offices as a first priority, while also networking across departments (Valuation/Profit & Loss, Operations, Internal Audit, Integration, etc.) to establish collaborative business relationships at all levels and facilitate the accomplishment of business objectives
Leading & Managing Others — Embody the CFS culture, lead and inspire team through change, encourage others to seek opportunities for different approaches to address problems and opportunities
Organization & Resource Management — Oversee the US team with responsibility for pre-sales, onboarding, client coverage planning, and other new business initiatives
Building and Retaining Organizational Talent —Focus on identifying, developing, deploying and retaining key talent within the US team (including succession planning) for the future success of CFS, initiating strategies to develop internal talent through ongoing training and conducting timely performance evaluations.
Operational Decision-making — Commit and take responsibility for tactical decisions, adopting innovative approaches to move resolution of challenges to completion; communicate outcomes to all stakeholders and contribute to CFS vision and strategy
Execution — Execute business strategy by aligning communication, accountabilities, skills, internal processes and measurement to ensure sustainable and profitable results
Client Risk & Continuity Oversight — Identify and manage clients with elevated customisation and key person risk, ensuring documented continuity plans are in place and escalating concentration risk where appropriate

Qualifications

About You:

Drive for Results — Possessing an energetic and tenacious achievement orientation; proactively seeking opportunities to drive performance of self and team, and setting stretching goals; managing personal and group strengths and opportunities
Navigating Complexity — Proactively and quickly making sense of complex issues where ambiguity exists; communicating complicated information concisely and logically
Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with proven ability to summarise and interpret client requirements
Aspiration to become a subject matter expert in proprietary risk solutions
Someone who enjoys project-based work, collaboration across teams, and dealing directly with clients — no two days the same
Quantitative background with a Bachelor's/higher level degree or professional qualification (MSc, PhD, CQF, FRM, PRMIA, GARP, CFA, FIA)
Proficient in Excel, VBA, SQL, with Python experience in particular advantageous
Knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Qlik Sense (or Tableau) and Jaspersoft is a plus
7–10 years' experience in investment and regulatory risk reporting and performance analytics in funds/asset management/banking/insurance - including hedge fund, private markets and multi-asset strategies , with demonstrated experience in client relationship leadership, team management, pre-sales, onboarding and business development
Prior experience managing or supervising a client-facing team is required
Knowledge of market, credit, liquidity and counterparty risk measurement and management under regulatory frameworks such as Form PF, Form CPO-PQR, Annex IV, Basel III/CRD IV/CRR and Solvency II is advantageous
Candidates must be willing to travel to the United States for business purposes

Salary Range:
$115,000 - 155,000

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance and central to our success here at Citco. Citco offers a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package to support your career success and personal needs. Your base salary will be determined by several factors such as the role, experience, skillset, market conditions, etc. Furthermore, qualifying positions can participate in an annual discretionary bonus pool based on company profitability and individual contributions. Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, short and long-term disability benefits, a retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, mental health and wellness support, parental leave, and more. Additional details about our total rewards package will be shared during the hiring process.

At Citco, we take pride in fostering an inclusive culture by prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation, mutual respect, and collaboration. We warmly welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. If you require any accommodations to make our recruitment process more accessible for you, please let your recruiter know.

As an equal opportunity employer, Citco adheres to making all employment and personnel decisions without discriminating based on race, color, creed, religion, sex, physical disability, mental disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status, national or ethnic origin, or any other protected status. We believe that an inclusive workforce not only enriches our company but also drives us towards greater success.

Please note that this job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Our employees may perform other job-related duties as needed to meet the ongoing needs of our organization.

Evaluate and integrate emerging energy technologies including battery energy storage systems (BESS), microgrids, distributed generation, and grid modernization solutions.

Lead portfolio-wide modularization and prefabrication strategies to improve schedule certainty, quality, and scalability across sites.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering (AI Workflows & Ecosystem)
jobs.description:
Are you driven to bring people, technology, and strategy together to build impactful software?

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber, they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

THE PROBLEM YOU’D OWN

Jobber has AI in production, but not yet at its full potential.

We already have AI answering calls, drafting responses, and powering parts of our product. But today, those systems are still fragmented. Some teams are ahead. Others aren’t. Some workflows are intelligent. Others are still manual. And most importantly, the system doesn’t yet think across the product.

A service pro still has to:

Manually follow up on jobs
Piece together context across workflows
Decide what to do next

The platform doesn’t proactively help them run their business. That’s the gap.

The opportunity is to evolve Jobber from: AI-powered features → AI-powered workflows → AI-powered business operations

This role owns that shift. Not a team. Not a feature. The system.

THE CUSTOMER

You’re building for people who don’t have time to think about software.

A plumber finishing their last job at 6 pm
A cleaner managing 30 clients and 5 employees
A landscaper juggling scheduling, payments, and follow-ups

They’re not asking for “AI.” They’re asking:

“What should I do next?”
“Why didn’t this job convert?”
“Who should I follow up with today?”

And eventually:

They shouldn’t have to ask at all.

The Director who succeeds here will understand:

This isn’t about building clever systems; it’s about building systems that remove thinking from already overwhelmed people.

What You’d Own

End-to-end ownership of Jobber’s AI system layer. You’re not owning a single team. You’re owning how intelligence flows across the entire product.

Product + Platform Scope

AI Foundations (models, orchestration, evals, guardrails)
Copilot (user-facing intelligence layer)
Automations (workflow execution layer)
Platform Experience / Marketplace (integration + ecosystem surface)
Emerging surfaces (voice, messaging, cross-product intelligence)

What This Actually Means

You are responsible for:

How decisions get made inside the system
How context moves across workflows
How actions get triggered (and when they shouldn’t)
How we evaluate whether AI is actually working

This includes:

Agentic workflows (reason → decide → act → evaluate)
Cross-product context (jobs, customers, payments, communication)
Reliability, safety, and failure modes
Developer experience for building on top of AI systems

Team Structure

~30 engineers across 4–6 teams
4–6 EMs / Sr EMs reporting into you
Close partnership with Product, Design, Data

What “good” Looks Like

The system proactively recommends and takes actions
Teams build on shared AI primitives, not reinventing them
AI output is reliable, measurable, and improving over time
Engineers trust the system, and move faster because of it
Customers feel like the product is working for them, not just responding

Someone who used LLM APIs for features
Someone adjacent to AI

Built real systems where AI makes decisions and takes actions in production.

That means experience with:

Agent orchestration (not just prompts)
Tool use and workflow execution
Evaluation (offline + online)
Observability and failure handling
Guardrails and safety in real systems
Tradeoffs between autonomy vs. control

You don’t need to code daily, but you must be able to reason at the system level.

What You’ll Actually Do

Define how AI should work across Jobber, not just within a team
Build and evolve a multi-team org to execute on that vision
Make tradeoffs between speed, quality, and safety
Push teams beyond feature thinking into system thinking
Challenge assumptions, including leadership’s
Drive adoption across engineering, product, and the company

What We’re Looking For

Leadership

You’ve led orgs through complexity, not just growth.

Managed managers across multiple teams
Built organizations that scale (not just teams that ship)
Driven cross-org alignment in ambiguous spaces

Product + Systems Thinking

You think in systems, not features.

You understand how user workflows connect end-to-end
You’ve partnered deeply with Product and Design
You care about customer outcomes, not just technical output

AI Depth (non-negotiable)

You’ve built or led production LLM/agentic systems
.

You understand what actually works (and what doesn’t)
You’ve seen systems fail and improved them
You have opinions about evaluation, reliability, and safety

Execution

You can move fast without breaking everything.

You’ve balanced shipping vs infrastructure vs tech debt
You know when to iterate and when to redesign

WHY JOBBER

WHY NOW?

This is not “AI theatre.”

We already have:

AI Receptionist (live, handling real customer calls)
AI features embedded across the product
250,000+ businesses using the platform

What we don’t have yet is: A unified, intelligent system across the product.

That’s what this role builds.

TLDR:

Most Director roles optimize delivery. This one defines: How an entire product becomes intelligent.

What you can expect from Jobber:

A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.
A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! jobs.description:
About The Role

This is a unique opportunity to shape the strategy, resiliency and employee experience of the assisted-channel platforms that enable Personal & Business Banking (P&BB) employees to serve customers. Working across Business, Technology, Product, Operations and Risk teams, the Director will turn employee, customer and performance insights into clear priorities, roadmaps and sustained outcomes.

P&BB depends on assisted-channel platforms that are reliable, intuitive and able to evolve with employee and customer needs. This role will define how those platforms advance over time, how resiliency priorities are established and how change is introduced and sustained across the frontline.

This is a strategic and execution-focused mandate. The role connects near-term stability and employee-experience needs with longer-term platform modernization, ensuring that incidents, operational insights, adoption results and frontline feedback influence priorities and investment decisions.

The Director leads three integrated functions: Assisted Channels Platform Strategy and Resiliency, Organizational Change Management for Digital Employee Platforms, and BTE.
The role establishes the strategies, governance, measures and partnerships needed to improve technology performance, employee readiness and frontline outcomes. Acting as a trusted advisor and integrator, this individual works with senior leaders and delivery partners to establish shared accountability, resolve cross-functional barriers and provide clear recommendations on priorities, risks, sequencing and investment.

Key Responsibilities (not limited to):

Assisted Channels Platform Strategy & Resiliency

Own and continuously evolve the vision, target state, multi-year strategy and roadmap for P&BB assisted-channel platforms.
Translate business strategy, employee and customer needs, technology health and operational risk into sequenced priorities, investment recommendations and measurable outcomes.

Organizational Change Management

Own the integrated organizational change management strategy and roadmap for Digital Employee Platforms and technology change affecting P&BB and other lines of business.
Provide oversight of stakeholder engagement, impact assessment, communications, learning, readiness, adoption, sustainment and benefits realization.

Branch Technology Experience

Lead the business approach to improving the technology experience for P&BB frontline employees, with a focus on stability, usability, productivity and customer service.
Establish a consistent model for issue intake, triage, escalation, communication and follow-through in partnership with Enterprise Technology and Operations.

Cross-Functional & People Leadership

Act as the connective tissue across P&BB, Product, Technology, Operations and Risk, creating shared accountability for platform, change and employee-experience outcomes.
Represent the mandate in senior governance forums and provide concise recommendations, trade-offs and decisions required.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 274773

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Team

Global Wealth Banking and Markets Engineering (GWBMT) is the fast-moving, award-winning technology engine that powers Scotiabank's Wealth and Capital Markets businesses.

The Platform Engineering organization provides the foundational technology platforms and cloud services that enable application teams to innovate rapidly, securely, and at scale. Our portfolio includes enterprise Kubernetes platforms spanning on-premises and Google Cloud environments, Cloud Enablement Services, Kafka as a Service, Airflow as a Service, Fine-Grained Access Management capabilities, and future developer platform offerings that accelerate application modernization and cloud adoption.

The Role

We are seeking a Director, Technical Product Management – Platform Engineering & Cloud Services to lead the product strategy, roadmap, adoption, and delivery of a portfolio of enterprise platform products that serve hundreds of engineers and mission-critical applications across the bank.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, product management, engineering, and business strategy. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and evolving platform products that enable cloud adoption, application modernization, developer productivity, security, and operational excellence.

As a senior product leader, you will partner closely with Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and application development teams to ensure our platforms deliver measurable business value, exceptional user experiences, and scalable solutions that meet the needs of a rapidly evolving enterprise landscape.

You will act as the voice of the engineering customer while balancing engineering priorities, platform sustainability, risk management, and strategic technology objectives.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Product Strategy & Portfolio Leadership
Define and execute the strategic vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management of a portfolio of platform engineering products and services.
Develop product strategies that accelerate cloud adoption, platform standardization, application modernization, and engineering productivity.
Identify emerging customer needs and market trends to drive innovation and platform evolution.
Establish product success metrics, adoption goals, customer satisfaction targets, and business outcomes.
Prioritize investments and roadmap initiatives based on business value, engineering impact, risk reduction, and operational efficiency.

Product Portfolio Includes

Enterprise Kubernetes Platforms (On-Prem and Google Cloud)
Cloud Enablement and Migration Services
Airflow as a Service
Kafka as a Service
Fine-Grained Access Management Platforms
Developer Platform Capabilities and Self-Service Engineering Solutions
Customer Engagement & Platform Adoption
Act as the primary advocate for platform consumers across GBM and enterprise engineering teams.
Build deep understanding of customer journeys, pain points, and platform adoption barriers.
Drive platform onboarding strategies and self-service experiences that improve developer productivity.
Partner with application teams to identify modernization opportunities and accelerate cloud migration initiatives.
Lead customer advisory forums, feedback programs, and adoption reviews to continually improve platform offerings.
Establish product analytics frameworks and measurable indicators to track platform utilization, customer outcomes, productivity gains, and business value realization.
Technical Product Ownership
Translate strategic objectives into clear product roadmaps, capabilities, requirements, and delivery plans.
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to define platform capabilities, service offerings, APIs, and user experiences.
Ensure platform products align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and regulatory obligations.
Define service offerings, operating models, support models, and service-level objectives (SLOs) for platform products.
Champion platform engineering principles, self-service capabilities, automation, and developer experience improvements.
Establish service consumption metrics, cost transparency models, showback/chargeback capabilities, and platform ROI measures.
Delivery Leadership & Execution
Lead the planning and execution of platform product initiatives from ideation through delivery and adoption.
Partner with engineering leaders to balance feature development, platform reliability, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence.
Drive agile product delivery practices, roadmap governance, backlog prioritization, and release planning.
Track delivery performance and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives across multiple platform teams.
Manage dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations across a complex enterprise environment.
Platform Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence
Define and monitor key platform performance indicators, including availability, reliability, scalability, security, adoption, and customer satisfaction.
Partner with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and Operations teams to improve platform resiliency and operational maturity.
Ensure security controls, access governance, and compliance requirements are embedded within platform services.
Drive continual improvement initiatives focused on automation, observability, service health, and cost optimization.
Balance innovation with operational stability and risk management.
Own the end-to-end platform user experience across onboarding, self-service workflows, documentation, observability, support engagement, and lifecycle management.
Stakeholder Management & Executive Communication
Build strong relationships with senior technology leaders, architects, engineering teams, security stakeholders, and business partners.
Present product strategy, investment priorities, roadmap progress, and platform value realization to executive leadership.
Influence strategic technology decisions across cloud, platform engineering, developer experience, and modernization initiatives.
Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:

10+ years of technology experience with at least 5 years in Product Management, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Developer Platforms, or Infrastructure Services.
Proven experience leading the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of large-scale platform products.
Experience working with cloud platforms, enterprise infrastructure, and application modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of platform engineering, developer experience, self-service platforms, and product operating models.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across multiple organizations.
Experience leading cross-functional teams in complex enterprise environments.
Outstanding communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
Strong strategic thinking, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making capabilities.

Technical Expertise

Strong understanding of Kubernetes and container platforms operating across hybrid-cloud environments.
Experience with public cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Familiarity with event-driven architectures, Kafka, streaming platforms, and modern data infrastructure.
Understanding of workflow orchestration and data engineering platforms such as Apache Airflow.
Knowledge of Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Fine-Grained Authorization, and Zero Trust security principles.
Experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, platform automation, observability, and reliability engineering practices.
Understanding of platform security, risk management, compliance, and operational resilience requirements.

Preferred

Experience building or managing Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and self-service engineering ecosystems.
Background in Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Architecture, or Software Engineering.
Experience driving enterprise cloud transformation and migration programs.
Experience within financial services, capital markets, or other highly regulated industries.
Knowledge of Google Cloud technologies including GKE, networking, observability, and security services.

Success Measures

Success In This Role Will Be Measured By

Platform adoption and customer satisfaction
Growth of cloud-enabled and modernized applications
Developer productivity improvements and self-service adoption
Reliability, availability, and operational performance of platform services
Reduction in onboarding friction and time-to-market
Delivery of strategic roadmap commitments
Platform cost optimization and operational efficiency
Achievement of security, compliance, and risk management objectives

What's in it for you?

We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.

Scotiabank continues to locate, remove, and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

Initial areas of focus may include Cineflix’s finance, rights management, production budgeting, payroll and planning systems, but the scope of the role extends across the organisation. Identify and prioritise practical AI and automation opportunities that improve productivity, accuracy and decision-making.

Lead systems integration, automation and modernisation initiatives in partnership with IT and functional leaders.
Evaluate technology partners and solutions based on business value, security, scalability and cost.
Lead the successful adoption of new systems, AI tools and redesigned processes.

About The Role

As an Associate Director, Analytics, you will lead complex analytics and data science engagements, bringing together strong quantitative expertise, strategic thinking, and client leadership.

This role requires a strong foundation in data science and advanced analytics
. You should be comfortable working with sophisticated analytical methodologies, evaluating data science approaches and outputs, and translating complex quantitative findings into clear business recommendations.

At the Associate Director level, you will also lead teams and workstreams, influence senior stakeholders, and help shape the analytical approach to complex client challenges. You may not be coding or building models every day, but you should have sufficient data science depth to credibly guide the work and challenge the methodology.

Responsibilities

Data Science & Advanced Analytics

Lead advanced analytics and data science work across complex client engagements. Apply and guide approaches such as statistical modeling, predictive analytics, experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, machine learning, or other advanced quantitative methodologies as appropriate to the business problem.

Evaluate analytical approaches and outputs, identify limitations and opportunities, and ensure that methodologies are rigorous, actionable, and connected to client objectives.

Complex Program & Engagement Leadership

Lead complex analytics projects or programs end to end across one or more accounts—shaping the analytical approach, orchestrating cross-functional teams, and owning outcomes at a senior level.

Strategic Analytics & Client Advisory

Translate sophisticated analysis and data science outputs into clear business implications and recommendations. Connect analytical findings to the client's broader marketing and business agenda.

Team & Technical Leadership

Lead and develop analytics and data science talent, set expectations for analytical quality, and provide guidance on methodologies and approaches across multiple workstreams.

Partner effectively with data scientists, analysts, media teams, strategists, engineers, and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions.

Early Account Economics

Take first-line accountability for the economics of your workstreams—including utilization, scope discipline, and margin within your remit—and partner with account leadership on planning and resourcing.

Client Advisory & Growth

Build credible senior client relationships and identify opportunities where analytics, data science, measurement, or AI capabilities can address additional client needs.

AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation

Identify qualified AI use cases and opportunities to incorporate AI-enabled approaches into analytics and measurement. Help evaluate where emerging technologies can create measurable value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

About You

The Essentials

Experience partnering with or leading data scientists, analysts, and other technical specialists

Strong Plus

Hands-on experience with programming and analytical tools such as SQL, Python, R, or similar
Experience with experimentation, causal inference, marketing measurement, incrementality, attribution, or other advanced measurement approaches

to lead and evolve our strategy practice across the Americas. You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are

A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo

Role Responsibilities

Executive Client Advisory

Strategic Pursuits & Business Development

position based in Canada
. The offered salary range is $ 170,000 CAD - $230, 000 CAD
